articleTitle: Control strategy of the input stream on the online charging system in peak load moments
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The report presents a strategy for managing the incoming flow, which takes into account the resource requirements for service requests for billing, taking into consideration the statistical information about the duration of the operations that will prevent the simultaneous presence in the system service requests requiring a large number of resources simultaneously.

articleTitle: Determination of bulk density of the source of heat in the analysis of thermodynamic processes in the quartz piezoelectric element
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Features of bulk density determination for a heat source are considered in the analysis of thermodynamic processes occurring in a quartz piezoelectric element. Standard dependences of distribution of mechanical oscillation of piezoresonators of turning Y-cuts are shown. The paper shows the dependence of distribution of a temperature field in AT-cut piezoelectric element of the quartz resonator under conditions of variations of its excitation power.

articleTitle: Development perspectives for radiation-hard shf transmit/receive LSI's for applications of SOI CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the study of SOI MOS transistors RF performance for 0.35-µm domestic digital SOI CMOS technology. A specialized library of RF elements and comprehensive set of SOI RF IP-blocks, including mixers, VCO's, amplifiers, ADC, PLL and frequency divider have been designed and measured. The possibility to design radiation-hard RF transceiver LSI's based on the domestic SOI CMOS technology is confirmed as per the total dose, dose rate and SEE testing results.

articleTitle: Calculation of combined stub directional couplers on microstrip and slot lines
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The use of traditional microstrip couplers in microwave integrated circuits, where the problem of miniaturization is extremely important, is problematic. Transition to 3D-structures using combinations of the transmission lines provides both improved mass-dimensional parameters and the electrical characteristics of integrated circuits. The paper presents compact couplers on the base of a microstrip and slot line combination considering their implementation. Formulas for calculating of impedances of transmission line segments defining the structure of couplers are obtained. It is shown that the proposed schemes have better parameters than a traditional three-stab microstrip coupler.

articleTitle: Microstrip broadband filters based on the multimode resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The microstrip broadband band-pass filters based on the irregular meander are investigated. It is shown that the connection with a screen of conductors of utmost quarter wave resonators results in significant improvement of frequency selective properties the filters.

articleTitle: Means of integration of heterogeneous data corporate information and telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The key features and characteristics of a declarative database for corporate information technology systems are identified. It is shown that the use of syntactic structures of deductive databases fairly confirms with logical rules for constructing intension database. It is shown that the use of rules for describing the properties of the database allows recursively computing the values of the query.

articleTitle: Creating two-dimensional images of objects with high angular resolution
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new method of digital radar signal processing for solving remote sensing, which allows obtaining two-dimensional images of objects with superresolution is presented. The method is based on solving linear integral equation of the first kind of two-dimensional convolution type by algebraic methods.

articleTitle: All-purpose adjuster for microwave microstrip devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns an adjuster providing possibility to measure characteristics of one or more microwave devices with different overall and coupling dimensions by connection of microstrip terminals of devices with microstrip line launchers of the adjuster in the course of adjusting in wide band. The issues of possibility and necessity of shielding, measurement accuracy increase and design are considered. The adjuster operation is described.

articleTitle: The use of images of DDS in the hybrid frequency synthesizers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principle of the hybrid frequency synthesizer performed on the basis of a phase-locked loop and direct digital synthesizer is considered. The synthesizer uses images of the fundamental frequency and performs a frequency conversion with a mixer in the feedback path. The mathematical expressions for the model of power spectral density of the phase noise of the synthesizer are obtained. The results of simulation of noise curves of the synthesizer for different parameters of synthesized signals are given. A comparison of noise curves of the synthesizer, a single-loop PLL and a two-loop PLL derived from similar conditions are performed. It is shown that the phase noise level of the hybrid frequency synthesizer is significantly lower than phase noise of single-loop PLLs and two-loop PLLs.

articleTitle: The low-profile phased array antenna with combined electrical and mechanical beam steering for satellite communications
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The low-profile phased array antenna with combined electronic and mechanical beam steering (EMBS) in elevation plane is considered. Simulation results of investigated antenna are introduced (Fig. 2). Optimal antenna geometrical parameters allow keeping reasonable directional characteristics for scanning angles 0±70°. Comparison of a planar phased array antenna and a stair-planar array is performed and results are presented (Fig. 4).

articleTitle: The insolation anomalies on the Crimean peninsula with observations from space
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the analysis of climatic anomalies on the Crimean peninsula on daily measurements of NASA satellites climatic parameters in extreme points of Crimea, Simferopol and Kara Dagh for the period of 1983–2005 years are presented. In order to compare the trends calculated, whose analysis reveals an abnormal growth of the earth's temperature and insolation on a horizontal surface to claim Kara-Dag.

articleTitle: Total ionizing dose hardness of microwave electronics
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A review of microwave electronics total ionizing dose (TID) test results is presented. It is shown that microwave electronics is usually characterized by high TID hardness as compared to electronic components of other functional types. However, there are microwave components with relatively low hardness, these parts contain CMOS elements.

articleTitle: Microwave measurement of water content in flowing crude oil with improved accuracy
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Some ways for measurement accuracy improvement of UWSNP microwave device are considered. Main of them take into account errors under registration of frequency-dependent relative reflected power, choice of operation part of frequency range, careful plant calibration of each sample of the device. Using the device modification UWSNP-2M as an example under its on-site exploitation, an approach for optimal tuning of the device is suggested that takes into account factors jointly influencing on measuring accuracy.

articleTitle: Recognition and 3D-reconstruction of objects from images using a priori information
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The probabilistic approach of three-dimensional reconstruction of the visual environment of urban scenes from satellite and aerial images is presented. The mathematical model of the reconstructed objects is presented. Contour images of models of reconstructed objects are shown. Conditional probability of occurrence of recognizable signs and reconstructed objects are used in the model. Hough transform is used for feature extraction. The approach aim is to find maximum a posteriori probability of the synthesized model. A maximum a posteriori probability is using Monte Carlo Markov chain scheme. Possible transitions between the models for the iterative search are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Use of fractal signs of digital images for detection of surface defects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the problem of the analysis of digital images based on local signs of self-similarity is considered. The algorithm of formation of fractal signs of images and the algorithm of detection of unrepresentative sections of the image, which in particular can be used for the solution of tasks of defectoscopy, are described. Results of researches of possibility of use of distribution of self-similarity are given in defectoscopy tasks.

articleTitle: Radiation effects in phase-locked loop
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An analysis of total dose and dose rate effects in phase-locked loop (PLL) ICs is presented. New radiation hardness test results for a variety of commercial and experimental PLL ICs are obtained.

articleTitle: The method of tolerance increasing to internal and external noises for neural network devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We propose a method to reduce the impacts of noise distorting the input data on accuracy (quality) of the neural networks' operation. The essence of the method is to determine the necessary and sufficient digit capacity of input information and elements of neural networks. The offered method is realized in the form of the algorithm, whose work is shown by an example of some neural network devices.

articleTitle: The mathematical model of a complex reflection coefficient measuring instrument based on a method of direct frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The mathematical model of a complex reflection coefficient meter for microwave devices is designed using the direct frequency conversion method. The model is represented by two independent equation systems, which are allow calculating a module and a phase of the complex reflection coefficient by two different ways using discrete analysis of an amplitude and phase field distribution in a transmission line. The model makes it possible to increase of measuring accuracy by an averaging procedure for obtained results.

articleTitle: Increasing angular resolution by extrapolating signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new method of digital signal processing by smart antennas (SA), enabling to obtain an image of the object with angular super-resolution, is theoretically justified. The method is based on the extrapolation of the signals received by each element of the SA outside the array aperture. This allows introducing new virtual emitters and thus synthesizing much larger antenna array. The method is tested in numerical experiments on a mathematical model.

articleTitle: Radio frequency indentification technology with passive tags in invasive biosensor systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Application problems of radio frequency identification (RFI) technology with passive tags for data read-out of invasive biosensors are considered: choice of operation frequency range and decreasing of negative impact of reader's electromagnetic radiation on the patient and the servicer. The comparative characteristic of RFI systems of HF and UHF ranges are offered in relation to biosensor systems. The problemsolution of decreasing of negative impact of reader's electromagnetic radiation on the patient and the servicer is offered.

articleTitle: Truss-type deployable reflector antenna systems for synthetic aperture radar mounted on a small spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper describes the principles of constructing antennas for the Earth remote sensing synthetic aperture radar (SAR) systems mounted on the small spacecrafts and based on the truss-type deployable reflector antennas developed by JSC “OKB MEI”. The basis of reflectors is a rigid truss framework. Metallic mesh grid playing the role of reflecting surface is attached to this framework. The possibility of providing electronic beam scanning with a small step for ScanSAR mode is realized by the usage of complex feed, consisting of an array of antennas, microwave switches and power divider. Two S-band SAR deployable reflector systems designed for Russian and Chinese small spacecrafts are presented.

articleTitle: The use of images of DDS fundamental frequency for high-frequency signals formation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents a method of a high-frequency signal formation based on the use of images of fundamental frequency of direct digital synthesizers (DDS). The analysis of the noise performances of signal shaper is realized. It is shown that the use of images of DDS allows reducing the power spectral density of phase noise of shaper of 5–12 dBc/Hz. It significantly decreases multiplying factor of output frequency multiplier and allows reducing the dimensions of the shaper.

articleTitle: Infocommunication systems parameter monitoring by means of artificial neural network devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the aspects of the verification of equipment operability made by artificial neural network devices. An artificial neural network device for signal verification is discussed in detail. We should pay attention that this device is developed by the authors with their own method and algorithms for ensuring of artificial neural network accuracy.

articleTitle: Single event effects in RF and microwave ICs
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper presents an overview and an analysis of single event effects (SEE) for a variety of RF and microwave ICs. New SEE test results obtained at the NRNU MEPhI test center have been used along with the published data.

articleTitle: The problem of antenna placement on complex multi-purpose objects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Problems of antenna placement on complex multifunctional objects saturated with antennas of various types, ranges, appointments and accessories are discussed. The paper provides some examples of constructing such objects' electrodynamics models based on modern approaches.

articleTitle: Multi-agent approach for the metallurgical enterprise information system development
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the multi-agent approach for the metallurgical enterprise information system development. To design a multi-agent information system of an enterprise it is required to determine goals and characteristics of agents, as well as solve problems of agents' interactions. Multi agent approach allows solving the problems of coordination and decision making for technological, logistical and business processes of a metallurgical enterprise.

articleTitle: Synthesis of signal flow group parameter optimal indicator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The task of signal flow group parameter determination algorithm development was solved. Relevant results for Poisson and Bernoulli flows were received.

articleTitle: Coherent-pulse transmitter of aerological radar
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the results of development of the coherently-pulse transmitter of aerological radar of system of radio sounding of the atmosphere with phase modulation of sequence of the request radio impulses, providing measurement of instantaneous velocity and inclined range to an aerological radiosonde (ARZ) supplied with the super-regenerative transceiver (SPP).

articleTitle: Morphology, chemical composition and optical properties of Cu2ZnSnSe4 nanoparticles synthesized by colloidal method
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the studies of the peculiarities of morphology, elemental composition and optical properties of semiconductor nanoparticles Cu2ZnSnSe4 synthesized by a colloidal method by transmission electron microscopy, energy dispersive X-ray and optical spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Graph matching algorithm in position and orientation estimation tasks
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An algorithm for the graph matching is presented. The steps of finding compliance with the expectation ratio are described. The degree of difference of edges is calculated. The way to find the similarity of vertices using the Euclidean distance is described. The algorithm is implemented and experimentally tested for performance.

articleTitle: The excitation device for H01 mode in a circular waveguide based on antiphased dipoles
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper describes the design of the compact excitation device for TE01 mode of the circular waveguide based on antiphased dipoles. Numerical investigation of the developed device is conducted. As a result, it was found that the device has a transfer index at the frequency of 6.2 GHz, approximately −1 dB. Ways and methods of reducing in the transformation losses and widening of the frequency band are also described.

articleTitle: About an energy potential of autodynes
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The expressions for calculating the noise characteristics and energy potential of an autodyne system taking into account both internal fluctuations of an oscillator active element and real power supply noises of a microwave oscillator were found. Calculations made on the example of a Gunn diode oscillator showed that the autodyne potential on case of detecting signal in the power circuit of oscillator is significantly lower than in case of detecting signals by changing the frequency and amplitude of oscillations.

articleTitle: The methods of algebra of finite predicates in the intellectual system of complex calculations of telecommunication companies
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The solution of the problem of finding hypothetically related objects in the intellectual system of complex calculations of telecommunication companies was found by applying the method of power of linear logical transformation by using algebra of finite predicates. The comparative evaluation of the method that was obtained and was used previously, was shown by using statistical researches. Also analysis of the application of the method to evaluate the performance of relational logical network was presented.

articleTitle: Simulation of wireless mesh network with smart antennas
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Adaptation algorithm for wireless network with collaborative behavior of nodes with smart antenna with respect of interference source is presented. Mathematicalmodel of routing in this network is developed. Results ofnumerical experiments are presented.

articleTitle: The hybrid frequency synthesizer based on DDS and two-loop PLL
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Applying the PLL system as a multiplier of direct digital synthesizers (DDS) output frequency in hybrid frequency synthesizers was analyzed in this paper. Increasing of DDS output frequency helps to reduce the division ratio in the feedback loop and, as consequence, decrease the phase noise level. It was proved that the PLL multiplier makes a significant contribution to the phase noise level of the hybrid synthesizer. The comparison of noise performances of the hybrid synthesizer and two-loop PLL system was performed.

articleTitle: Wide-angle mechanoelectrical beam steering antenna system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the modeling results of the phase front control structures based on perforated dielectric. One of the structures is a lens antenna with two other being identical structures with a linear phase shift. The beam steering is performed by angular displacement of linear phase shift structures. Presented antenna system provides wide-angle mechanoelectrical beam steering.

articleTitle: The radiation-hardened source of reference voltage of negative polarity for silicon bipolar-JFET technology
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the circuit methods for the construction of the temperature-stable voltage references with the use of base of npn-type and bipolar JFET transistors. The new circuitry of the voltage references is suggested for bi-FET technology which renders possible to create microelectronic products with the radiation hardness up to 1 Mrad and F=1013−1014 n/cm2 acceptable for many applications.

articleTitle: The circular waveguide TE01 mode converter based on aperture slot coupling with a rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the design of circular waveguide TE01 mode converter based on aperture slot coupling with rectangular waveguide. The described device is based on using of aperture ring shaped slots between rectangular and circular waveguides. Various forms of slots are considered and an optimal form is found, it has insertion loss −0.05 dB at center frequency with frequency band at level −1 dB about 0.3 %.

articleTitle: Development results of the unified receiving module for multichannel medical radio thermographs
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The structure and operation algorithm of the reception module of a multichannel medical radio thermograph is considered. Possibility of measurement trustworthiness rising of the radio brightness temperatures by accounting a mismatch degree of antennas-applicators with a body of the person is shown.

articleTitle: Digital beam-forming super wideband multi-beam hybrid antenna system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design of super wideband digital antenna array is considered. The hybrid reflector antenna contains a mirror forming narrow beam and array of log-periodical elements. Some variants of antenna structure, technical parameters of log-periodical antenna arrays and several types of mirrors are discussed. Results of beam forming with help of linear and non-linear algorithms are presented.

articleTitle: Microstrip bandpass filter with two spirals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Compact microstrip filter topologies with small inserted losses and easy scaling for different frequencies are presented.

articleTitle: The receiving-converting unit for the information system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The frequency receiving-converting unit operating on two parallel channels with intermediate frequencies of 144.0… 176.0 MHz and 100…1100 MHz is experimentally studied. The present paper concerns the details of the receiving-converting unit's modeling. Modeling was carried out with the aim of visual confirmation of the correct choice of software package.

articleTitle: Microstrip resonant sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The researches of properties of resonant transducers based on segments of microstrip lines, topology of which contains the microprobe tip structure are carried out. Numerical model studies of the distribution of the fields and the dependence of amplitude-frequency responses of resonant microstrip structures with probes of various configurations are carried out and value of communication and parameters of samples possible diagnosis are determined.

articleTitle: Design of broadband strip-line directional couplers with improved directivity
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theoretical and experimental results for two designs of 6-dB directional couplers operating within frequency band 2 - 8 GHz are presented. The both directional couplers are based on the coupled strip-lines. The couplers show high electrical performances as well as compact size, low weight and easy-to-manufacture design. It is shown that the directional coupler with periodic structure of step discontinuities on the outer edges of strip-lines has the better isolation and directivity in comparison with the coupler without periodic structure. The improvement in directivity and isolation is 6 dB at the high frequencies.

articleTitle: Analysis of influence of annealing parameters on electrical resistance of printed electronics elements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the study of the electrical characteristics of cells made by technology of a printer printing with conductive inks. The results of the printed items using silver ink are shown. The measurement results are presented for electrical resistance conductors printed on a flexible substrate. Submitted characteristics describe the nonlinear dependence of electrical resistivity of made samples both on annealing parameters, and length of a conductor.

articleTitle: GNSS antenna characteristics using bi-orthogonal far-field measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes a technique for characterization of GNSS antennas, using bi-orthogonal (two orthogonal linear polarizations) far-field measurements. The main feature of the proposed technique is that measurement can be done using only one measuring antenna with linear polarization. The formulas for calculation according to the bi-orthogonal measurements of the radiation patterns for co- (right-handed) and cross- (left-handed) circular polarizations, axial ratio, multipath ratio, coordinates and instability of the phase center position are given. An example of characteristics of a spiral slot GNSS antenna using the proposed technique is discussed.

articleTitle: A phase unwrapping algorithm for insar data processing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Phase unwrapping is the most complicated and unreliable stage of interferometric data processing. For real radar scenes obtained by InSAR systems the phase unwrapping problem does not have unique solution because of phase noise and aliasing. A semi-automatic phase unwrapping algorithm of 2D-interferogran into 3D dimension with further analysis of its cross-section is proposed.

articleTitle: Choosing the way to create the ensembles of m-sequences for modulation of a sounding signal of space-borne sar in order to reduce a maximum sidelobe level of a point target response function
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The study of M-sequence ensemble combining rule effect on single point response function sidelobe levels and distribution is presented in this paper. Three ways of ensemble combining are considered for generating polynomial orders of 8–13: no shift, linear shift and random shift. The best results are obtained for sounding signals modulated by M-sequence ensembles combined by a random shift.

articleTitle: Bifurcation transitions to the dynamic chaos mode in mutual coupled microwave oscillators system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the features of transition of the system of two mutual coupled and partial stable transistor microwave oscillators to the dynamic chaos mode through the coherence destruction mechanism. This phenomenon is conditionality shown a per resonant properties of a couplings channel.

articleTitle: Reflex klystrons and nanoklystrons of terahertz frequency range
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of experimental investigations into terahertz frequency range of continuous-wave and pulsed reflex klystrons, the results are obtained by IRE NAS of Ukraine, in the 1960s. The current design of reflex nanoklystrons operating in the frequency range of 1–3 THz at operating voltage of ∼ 1000 V is patented in 2010 – 2014. The nanoklystrons incorporate an electron-optical system with a matrix field emitter. This system is designed to form a laminar electron flow.

articleTitle: Filters based on aggregation operators Part 1. Aggregation operators
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this work we introduce and analyze a new class of nonlinear filter which have their roots in aggregation operators theory. We show that a large body of non-linear filters proposed to date is a separate subset of Aggregation Filters.

articleTitle: Study of the receiver module of GLONASS/GPS signals of the navigation aerological radiosonde
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Some results of the receiver module design of a navigation aerological radiosonde and pilot studies of its noise sta-bility under the influence of active interferences are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Filters based on aggregation operators. Part 3. The Heron filters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this work, a new class of nonlinear filters called the generalized arithmetic and median Heronian filters for image processing is introduced. These filters are based on Heronian mean.

articleTitle: Investigation of behavioral models for MMIC elements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Behavioral models for MMIC elements based on three multidimensional approximation techniques, i.e., artificial neural networks (ANN), radial basis functions method, and inverse distance weighting (IDW) method, are investigated. As a test example, the parametric models for describing a frequency dependence of scattering parameters of GaAs pHEMT in different DC operating points have been constructed. It is shown that IDW model demonstrates the accuracy and calculation speed that are comparable with ANN model. However, IDW method needs much lesser time for the model building. Thus, it can be successfully used for constructing MMIC elements' behavioral models.

articleTitle: Simulation of IC-packages for RF and MW applications
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new approach to characterization of IC-packages for RF and microwave applications based on electromagnetic simulation and vector measurements is presented. Following the approach the equivalent-circuit parameters and maximum working frequency have been evaluated for a variety of metal-ceramic and metal-glass packages produced domestically.

articleTitle: Digital sounding-pulse generator for UHF MST radar
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A prototype of the sounding-pulse generator unit for mesosphere-stratosphere-troposphere ultra-high frequency radar (MST radar) has been developed. The pulse generator has the following technical specifications: the output frequency range of 40–60 MHz; the output power not lower than 1 W; the RF pulse length from 0.1 to 50 µs; the interpulse interval from 2 µs to 60 µs. The RF pulse envelope can be of different shape: rectangular, trapezoidal, Gaussian etc. The RF pulse bursts can also be generated with the phase modulation using the Barker code or other codes.

articleTitle: Microstrip filters design using a spectral domain method of moments
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Coupled lines based bandpass microstrip filters are presented. Main design relations are stated. Application of spectral domain method of moments for coupled line characteristics computation is described. The results of simulation and measurements are shown.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Bit Error Rate probability for radio communications and fiber-optic communication systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the estimation of BER parameter (Bit Error Rate) for radio systems and FOCS (fiber-optic communication systems), taking into consideration what is known the relationship signal/noise SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) and the type of modulation.

articleTitle: Assessment of resistance of AlAs/GaAs nanoscale heterostructures of resonant-tunneling diodes to diffusion destruction by means of IR-spectroscopic ellipsometry
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the course of the work the procedure of the quality assessment of AlAs/GaAs resonant-tunneling heterostructures with relation to their resistance to diffusion destruction was developed. The diffusional blurring of the AlAs/GaAs heterostructure layers was detected by the means of IR-spectroscopic ellipsometry. The coefficient of Al and Si diffusion in GaAs was also calculated.

articleTitle: The element base on the basis of semi-shielded dielectric waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Operation principles and implementation problems for components are considered in the one cluster of the dielectric element base (DEB) used for creation of the large number of various passive millimeter-wave devices. The object under investigation is the complex of phenomena and specific properties of semi-shielded dielectric waveguides (SSDWG) representing a dielectric element located between two conducting plates. It is shown that devices and circuits in the SSDWG element base have a unique combination of quality properties, which cannot be achieved in the other DWG types and, thus, have essential application prospects in the millimeter-wave engineering. In particular, under defined size ratios and for determination of the specific wave types in DWG on the basis of SSDWG the “phenomenon on non-radiation” takes place, when irregularities do not cause energy radiation into external environment.

articleTitle: Use of nature of distribution of self-similarity as the sign of the digital image in the task of detection of objects on aerial photographs
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The description of property of self-similarity of the digital image is provided. The new signs of images characterizing internal distribution of self-similarity and the most similar sections of the image are offered. The algorithm of formation of fractal signs of images is described: characteristic sections of the image and nature of distribution of self-similarity. Results of researches of possibility of use of distribution of self-similarity are given in tasks of detection of objects

articleTitle: Error-corrected information transmission in telecommunication systems based on digital Hankel-Toeplitz transformation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An important systems' function of the telecommunication systems is error correction of information transmission. A digital manipulation method of information flows by means of numerical sequences with deep recursive logical interdependence is proposed. The method uses discrete Hankel-Toeplitz transformation that allows constructing an algorithm of received information fast conversion with automatic data error correction and reduced discrete transformation operation quantity.

articleTitle: Coherence estimation in interferometric SAR data processing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A technique of spatial coherence estimation for interferometric radar image pairs for digital elevation models and surface motion maps generation problems with space-based SAR data is proposed, which allows solving the problem of coherence estimate bias caused by a phase slope.

articleTitle: Design features of the spacecraft vehicle onboard equipment of the command-measuring system to control it in the zone of its coverage from a ground station and outside it
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Principle of design and initial data for design of a command-measuring system (CMS), intended to control the low-orbit spacecraft (SC) and SC, designed to operate on the geostationary orbit at the stage of their output to the state security service are considered. With two control loops, as contained in CMS - between the ground station of CMS and SC and between the CMS, satellite-relay and SC, allows providing control of SC throughout its orbit flight. The problem questions of creation of CMS onboard equipment and ways of their solution are discussed.

articleTitle: New approach to dose rate testing of MW ICs based on heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns some testing peculiarities for GaAs MW IC's based on heterostructures in the context of ionizing pulse radiation effect. Comparative analysis of experimental results achieved using a small-size pulsed accelerator and a pulse laser source with a variable wavelength is performed. The parameters of laser radiation that ensure adequate simulation of dose rate effects are determined.

articleTitle: Analysis of radiation behavior of characteristics of precision rf passive components
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the performed analysis of modern passive RF components materials and structures. EIA classification of capacitors is presented. Using own experimental results the passive components radiation sensitivity is analyzed.

articleTitle: Filters based on aggregation operators. Part 4. Generalized vector median filters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this work, a new class of nonlinear filters called vector median aggregation filters for multispectral image processing is introduced and applied to the color image filtering problem. These filters are based on an arbitrary pair of aggregation operators and a selection rule. We show that a large body of vector median filters proposed to date constitute a proper subset of new vector median aggregation filters set.

articleTitle: Dynamic modes of two coupled microwave oscillators
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the report an experimental characteristics of two mutual coupled and partial stable microwave oscillators are presented. It is shown that the same scheme depending on parameters of the passive interconnection channel is capable to operate in various regular (coherent) and irregular (chaotic) dynamic modes. Areas of operating parameters are identified in the realized specified modes.

articleTitle: Filters based on aggregation operators Part 2. The kolmogorov filters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this work, a new class of nonlinear filters called the generalized Kolmogorov filters for image processing is introduced. These filters are based on Kolmogorov-Maslov-Matkowski aggregation operators. We show that a large body of nonlinear filters proposed to date constitute a proper subset of the generalized Kolmogorov filters.

articleTitle: Spherical antenna excited by a slot in an impedance end-wall with losses of a rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic waves radiation into a space outside a perfectly conducting sphere through a narrow slot, cut in an end-wall with an impedance end-wall with losses of a semi-infinite rectangular waveguide, excited by a wave of H10 type is solved using a rigorous self-consistent formulation. The asymptotic solution of the integral equation for a magnetic current on the aperture of slot was found by the generalized method of induced magnetomotive forces (MMF). Influence of the sphere radius and impedance of end-wall upon energy characteristics of the spherical antenna was investigated numerically.

articleTitle: Modeling of the electron-molecule collision frequency variations in the undisturbed midlatitude D-region on the experimental basis
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: There are given and analyzed the main features of the model distribution of the height-temporal variations of the electron collisions with neutral molecules in the undisturbed midlatitude D-region of the ionosphere, obtained through long-time systematic experimental studies near Kharkov and episodic purposeful observation near Volgograd performed by the partial reflection and rocket methods.

articleTitle: Measurement of thread pitch of casing coupling using a laser triangulation 2D scanner
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An experimental setup was assembled for measuring of the thread pitch. An experiment to test the law of distribution of measurements of thread pitch of 2D laser scanner is held. Experimentally the optimal values of the angle of incidence of the laser beam to the surface plane of the thread tooth and the exposure time of matrix of scanner are calculated. The possibility to meet regulatory requirements to measurement error was experimentally confirmed by means of 2D laser scanner.

articleTitle: Image restoration of sound source objects using the linear array of scanning microphones
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A linear array of microphones, which allow measuring the field of sound sources in the air in the wide frequency range is designed. The measurements are processed by the matched filter that allows visualizing the sound source objects. The present paper presents the results of experimental studies of visualization sound source objects in the air at frequencies from 18 kHz to 29 kHz.

articleTitle: Calculation of multibeam reflector antenna using hybrid method in ANSYS HFSS software
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the calculation of a multibeam reflector antenna using a hybrid method in ANSYS HFSS software. A design model of the antenna, radiation patterns, SWR frequency response, current distribution on the antenna reflector surface are presented.

articleTitle: Spectral analysis of low intensity microwave radiations
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Structural realization of the device for measurement and recording of spectral components of the microwave signals of low intensity with a wide continuous range is offered. The frequency of only one narrow-band element operating in a chain of rather low frequency is reconstructed in the device. At the expense of it the influence of image interferences is suppressed and increase of accuracy and resolution of the spectral analysis is provided.

articleTitle: Method of ensuring the required transmission rate for WiMAX subscriber station
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method is proposed to meet the requirements of the transmission rate in a downlink of WiMAX. The novelty of the method is to formulate the problem as a problem of subchannel allocation redistribution of the available bandwidth for the transmission of downlink information in the direction of subscriber stations (SS) with their spatial remoteness registered (type of modulation and coding scheme), and the required transmission rate.

articleTitle: Doctor Ernst Alexanderson — From alternators to autodynes
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of work and technical solutions which are the basis of the operating principle of autodyne altimeters for aircraft offered by Dr. Alexanderson, a great inventor of the 20th century, is carried out. Obtained results of the analysis showed the correctness of technical solutions and deep insight of the physics of autodynes by the author of the invention.

articleTitle: Complex switched MOS capacitor filters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The report describes, for the first time, the creation of complex switched-capacitor microwave filters, the features of complex FIR and IIR filters constructing on the basis of switch-capacitor (SC) circuits. Separately, a choice of phasing for building the SC-device is discussed in accordance with its functional scheme. Authors offer the new SC circuit of complex delay. The report also contains the results of the complex band-pass fourth-order SC-filter modeling.

articleTitle: Dimension effect in a linear model of a Ka-band GaN HEMT
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that electrophysical property fractality (for example, ρ=ρ(l,d)) of a heteroepitaxial AlGaN/GaN structure with two-dimensional electron gas has a strong influence on field effect transistor linear model. In the present work influence of fractality on inner elements values of transistor equivalent circuit is described. It is necessary to take this influence into the account during design and manufacturing of either power or low noise AlGaN/GaN HEMT.

articleTitle: Directional characteristics of a ring aperture radiator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper an explicit analytical expression is presented, it describes a radiation pattern of a scanning ring aperture radiator. Such radiator has a form of a ring with finite width. When the ratio of inner to outer radius changes from 0 to 1 a ring aperture will change from a continuous round aperture to a circular ring radiator. It is shown that this leads to the main lobe narrowing, directivity decreasing and side lobe level increasing.

articleTitle: On the interaction of electromagnetic microwave radiation with emulsion containing magnetic nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The study of the effects of electromagnetic microwave radiation on liquid medium containing iron oxide nanoparticles is continued. A numerical simulation of distribution of electromagnetic field and magnitude of the absorbed power in the sample of the magnetic fluid in the process of irradiation is carried out. The experimental study of the interaction of microwave radiation with a heterogeneous liquid medium containing magnetic nanoparticles is carried out. The sets of emulsions containing nanoparticles of different sizes (from 20 nm to 100 nm) were prepared for the experimental works. The dependence of the thermal effects of microwaves on the size of nanoparticles contained in a heterogeneous liquid medium is investigated.

articleTitle: Simulation of fluctuation of radar signal reflected from a distributed target
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns a comparison of different methods for calculation of the apparent center of a distributed target to create an echo signal simulator. A quantitative analysis of the apparent center fluctuations due to phase shift signals from the individual elements and due to changes of the scan angle, is carried out.

articleTitle: Intelligent IT-environment for integration of semantic models to energy research
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article describes the intelligent IT-environment to support a two-level technology of energy security research. There are considered the existing and perspective possibilities for integration of semantic (ontological, cognitive and event) models in the framework of the intelligent IT-environment.

articleTitle: A set of GaAs MMIC digital phase shifters with an integrated control driver
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This report presents results of design and manufacturing of GaAs MMIC digital phase shifters with an integrated control driver based on «0.25 um Power pHEMT» and «0.5 um Switch pHEMT» processes of CJSC «Research and Production Company «MICRAN».

articleTitle: Diocotronic instability of the ribbon relativistic electron beam in the crossed fields
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper considers the diocotron instability arising in relativistic beams in crossed fields. Using analytical and numerical models, a degree of instability growth is analyzed at different beam parameters and external crossed fields' intensity. The shape of the extended electron beam is analyzed after the excitation of the instability in it.

articleTitle: Structured modeling of the biological media in the form of grid resistive wires
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The model of the biological tissue on the basis of the grid arrays of resistive filaments is considered. The amplitude and phase of the electromagnetic wave transmission coefficients are investigated. It is shown that the variation of electrophysical and geometrical parameters of the biological tissue model of the structured type leads to a substantial change in energy and phase characteristics of the transmitted electromagnetic waves for the coincident and cross- polarizations. It allows using the results of the corresponding measurements to extract information concerning deviations of biological environment properties from the typical values, for example, due to the development of cancer.

articleTitle: Study of band properties of the mode separator of two-channel antenna of MWF radio heat-seeking system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper presents the results of modeling of frequency dependences of coefficients of mode transfer of a round wave guide of H11 and E01 on the exits of a mode separator of two-channel MWF radio heat-seeking system with compensation of background noise for the solution of a problem of allocation of information component of an entrance signal of the system.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband power detector MMICs with 70 dB dynamic range
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of ultrawideband power detectors development are presented. Detectors are designed as microwave monolithic integrated circuits (MMICs) produced with use of “Micran”'s GaAs zero-biased diode technology. Several detecting paths and series diode stacks are used for dynamic range expansion. MMICs provide signal detection in dynamic range of 70 dB in frequency band from 0 to 50 GHz.

articleTitle: Phase control in microstrip reflectarrays radiators
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The basic design principles of integrated types of radiators for microstrip reflectarrays are observed and discussed. The considered kind of radiators construction allows combining two main functions simultaneously: to radiate RF energy and to control the phase of re-radiating signal. There are two types of arrays to be investigated: with time constant and time varying parameters. The last ones can be used as electronically scanning arrays “without phase shifters”.

articleTitle: Radar signals class recognition algorithm synthesis
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Likelihood factors analytic expressions and structural scheme of their forming were received for the radar signals recognition task solving.

articleTitle: Optimization of resonator for local quasi-optical SHF and EHF diagnostics of inhomogenious materials anisotropy
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the possibility of studying of weak anisotropic media, which is based on the use of open microwave resonator with a measuring hole in one of the mirrors. This approach is allowed providing the locality of observations, the high sensitivity to small variations of the reflected signal, the opportunity to explore the materials with high absorption. The use of quasi-optical resonator does not practically limit the frequency field of studies. The model of the open resonator with an inhomogeneous radius mirror, being used to describe the sensitivity of this method, is quantitatively allowed estimating the influence of geometric factors of the resonator and optimizing them for different requirements on local measurements, for the reflectivity of the objects under study, for frequency sensing.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband directional power detectors
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of design and manufacturing of GaAs MMIC directional power detectors. Detectors frequency range is from 10 MHz up to 40 GHz. Insertion loss is less than 2 dB; chip size is 1.75 × 0.75 × 0.1 mm. MMIC can be used for microwave measurement systems and for small-size detector blocks.

articleTitle: Seminatural modeling of radio altimeters over layered surfaces operation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The signal simulator for onboard altimeters allows carrying out laboratory tests and adjustments, checking functioning in close to real conditions. The reflected signal may be obtained as sum or as combination of many backscattering signals corresponding to the reflection from many underlying layered surface bright points. A seminatural platform that can generate a real-time mode signal taking into account vehicle motion dynamics, even at variable modulation parameters, is discussed.

articleTitle: A broadband sub-wavelength phase-correcting element for transmit antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents a broadband sub-wavelength phase-correcting element to design the low-profile transmit antenna arrays with periodicity structure 0.2 λ0 (λ0 - wavelength in free space) and frequency bandwidths of 17%. Shown characteristics of the studied structure calculated using CST Microwave Studio software package.

articleTitle: Metal waveguide to semi-shielded dielectric waveguide front transducers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Engineering design of transducers for half-shielded dielectric waveguides (and non-radiating waveguides in particular) is a very complex problem. Production of microwave units, which are based on semi-shielded dielectric waveguides, requires the development of designing methods for this class of devices. One of the solutions to this problem is a set of empirical methods for prediction of semi-shielded dielectric waveguides transducers parameters of different structures. In this paper we suggest engineering solutions, which allow meeting the requirements for this class of devices while keeping the minimal size of transducers.

articleTitle: Design of harmonic-tuned dual-band GaN HEMT power amplifier based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design of a harmonic-tuned dual-band GaN HEMT power amplifier (1.28 GHz and 2.14 GHz) is presented. The transistor's load impedance at the fundamental frequency, the second and third harmonics in both pass-bands were optimally selected to increase the output power and efficiency. In order to design an output matching network from these data, a new CAD procedure has been used that is implemented by means of the genetic-algorithm-based software for automatic synthesis of passive networks. This allows facilitating and accelerating the network design significantly. The measured performances of the dual-band amplifier are as follows: Pout = 37.28 dBm, G = 11 dB, PAE = 42.1% at f1 = 1.28 GHz; Pout = 35.7 dBm, G = 9 dB, PAE = 23.7% at f2 = 2.14 GHz.

articleTitle: Radiophotonics-based radiolocation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The key areas of radiophotonics-based phased-array antenna systems application in special and civil radioelectronic means are highlighted. The Russian Program of R&Ds in Radiophotonics previous designing results are discussed. An idea and a structure of All-Russian Classifier for Radiophotonic Components and Devices are suggested.

articleTitle: Study of the “memory effect” in 3-cm band gunn diodes under irradiation by fast neutrons
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Irradiation by fast neutrons provokes parameters degradation of semiconductor devices. On the other hand, operating conditions of the devices may lead to partial (or complete) annealing of defects introduced by ionizing radiation. The main aim - investigation of the “memory effect” in the Gunn diodes of the 3-cm wavelength range was carried out on the basis of n+-n-n++ GaAs structures under irradiation by fast neutrons. As a result of researches the existence of “memory effect” is established, the appearance of which leads to an increase radiation resistance under subsequent irradiation. The possible mechanisms of “memory effect” are considered.

articleTitle: Technology for environmental monitoring using wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article discusses new technology for environmental monitoring and risk assessment in the area of surveillance of potentially dangerous objects using the intellectual sensor techniques. We also consider the problem of optimal placement of sensors in the surveillance zone. To solve this problem the following main heuristics are considered: block cover heuristic, hexagonal cover heuristic, pseudo hexagonal cover heuristic, evolutionary meta-heuristic, etc. The experimental results showed that all of the proposed algorithms can be applied to solve the problem, the choice of algorithm is dictated by the specific requirements of the task.

articleTitle: Experimental research and modernization of a microwave installation for grain crops processing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Modernization of the designed microwave installation for high-intensity heat treatment of grain crops at 25 kW and 915 MHz has been made. Installation system automation, that manages and controls all systems of the installation, has been created on the basis of the industrial controller. The experimental surveys and the testing certification of the microwave installation at high power were carried out under conditions of fodder production. Technological schemes of grain crops processing have been developed and experimental results of microbiological and physico-chemical characteristics of treated grain have been obtained.

articleTitle: The multibeam electron system for increasing of gyrotron operating frequency
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper the possibility of THz gyrotron operating at the third harmonic of the gyrofrequency with electron-optical system with two tubular electron beams is under discussion. An electron source in this case is the traditional cathode gyrotron geometry with two emitting rings. Previously, such a system has been successfully used to increase the output power of gyrotrons and selective excitation of mode on the second harmonic of gyrofrequency. The use of multibeam systems with enhanced selection shall record values of power and frequency of CW gyrotron in terahertz range.

articleTitle: Development of microwave power divider for radio module based on Low-Temperature Cofired Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: As part of the development of the radio receiver module operating at ∼ 1.6 GHz frequency we developed a microwave power divider circuit board made of DuPont Green Tape 951 Low Temperature Co-fired Ceramics (LTCC). Electromagnetic simulation of the divider in ANSYS HFSS is conducted, electromagnetic fields are calculated and S parameters are obtained.

articleTitle: Choice of parameters of weight functions at spectral processing of signals of microwave level gauges with frequency modulation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of influence of hindrances on an error of distance measurement by a range finder with frequency modulation at signal processing in a spectral area are considered. Considerable influence of a kind of weight function (WF) on result of processing is shown. For an objective choice of kind WF it is offered to add traditional system of WF parameters in a new parameter - a relative error of frequency estimation. The comparative analysis of some traditional WF is carried out.

articleTitle: Structures of multiresonator microstrip directional traveling-wave filters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Based on the known structural scheme of single-resonator microstrip directional traveling-wave filter the formation principles of multiresonator filters of this type are considered and substantiated.

articleTitle: The microwave ice thickness gauge with frequency modulated signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper demonstrates a possibility to carry out measurements of fresh ice thickness, and enumerates existing obstacles and shows the ways of their overcoming. The block diagram of a measuring instrument with frequency modulation of the radiated signal providing demanded measurements is considered and results of experimental check are presented.

articleTitle: Additional error correction for two-port vector network analyzers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article presents a new method of addition correction of calibrated two-port vector network analyzers based on the verification procedure. The verification measures complex residual errors of a calibrated vector network analyzer. The use of the complex residual errors improves the accuracy of measurement. Experimental studies were conducted in coaxial measurement environment. Measurement results have verified the proposed method.

articleTitle: Investigation of forming nanoclusters of germanium and silicon — germanium solid in LPCVD process
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The process of self-organization and evolution of the stable perfectly-ordered nanoclusters of Si, Ge and SiGe solid solution in thin-film deposition process of the germanium-alloyed silicon for the new generation electronic devices is studied.

articleTitle: Operational features of static M2M devices under changing coverage environment
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A model of static M2M network nodes was studied using two operating methods. A threshold SNR evaluation parameter was introduced in the enhanced method.

articleTitle: Comparison of the ion-optical characteristics of conventional quadrupole probe-forming lenses in the nuclear scanning microprobe system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Optimization calculations of the probe-forming systems with three, four and five lenses are carried out. It is shown that the proposed concept of additional power supply of the lenses allows improving the physical parameters of a scanning nuclear microprobe, which can be used in development of the new lithography methods, manufacturing of microwave and nanoelectronics devices.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluation for model-based and non-model-based objects visibility improvement methods using television images
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of visibility improvement by means of television image processing is considered. Two main approaches to enhancement of images, recorded in adverse weather, are analyzed. As an example of model-based method the dark channel prior method was chosen. Its results are compared with results of nonlinear contrast enhancement methods. The modification of adaptive histogram equalization that supposes usage of contextual regions with variable sizes is presented.

articleTitle: Analytical model features of quarter-wave resonator microwave sensor for monitoring of cardiovascular pathologies
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Versions of the working space of the quarter wave microwave resonator measuring converter intended for line measurements of biological objects of patients are considered. Requirements to the analytical model of the sensor taking into account features of biological objects are formulated. To ensure the optimum form choice the model has to provide speed of calculation and possibility of graphical representation of a field in the working space. Algorithms for calculation are considered and examples of the electromagnetic field components distribution in the working space are presented.

articleTitle: Formation of chips with passive part by the alumina technology for microwave attenuator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper concerns the application of the electrochemical alumina technology for the formation of chips with passive part for microwave attenuators. The structure of this chip consists of an aluminum base with an anodic dielectric Al2O3 layer, copper strip lines and contact pads at the alumina surface, and a thin-film resistor. Experimental results verify availability of this technology for the microwave attenuator manufacturing.

articleTitle: Rezonance transitions in a high-frequency electric field in triple-barrier structures with a transparent upper quantum level
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For asymmetric triple-barrier resonant-tunneling structures with thin and high (delta) barriers and a transparent upper quantum level the analytical solution of the non-stationary Schrodinger equations describing the resonance transitions in quantum levels in a strong high-frequency electric field is found. It is shown, that the conditions of full transparency of the upper level correspond to the terms of resonance strictly in a non-transparent triple-barrier structure.

articleTitle: The world's first practical radio link between Hogland and Kuutsalo
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the history of use of the system of wireless telegraphy for practical purposes, designed by a Russian physicist Alexander Popov. The paper draws attention to the causes of this event. Based on preserved and actually existing historical documents it is shown, that the information radiolink Hogland — Kuutsalo made by A. S. Popov to carry out a rescue operation for the battleship «General-Admiral Apraksin», is an example, first in the world, of radio communication application for the needs of the society. This fact gives grounds to assert that the practical use of radio communication took place in Russia earlier than in other countries.

articleTitle: The method of planning and bottleneck analysis of enterprise project portfolio
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper focuses on the new approach and information technology of planning and bottleneck analysis of enterprise project portfolio. Comprehensive use of a multi-agent model of resource conversion processes and critical path method allows solving the problem of bottleneck analysis both for tools and for resources.

articleTitle: Capacitor structures on the basis of strontium titanate films
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Thin layers of strontium titanate have been synthesized with sol-gel method. The strontium titanate phase is registered with X-ray diffraction analysis. The thickness of the strontium titanate xerogel films deposited by a spin-on technique is in the range of 200–280 nm for 5 and 6 layers. The properties of capacitors' structures on the basis of SrTiO3 xerogels in relation to morphology are discussed. The values of the dielectric constant and the lose factor are found to be 186 and 0.08, respectively, for the frequency of 1MHz.

articleTitle: Application of MIMO-lines in the problem of three-dimensional radio-frequency visualizations of subsurface objects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The three-dimensional instrument functions of synthetic aperture LFM-radar using MIMO-lines with different topologies are studied by means of numerical simulation. A comparison with usual synthetic aperture radar was carried out.

articleTitle: IRIT-RTF created its own «time machine»
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: To anniversaries of IRIT-RTF (the Institute of Radioelectronics and Information Technologies) two books were released being dedicated to the 55th anniversary and the 60th anniversary. The present paper concerns the last jubilee digest, as the most complete and the modified edition, and shows its historical value and influence on the future.

articleTitle: Wide angle scanning Vivaldi antennas array
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Parasitic resonances in a single-polarizational two-dimensional array of Vivaldi antennas with modulus structure appearing in a wide sector of scanning are investigated. Several constructive solutions for their suppression are proposed. Results of computer simulation and experiments are discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of electron-wave microwave amplifiers with high power input signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper we deal with the study of electron-wave amplifier (EWA) based on the transparent traveling wave tube (TWT). The case of the formation of electron flow with double-humped distribution function of the electron velocity in the interaction space of the investigated device is considered. The results of investigating the dependence of the gain of electron-wave amplifier on the magnitude of the negative potential on the focusing electrode, on the length of interaction space, and on the input power are obtained. Based on the analysis of the experimental results a number of steps to improve the output characteristics of the electron-wave amplifiers based on transparent TWT are developed and proposed.

articleTitle: Evaluating the performance of several types of antennas in a holographic radar with continuous wave
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experiment examines the performance of the logarithmic spiral antennas, Vivaldi antennas and dipole antennas when operating in continuous wave radar based on a chirp signal. Evaluation of the spectrums of the received signals shows that the use of the separation shield can effectively reduce mutual coupling. It also concluded the feasibility of constructing the antenna system holographic radar as a pair of transmit and receive logarithmic spiral antennas.

articleTitle: Subthreshold detection and tracking of a small maneuvering target
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the feasibility of applying a combination of Gaussian particle filter and an interactive multimode filter for mutual detection and tracking of a small maneuvering target. We propose using two models: one with a constant velocity, another with a constant acceleration. Filters, corresponding to each of those models, employ Gaussian particle filter. Numerical modeling results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is capable of detecting a maneuvering target at low signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Development of microwave filters for radio modules based on Low-Temperature Cofired Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: As part of the development of the radio receiver module operating at ∼ 1.6 GHz frequency we developed a microwave filter circuit board made of DuPont Green Tape 951 Low Temperature Co-fired Ceramics (LTCC). Electromagnetic simulation of the filter in ANSYS HFSS is conducted, electromagnetic fields are calculated and S parameters are obtained.

articleTitle: Wireless microwave system study for remote monitoring of environmental parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The structure of the remote microwave system with packet information transmission through the microwave channel of the GPRS mobile network operator and packet reception from the Internet to operator PC is described. The possibility of time-synchronized multi-channel remote measurements and the time delay check of separate packets propagation through telecommunication channels, is shown.

articleTitle: On possibility of electrolysis in standing HF-wave field
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The forming technique of a deposited metal layer by the standing space field harmonic of the resonant oscillator with long-time interaction is discussed. The study shows that the electroplating efficiency of the high-conductivity periodical layer on a cold cathode in presence of the standing space field harmonic can be rather high without essential technological problems.

articleTitle: The analysis of cumulative phase difference and euclidean distance application to the problem of reference dictionary creation in dictionary based estimation methods
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
