abstract: Euclid distance and cumulative phase difference criteria used for reference set construction are analyzed. The potential gain in signal-to-noise ratio, required for a given detection probability, is studied for various parameters such as antenna element number and aperture angular size. The parameter's range, when the gain is obtained, is analyzed.

articleTitle: Ultra-short pulse characterization of dielectrics with simultaneous evaluation of conduction, relaxation losses and dielectric nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method for the characterization of dielectrics allowing simultaneous measuring of relaxation, conduction losses and dielectric nonlinearity at the short-pulse impact is proposed. In this case we may evaluate the function of the instantaneous power loss versus time. An example of practical measurement of characteristics of two capacitors with very different relaxation losses is given.

articleTitle: Adaptive estimation of time and power parameters of the random pulse with inexactly known duration in the presence of the interference with unknown intensity
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Synthesis of measurement algorithm of time delay, mathematical expectation and dispersion of the low-frequency random pulse with inexact known duration observed against white noise and band Gaussian interference, adapting for unknown intensities of action additive distortions is implemented. On the basis of the performed generalization of a local Markov approximation method the closed analytical expressions for conditional biases and variances of made estimates are found. By means of statistical computer modeling the functionality of the offered measurer is established and applicability borders of asymptotically exact formulas for characteristics of its operating effectiveness are determined.

articleTitle: Analysis of plasmonic nanowaveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The vector integral-differential equation to describe electromagnetic waves propagation in nanowaveguides and photonic crystals containing thin metal layers is developed. The exact solution of the equation is obtained with Galerkin method taking into account complex dielectric permittivity of metals in the optical range. A simple method to find out complex effective refractive index for low-loss waveguide structures is developed and proved. Surface plasmon-polariton (SPP) waves were simulated in the structures under consideration.

articleTitle: Digital radio relay station “contact-11M.820M1 ETH”
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the digital radio relay station with 820 Mbit/s bandwidth and with an emission band of 80 MHz. Such stations are manufactured by “Beta TV com”, Ltd, Donetsk, Ukraine.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence of AlGaAs/InGaAs/GaAs phemt heterostructures with donor-acceptor doping of barriers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We have studied the photoluminescence (PL) of AlGaAs/InGaAs/GaAs pHEMT heterostructures with donor-acceptor doping of AlGaAs barriers. We have found out that the application of additional p+doped AlGaAs layers leads to the appearance of the new bands in the PL spectra. These bands are identified as the transitions between 1) donor-acceptor pairs in the doped AlGaAs layers and 2) conduction subband - acceptor levels in the undoped InGaAs well.

articleTitle: Determination of heartbeat parameters through using the form of oscillations of a brachial artery by radiowave interferometry
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the possibility of biometric parameters control of the human body motion related with heartbeat, using the form of oscillations of a brachial artery, by the method of radio wave probing by means of a radio-wave interferometer based on an autodyne microwave Gunn diode oscillator.

articleTitle: Electrochemical formation of through thickness anodic alumina structures with embedded aluminum elements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Technological features for the formation of free anodic nanoporous Al2O3 structures and 5–100 µm thick embedded aluminum elements simultaneously by a two-sided through thickness electrochemical anodization were studied. It was proved that the thickness of the free alumina plate, the distribution and sizes of the interconnection system in its volume were varied by technological conditions.

articleTitle: Conductivity of planar GaAs Schottky diode with small thickness of the active region
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The conductivity of the thin film Schottky diode on GaAs is investigated. It is shown that at a low thickness channel there is the changing nature of the relationship between voltage and conductivity of the diode, and it is explained by the spreading of the potential and, subsequently, the lack of inter-valley scattering.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization of the cesium atomic-beam tube functional parts
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Possibilities of basic functional parts parameter improvement of the industrial cesium atomic-beam tube, on which Russian global navigation satellite system GLONASS is based, are discussed.

articleTitle: The analysis of influence of spherical radomes of large reflector antennas and antenna arrays on their radiation properties
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of equivalent surface currents on the illuminated side of a multilayered antenna radome for calculation of reflection and transfer coefficients is suggested. The effects of antenna gain decreasing and the main lobe shifting are analyzed. The multilayered radome properties are calculated with tensor Green's functions.

articleTitle: The effect of emitter and collector parameters on the collective electron transport properties in a semiconductor superlattice
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We proposed the mathematical model of space-charge dynamics in semiconductor superlattice with ohmic emitter and collector contacts. With the help of this model, the effect of contact parameters on the domain generation properties has been studied.

articleTitle: The mismatched sidelobe-free filter for compression of phase-shift keyed signals with increased processing gain
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The mismatched sidelobe-free filter is proposed for compression of phase-shift keyed signals with increased processing gain. The search of a combination of phase-shift keyed signals and mismatched sidelobe-free filter, providing the best compression effectiveness, is performed. The analysis of effectiveness of the proposed filter is carried out. The proposed filter is supposed to be used in signal processing software of the perspective radar.

articleTitle: MMIC l-band frequency solid-state converter with an integrated LO amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of development of the frequency converter with integrated LO amplifier have been presented. The frequency converter with dimensions 2.2×2.6 mm2 has been fabricated. The MMIC provides conversion loss not exceeding 12 dB within 1–2 GHz radio frequency range and at 0 – 0.5 GHz intermediate frequency range with −5 dBm LO power.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable antennas based on diffraction arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of a new class of antenna systems with variable array geometry and shape of the radiators is presented. It is shown that the most technologically advanced and least costly are reconfigurable microstrip antenna arrays. The numerical investigation results obtained by the original model based on the integral equation method and the periodical structures theory are considered.

articleTitle: Study of relativistic virtode in CST Particle Studio
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Mechanisms leading to the microwave generation breakdown and to the corresponding microwave impulse shortening in the relativistic virtode have been investigated with the help of CST Particle Studio. It has been discovered that this breakdown is conditioned by the qualitative change of beam dynamics during the process of the suppression of generation in the system. Obtained results is principally important because it may help in the long term to solve the problem of a microwave radiation impulse lengthening and, hence, the efficiency increasing of relativistic virtode. The optimization of virtode geometrical parameters (cathode-anode distance, cathode radius, feedback window size, plunger positions et al.) was carried out with the help of CST Particle Studio optimizer in order to maximize the efficiency of the device in a single-mode regime.

articleTitle: Test site image analysis for SAR radiometric performance determination using a statistical method
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A statistical method of test site radar image analysis for SAR radiometric performance determination is proposed. The software has been tested using the reflected signal hardware-in-the-loop simulation.

articleTitle: Organization of a modulated signal and a method of laser modulation by means of the signal
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper suggests a method of external modulation by an optical modulator of laser. Permissible speed of a modulating signal of Corning-10-A modulator is 10.5 Gbit/s and overall speed of all service signals is 4G in Interactive Heterodyne Transport Network (for 2000 kinds of service, 12 Mbit/s for each service) is 24 Gbit/s in total. This contradiction can be solved by application of the principles of the organization of technology TDMA for signals provided by OFDM technology.

articleTitle: OFDM as a method for distribution of communication system resources
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Scenarios for management of the transmission system resources by using OFDM technology are considered taking into account the spatial factor together with changing the load in the system. The possibility of using OFDM technology in the proposed scenarios is based in accordance with the distribution of the communication system resources.

articleTitle: Band pass tunable filters of vhf range, completed with use of varicaps
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of creation of circuits of band pass tunable filters of VHF range with use of varicaps are considered. Possibility of transformation of elements of the circuit for the purpose of achievement of the necessary nominal of elements of the circuit is shown. The experimental inspection, which has shown good compliance of settlement and experimental results, is carried out.

articleTitle: Applied aspects of the use of microwave chaotic signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Problems of practical application of microwave chaotic signals are discussed. Examples of the use of dynamic chaos in communication systems, including wireless sensor networks, are shown. International standards IEEE, allowing using of UWB microwave chaotic signals in modern communications and wireless monitoring systems, are analyzed.

articleTitle: About some features of formation information signals of resonance measuring converters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the experimental study of parameters of a resonance converter included in the measuring circuit. It is shown that the character of change of the main information signals of the converter (Q and resonance frequency) depends on the parameters of the object of diagnosis, due to changes in ignition mode of the converter in the measuring circuit. Thus, the measuring data signals do not adequately reflect the changes of parameters of the investigated objects, and this fact shall be considered when analyzing the results of measurements.

articleTitle: On the application of method increasing frequency resolution in a portable wideband microwave generator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article presents the application results of the method obtaining sub-Hz frequency resolution in the wideband microwave generator. Using the method there was built an unique instrument with the functional capabilities of classical generators and only 2.5 W of power consumption.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of delay in voice transmission and congestion influence in LTE network
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the comparative analysis of voice transmission delay in LTE network at incoming and outgoing calls in Almaty. Channel congestion influence to the delay was also studied.

articleTitle: System tasks in information communications and a general approach to their solution
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The info-communication network is studied in the present paper from the point of view of system approach as the main object of the new communication paradigm known as “info-communications”. The work covers a set of system tasks such as planning, control, reconstruction, identification of info-communication network and also offers general solution for the tasks as adaptation of a complex system.

articleTitle: Patterns of microwave modification of semiconductor thin film structures
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns heating, annealing and redoping of semiconductor layered structures using a microwave radiator with a micron-sized aperture. We proposed a variant of such a modifier that is based on a conical coaxial waveguide. The study is focused on localization of heat and specific spatiotemporal distribution of temperature depending on the electrical and thermal parameters of the objects under study.

articleTitle: Temperature in biological body under microwave power
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Simulation of an antenna system with nearby a user's head is carried out using SCT SUITE software. Analysis and experimental investigation of the temperature inside the meat in the microwave oven is made in static and dynamic mode.

articleTitle: Application of a combined horn antenna with a dielectric resonator for allocation of new formations
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the possibility to use the microwave method to localize tumours by means of the combined horn antennas with dielectric resonator. Application of metal plates around the dielectric resonator allows adjusting the radiation pattern of antennas and VSWR. VSWR, S-parameters, chart orientation and interaction with multilayer dielectrics are simulated.

articleTitle: Transition to chaos in semiconductor superlattice coupled to external resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The transition to chaos in semiconductor superlattice coupled to external resonant system had been investigated. We have shown that transition to chaos goes through type I intermittency in the system under study. This fact is approved by dependence of the mean laminar phase length versus criticality parameter, and form of Poincare mapping

articleTitle: Multiple-beam cloverleaf slow-wave structure «cold-test» simulation results analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The application of multiple-beam slow-wave structures (SWSs) allows lowering accelerating voltage of a microwave device. The paper deals with multiple-beam cloverleaf slow-wave structure investigation. Engineering software was used for numerical simulation and “cold test” results obtaining. Finally, the results were analyzed.

articleTitle: Side-fed offset cassegrain antennas with 18°×18° field of view: An efficiency comparison using surface area efficiency criterion
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculated performance of side-fed offset Cassegrain antennas (SFOCAs) with two different feed arrangements and two different subreflector sizes is investigated and compared in this paper. Antennas under investigation have 70 wavelength circular apertures (1° beamwidth) and operate over a conical FoV of 18°×18°. The efficiency investigation and comparison are performed using the novel surface area efficiency (SAE) criterion that was introduced as an additional criterion for comparison of efficiencies of the dualreflector antennas with big subreflectors in addition to the classical aperture efficiency (AE) criterion. Using SAE criterion for beams located at the edge of FoV, it is shown that in the case of the simplified feeds arrangement within a plane array oversizing of the subreflector dimensions is much more effective than comparable increasing of the surface area of the whole AS with the standard subreflector size. In the case of the feeds with optimal positions and orientations this benefit is negligible. Designed SFOCA with an oversized subreflector within the whole FoV of 18°×18° has SAE better than 25% (AE > 50%) for the simplified feed positions within a plane array and SAE better than 32% (AE > 65%) in the case of the feeds with optimal positions and tilt angles.

articleTitle: Power pHEMTs operating at zero gate bias
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The first development results for zero gate bias operation power pHEMTs have been submitted. High power transistors with Γ- type gate with gate length and width about 0.3 µm and 0.8 mm demonstrate specific output power exceeding 1.6 W/mm associated gain higher than 10 dB and efficiency higher than 40% at 10 GHz in pulse mode at +0.2 to −0.2 V gate bias operation. The possibility of lowering the input resistance in such devices by introducing a special embedment in the field of ohmic contacts has been investigated.

articleTitle: Minimization of the SLL in antenna arrays of mobile systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Methods of designing the antenna arrays with aperture hexagonic structure and the spatial element arrangement are considered. Directivity characteristics with regular and in-phase aperture excitation considering manufacturing technology errors are considered.

articleTitle: Study of oscillation modeswith intensive higher harmonics in a relativistic electron beam with a virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This work presents the results of the study of nonlinear oscillations of a relativistic electron beam with a virtual cathode in the cylindrical drift space depending on external magnetic field values, current and initial energy of injected electrons of the relativistic beam. Special attention was given to the analysis of higher harmonics of fundamental frequency of virtual cathode oscillations with the change of system control parameters. The numerical simulation was carried out by means of CST Particle Studio software package for three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation. The complex dynamics of virtual cathode in the relativistic electron beam were found out. Particularly, these were defined areas in the plane of the control parameters “beam current - magnetic field” where the first/second/third harmonic of current oscillations was maximal.

articleTitle: Transmission monochromatic radio tomography of dielectric objects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We propose a method of transmission multi-angle monochromatic radio wave imaging of dielectric objects. The emitter radiates spherical waves to one side, and measurement of the amplitude-phase field distribution is achieved on the opposite side by the receiving antenna array. The object is placed on a rotating platform that allows making multi-angle measurements. By matched filtering of multi-angle measurements the image of dielectric objects is restored.

articleTitle: Caillat boundary relations usage for signal classification effectiveness estimation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Boundary expressions for correct signal classification probability estimation using Caillat relations were received.

articleTitle: Phase response and group delay characteristics of UHF multiband filters and diplexers based on high-pass and low-pass filters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Phase response characteristics of multiband filters, as well as diplexers, with different amplitude response characteristic approximations based on high-pass and low-pass filters are studied. An absolute diplexer phase reaches the maximum at the frequency when LPF and HPF amplitude response characteristics intersect. The phase maximum value depends on juncture bandwidth and channel isolation.

articleTitle: The multichannel homodyne measuring system repeater
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this article the principle of a multichannel homodyne measuring system of a microwave signal amplitude and phase propagations fluctuations with a homodyne frequency transform is considered. The possibility of constructing a repeater with a gain of about 30 dB and more is shown.

articleTitle: Research of data transmission processes through data link with noise in a baseband
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the study aspects of data transmitting processes at different transmission rate through a data link using modems forming signals in a baseband. The feature of this research is artificial insertion of noise with various spectral characteristics to a channel for finding of error rate in data transmission using software and hardware of a microcontroller without using high-level algorithms and hardware.

articleTitle: Analysis of waveguide technologies and extremely high frequencies devices based on the dielectric structures with the use of patent content knowledge
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Patents are the best indicators of innovative development. It is possible to identify appearance of next-generation technologies, lines and paces of their development by using patent analysis. This scientific research was conducted to study the problem of the knowledge extraction from the patents in the area of radio electronics for the designing new engineering solutions for dielectric element's base. A new concept of «patent content knowledge» was introduced as knowledge contained in the full-text and images of the patents. Trends and paces of the development were discovered by using time series in the area of interest. Various data mining and knowledge extraction technologies were analyzed and utilized. A new method of “innovation tree” construction is proposed. It is effective for the technological area identification and monitoring up to a single relevant patent.

articleTitle: Development and investigation of constructing principles of RFID-systems for remote monitoring performance
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The structure of a wireless device for gas pressure measurements based on RFID technology with small current consumption is proposed. Basic principles of RFID-technology operation are considered, the data transmission interface is chosen. The software for microcontroller PIC 12/16 for data reading from the pressure digital sensor and data transmission through the wireless interface is developed.

articleTitle: Extraction of MMIC active device parameters by final measurements results
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the extraction of MMIC active device (PHEMT) linear equivalent circuit parameters by means of final measurements results. The experimental results are provided.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of the performance requirements for the arithmetic coder in H.265/HEVC standard video coding
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental results on the coding of high resolution video sequences with a different frame rate in the H.265/HEVC coding system. This gave possibilities to estimate the required performance of an arithmetic coding unit, largely determines the performance of the entire coding system. it is proposed to use a relative number of blocks encoding of the minimum size in the encoded images as a measure of the spatial complexity of the encoded images.

articleTitle: Water-containing nanocomposite electromagnetic shields operable at decreased temperatures
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The temperature influence upon the shielding characteristics of flexible water-containing nanocomposite shielding materials on a textile base is studied in the frequency range of 8–12 GHz. Application of porous materials with a highly developed surface, as well as nanostructuring additives and components for the solution prevents the nanocomposite water-containing materials from shielding efficiency deterioration at temperatures below freezing point.

articleTitle: Adaptive compression based on binominal numbers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article deals with solution of the problem of adaptive data compression based on the binomial binary numbers. There has been given appropriate algorithms for their preparation and accounts, which solve the assigned problem by converting binomial numbers into binary ones and vice versa.

articleTitle: State and prospects of the system of testing areas for ground support of external calibration for space systems of Earth's remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two satellite-covered testing areas for ground support of performance monitoring of space-based SAR are developed, created and successfully operated. In the short term the testing areas will be additionally equipped with metrological means of all Earth's remote sensing ranges.

articleTitle: Study of surface impedance of conductive inks for manufactrure of microwave frequency LTCC devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the study results concerning surface impedance of conductive inks with different composition for LTCC systems and comparison between them and wide used materials.

articleTitle: The mathematical model of distribution of light aeroions is in an operation zone of an air ionizer
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article presents a specified model of spreading light air ions in space at the operating aeroionizer.

articleTitle: Magnetic insulator with texture: Electromagnetic properties
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Prospects for production of magnetic dielectrics with texture are discussed. The samples of composites with magnetic texture are obtained. Increase in values of magnetic characteristics for textured magnetic insulator is shown. The electromagnetic properties of Z-hexaferrities composites are measured in microwave range. It is shown, those imaginary part of magnetic permeability of an insulator with texture 1.5 times more that of an isotropic samples.

articleTitle: Engineering calculation of cyclotron protective devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of engineering calculation has been presented and ways of increasing pass band of cyclotron protective devices according to the model of two- and three-section bandpass filters with Chebyshev characteristics have been considered.

articleTitle: Macros programming in modern electromagnetics software packages by the application example of log-periodic dipole array antennas designing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The proposed report notes the perspective of using programming features provided by modern commercial electromagnetic software packages to automate and accelerate the process of designing of complex multi-element microwave structures. Two macros coded for log-periodic dipole array antennas (LPDAs) designing in popular software tools FEKO and CST Microwave Studio are presented and discussed. These macros are able to create the fully parameterized models of multi-element log-periodic antenna structures including determination of mesh setting, material properties, boundary conditions, field monitors, and other project settings. Two example designs of LPDAs are shown. One of them is the simple L-band LPDA operating at the frequency range from 0.9 GHz to 1.5 GHz. Another one is the decade bandwidth planar LPDA feed for a reflector antenna with F/D ratio of 0.55 that consists of 47 dipoles.

articleTitle: Broadband balanced frequency multipliers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the broadband frequency multipliers constructed on the balance scheme, which based on the Marchand balun. Results of modeling and measurement of multipliers models are given in octave frequencies ranges. Topology of bridges and design of modules are considered. Modules are constructed on the Russian element base.

articleTitle: On-board slotted waveguide antenna array
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The slotted waveguide antenna array (SWAA) was developed and measured in an anechoic chamber (AEC). The measurement results have shown good agreement with results obtained from the modeling and technical task requirements.

articleTitle: To the theory of superheterodyne plasma-beam free electron laser of the dopplertron type with non-axial electron beam entry
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A quadratic theory of a plasma-beam superheterodyne free electron laser of the dopplertron type with non-axial electron beam entry is constructed. It is found, that four different operation modes in the investigated device can be realized. The conditions with peak amplification factor are determined. It is shown that amplification factors of electromagnetic signal in all operation modes of the device are increased when beam entry angle grows.

articleTitle: Constructive methods of functioning assurance of memory microcircuits at radiation influence
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of experimental researches of protective properties of screens on the basis of coverings Bi/Sb and composite tungsten-copper (W75Cu25) at 1.8 MeV electron irradiation of microcircuits of programmable ROM 256 K are submitted. It is found that application of these coverings allows increasing hardness of ROM to 1.8 MeV electron radiation by factor of 13–16 to fluences Fe = (3 ÷ 6)·1014 cm−2. Calculation equivalent values of fluences Fρ = (2.25 ÷ 4.5)·1013 cm−2 of 23.3 MeV proton radiation, wherein be assured of ROM functioning with specified screen arrangement are defined.

articleTitle: Propagation simulation of VHF radio waves over a strongly-inductive surface
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of numerical simulation of the propagation of UHF radio waves over the plane strongly-inductive surface are presented. Numerical simulation showed the appearance of surface electromagnetic wave over the structure of the “dielectric on conductor” at the frequencies of the radio-navigation system GPS L1=1575.42 MHz and L2 = 1227.6 MHz.

articleTitle: Overview of the existing solutions in the area of the discovery of web services in multiontology environment
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The brief overview of existing methods for web services discovery is given. Problems with low relevancy, interoperability and decent human factor while discovering the web service are solved by addition of semantic information to web service description. Existing models of ontology-annotated web-services are analyzed; their extension allowing achieving more relevant discovery results is proposed.

articleTitle: Compact microstrip filters with symmetrical frequency response
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper describes the new microstrip pseudocombline filters with symmetrical frequency response and small size, which operate at frequency f0 ≈ 1.8 GHz. Filters are implemented on dielectric substrates with εr = 92 and contain step-impedance resonators.

articleTitle: Evaluation criteria of representation error of signals as orthogonal series
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is proposed to decompose a signal into a series of functions that are orthogonal with weight, which can be both positive and negative values. It is shown that in this case there are two criteria for evaluating the mean square error of this approximation. It is expedient to use one of the criteria to assess the effect of noise for the correct reception. This criterion allows determining the form of the basis functions, which minimize the error. The second criterion should be used to determine the approximation signal error as finite sum of the series. If the basis functions are equidistant, the error is minimized by determining the displacement intervals of basis functions.

articleTitle: Accounting of object interperiod shifts for increase of interperiod filtration of radar signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: To increase the efficiency of noise interference suppression the interperiod filtration of radio signals is applied. It is shown that the accounting of interperiod shifts of an accompanied object allows increasing not only interference suppression efficiency, but keeping a form of a detected signal as well.

articleTitle: MMIC Ka-band frequency image rejection solid-state mixer
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents results of development of a microwave monolithic integrated circuit of an image rejection mixer based on quasi-vertical Schottky diode designed for using in Ka-band frequency signal range. The MMIC provides conversion loss not exceeding 10 dB and image rejection more than 15 dB in frequency range from 27 to 36 GHz.

articleTitle: Computer modeling of devices and systems for the measuring bench creation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of computer simulation is introduced and the software package is developed for the virtual laboratory works creation. The created software package simulates the functionality of the modern measurement devices and allows creating a virtual computer-added laboratory for microwave devices investigation. The simulated devices provide the interface equal to the real ones.

articleTitle: Properties of superhard (Zr-Ti-Cr-Nb)N nanocoatings
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper concerns the investigation of structure, composition and properties of superhard multielement (Zr-Ti-Cr-Nb)N coatings obtained by vacuum-arc deposition. The study of coatings was performed using SEM, EDS and XRD. Hardness measurements and adhesion tests were provided. The optimal conditions for (Zr-Ti-Cr-Nb)N coating's deposition were found.

articleTitle: Use of global navigation satellite systems radiation to solve problems of radar and remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the possibility of using of global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) radiation for the detection of targets. Relations are obtained to assess the range of detection. The requirements for the degree of suppression of the direct signal lights are determined. The requirements for receiving systems located on the low-orbit satellites to meet the challenges of the global radar and remote sensing are formulated.

articleTitle: Electroplastic effect associated with the dislocation generation in the initially dislocation-free silicon whiskers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experiments on local high-intensity electric current pulse effect on mechanical properties of silicon whiskers made it possible to reveal a novel type of electroplastic effect associated with the generation of dislocations. The procedure of electric current effect by single impulses on the siliconwhiskers of the having the highest specific strength from all investigated versions of shapes of a solid body is offered. The structure of crystals in an initial state and after the effect by single impulses of current of various density is investigated.

articleTitle: Modifying effects of low-intensity extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation under injury induced by X-rays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It was shown for the first time that the exposure of laboratory SHK mice to low-intensity modulated extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation (EHF EMR) with effective parameters (carrier frequency of 42.2 GHz, intensity of 0.1 mW/cm2, exposure duration for 20 min, pulse modulation with a frequency of 1 Hz) before and after treatment with X-rays at a dose of 4 Gy caused pronounced radiation protective effect which is manifested as more recent restoration of thymus cellularity and a keeping unchanged summary content of fatty acids in thymic tissue. It is supposed that the mechanisms of the radiation protective effect of EHF EMR are connected with an induction of adaptive response and favorable action of the radiation on repair processes.

articleTitle: Magnetic susceptibility tensor of the composite material consisting of single-domain magnetic particles with uniaxial magnetic anisotropy
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Using the Smit - Suhl method, we have calculated the magnetic susceptibility tensor of magnetized ferromagnetic media with the uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy. An analysis of the obtained formulas in the particular cases of a composite material with randomly oriented ferromagnetic inclusions of ellipsoidal shape has been carried out.

articleTitle: Application of epochs superposition method for periodic component searching in semi-major axis distribution of Near Earth Asteroids (NEA)
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An important fundamental problem is to find periodic components (if they exist) in distributions of elements of orbits of comets, asteroids and meteor showers. The method of superposed epochs is a non-parametric method of finding of hidden periodicity and is based on building of series' phase diagrams for different values of test periods. Its advantage is the absence of a priori assumptions about the shape of a periodic component, which in most cases is assumed as per harmonic, and therefore it allows determining the true shape of the periodic component.

articleTitle: Microwave dual-reflector antenna irradiator for a system with four-channel reception
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The scheme and design of the duplex four-horn operating with a circular polarized waves irradiator with four receiving outputs are presented. To use the irradiator for a dual-reflector antenna feed the design contains a dielectric lens forming a narrow radiation pattern with a low side lobe level. Results of the Ka-band irradiator study are presented.

articleTitle: Elementary theory of clinotron with distributed interaction of electron beam with orthogonal component of field
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theoretical analysis of cross power of interaction between an electron beam and an orthogonal field component for a device such as a clinotron with an electron beam slope incident onto a comb, is made. The analysis concludes that under some conditions on the clinotron the cross-directional wave component could make a significant effect on the full power of the interaction between beam and the HF-field.

articleTitle: Microwave and antenna devices synthesis based on genetic algorithms implementation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Implementation of genetic algorithms to solution of applied problems in radiophysics based on functions of many variables optimization is discussed. Preferences of these algorithms are demonstrated by the example of two problems: designing Rotman lens with minimum total phase error and synthesis of a two-ring circular antenna array with a specified radiation pattern.

articleTitle: Formation of coherent structures in helical electron beam with a virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of analysis of complex nonlinear dynamics of a helical electron beam in the system with a virtual cathode are presented. By means of Karhunen-Loève decomposition, the processes of appearance and propagation in the beam with the virtual cathode of the space-charge wave are analyzed. It has shown that dynamics of an electron beam with the virtual cathode is defined by spatio-temporal dynamics of Karhunen-Loève modes.

articleTitle: Methods of signal processing systems remote sounding
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Raising awareness of the results of subsurface radar sounding of the ground cover is associated with improved spatial resolution of environmental monitoring, as well as suppression of various correlated and not correlated disturbances. To solve these problems, it is most expedient to use methods of signal processing, which lead to increased accuracy and spatial resolution systems.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic compatibility of sampling gate system processing of wide band radiosignals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Frequency response of sampling gate system with asynchronous interference is presented. The results of the semi-natural influence asynchronous interference on the radiopulse sampling gate system are shown. Possibility of suppression of external interference with the help of wobbling the sampling period by a random law is shown. A fluctuation period according to the harmonic law at 3% can suppress asynchronous interference by 20 dB.

articleTitle: Meeting-1969 on dielectric waveguides. The social-information evaluation in the generations' dialog after 45 years
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The scientific-technological analysis of arrangement, holding and results of the first All-USSR meeting on a theory and application of dielectric waveguides in UHF and optical range technology (Moscow, MPEI, January 28—30, 1969; hereafter Meeting) is given. 56 reports presented by 54 native authors were listened and discussed on this Meeting. This was the first wide meeting of researchers and developers in this scientific-technological area, which after 45 years the native “Dielectric Elements' Base” (NDEB) was come into being. The technology of this analysis has two peculiarities: 1) it was carried out in the “Generations' Dialog”, i.e. in the form of discussion between older generation and junior PhD-students; 2) authors consider not only informational aspect but the social ones, i.e. evaluate this Meeting influence on “the social-information climate” in the scientific community cluster presented in this Meeting.

articleTitle: The compact band-pass filter on L-ridged rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of electrodynamic analysis and synthesis of band-pass filters on rectangular waveguides with complex L-shaped ridge is solved. The calculation of cutoff wave numbers and expressions for components of electromagnetic fields were carried out by the method of partial regions including the singularity of an electromagnetic field on metal edges. As a filter prototype the evanescent waveguides model and Chebyshev approximation are used.

articleTitle: Microwave energy for heating viscous products in railway tanks
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Evaluation of possibility of microwave heating for recrystallization of viscous products in railway tanks has shown high efficiency of this method in comparison with existing ones. Dielectric properties of petrolatum were investigated experimentally and possibility of using microwave energy to heat it up to temperature of 80 °C was analyzed. Bases for creation of microwave heating installation were developed by using slot antennas. Conceptual design of mobile installation to heat and drain viscous petrolatum from railway tanks with microwave power of 100 kW at a frequency 915 MHz was created.

articleTitle: Measuring of microwave electric field sensor sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new method for investigation of sensitivity of the integrated optical nonelectrode electric field sensor was designed. This method is based on a compact microwave asymmetrical double-ridged waveguide with regular inhomogenities. Small dimensions of the waveguide along with 1 W power of the microwave generator produce the strong electric field. The sensitivity dielectric sensor electric field strength of 3 cm microwave range was measured.

articleTitle: Formation of membrane structures based on porous Al2O3 with high-ordered nanomorphology for filtration systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Technological fabrication features of free membranes based on high-ordered matrices of nanostructured anodic porous alumina with open-ended pores without the barrier layer were designed. The special combined method composed of the smooth slow voltage drop at the final stage of the two-stage anodization with the cathode polarization and with the alumina chemical etching for the barrier layer thinning and removal was optimized. These membranes are promising as filtration systems elements for different applications because of their manufacturability, capability of reproducing and regularity of the structure parameters.

articleTitle: Characteristics of the optimal receiver of information signals with unknown discontinuous parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this work the universal method for determination of characteristics of optimal detectors and measurers of information signals with the unknown discontinuous parameters, based on approximation of solving statistics or its increment by local Markovian random process, is considered. Application of the offered approach for calculation of false alarm and missing probabilities, and bias and variance of time delay estimate of the discontinuous quasi-determined and random pulse is illustrated.

articleTitle: Influence of residual gas pressure and ion implantation on the properties of nitride high-entropy alloys (TiZrAlYNb)N
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Using methods of electronic and atomic-force microscopy, energy-dispersive analysis, laser scanning microscopy, X-ray diffraction, hardness measurements the nitrides of high-entropy alloys (TiZrAlYNb)N, obtained by cathodic-vacuum-arc-vapor-deposition, were investigated. Influence of residual gas pressure on the properties of investigated nitrides was found. In addition, comparison of structure and phase analysis of investigated coatings before and after ion implantation of the heavy negative charged Au- was conducted.

articleTitle: 2D electron gas mobility in pseudomorphic AlGaAs/InGaAs/AlGaAs heterostructures with donor-acceptor doping
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown, that the donor-acceptor doping of pHEMT heterostructures lead to significant suppression of an additive parasitic conductivity channel via δ-doping layer. In such heterostructures the two-dimensional electron gas mobility reached the value of 6000 cm2/(Vxs) at density exceeding 4×1012 cm−2.

articleTitle: Influence of the electromagnetic radiation at frequency of 129 GHz on nature of self-oscillatory reaction of briggs — Rausher
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the transmission spectra of gases evolved during the reaction of Briggs-Rauscher in the infrared range. It shows the amplitude change of the transmission minima, which in turn indicates a change in the concentration of the gases released during the reaction. The transmission spectra of a reaction medium control (unirradiated) and when exposed to electromagnetic radiation at a frequency characteristic of the oxygen absorption line spectrum 129 GHz, are compared.

articleTitle: Microwave antenna formation using innovative technology
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Three-dimensional model of the device formed was created. Then, using ABS plastic, a completed component was produced with a 3D printer. A conducting metal layer was deposited on the component surface to form a microwave antenna offering a number of advantages.

articleTitle: Device for light therapy based on sources with a frequency modulation of human biorhythms
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The proposed device includes the light-emitting diodes with different wavelengths of radiation and the frequency of the LED's alternating, which increases the effectiveness of influence upon the acupuncture points. The switching frequency of LEDs may change within a frequency range of the biological rhythms of the human organism from tens to hundreds of Hertz.

articleTitle: 3D-modeling elecrostatic system of Schottky contact
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Three-dimensional modeling of electrostatic metal-semiconductor contact with Schottky barrier has fully confirmed the presence of the experimentally observed extended halos with low contact difference of potentials of the surface around the contacts. The results show that changes in surface potentials around the contacts are caused by the spread of electric charge of the space charge region on a sufficiently large distance (l > 2 µm) under the action of electric field of periphery.

articleTitle: Symmetrical antennas in anisotropic medium
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Symmetric antennas pattern in the near and far zones were constructed on the basis of exact solutions of Maxwell's equations for a uniaxial crystal in an anisotropic medium. The trustworthiness of the obtained solutions for symmetrical antennas directed perpendicular to the axis of the crystal was checked by the law of conservation of energy flow.

articleTitle: On the correctness of vainstein-solntsev equations for excitation of waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the comparison of various expressions for waveguides' excitation equations which were derived by several authors. Their equivalence is demonstrated. Some cases are pointed out when approximate expressions describing interaction with only one synchronous mode are valid.

articleTitle: The study of aerogels on the basis of carbon nanotubes in the open microwave resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the technique and results of measurement for electric and magnetic polarizabilities of spherical aerogel samples of multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) with diameters up to 4.5 mm by means of an open resonator (OR) in 8 – 12 GHz range.

articleTitle: Extensibility and integration of tools for 3D data visualization and analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of the analysis of the possibilities of integration and expansion of existing software for visualization and analysis of scientific data. The expediency of use of the VTK framework that implements the methods of data display, and provides for their implementation in hardware-software systems, intended for reception and processing of spatial information.

articleTitle: Radar image quality improvement by means of interperiod spread spectrum optimization for switched-frequency SAR
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Mathematical modeling of SAR sounding signals and corresponding response functions providing range resolution improvement by means of interperiod spread spectrum is made for investigation of carrier hopping order effect on radar image quality.

articleTitle: Possibilities of increasing capacity of microwave links for their repeaters in Fresnel zone
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theoretical possibilities of increasing capacity of a single-interval radio relay line by means of the physical phenomenon of phase front curvature of electromagnetic waves are presented. Location of repeaters of radio relay stations (RRS) in Fresnel zone is the main condition. The scheme for implementation of this method and results of modeling distances (bases) up to additional antennas of repeaters of RRS for different signal/noise + interference ratio (SNIR) are shown as well.

articleTitle: Terms of appearance of abnormally large errors in phase direction finders in case of receiving signals from a radio source with a scanning antenna along terrestrial paths
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analytical relations, defining conditions for appearance of abnormally large errors in case of receiving signals from radio source with scanning antenna by a direction finder along terrestrial paths, are obtained. It is theoretically proved that it is necessary to compare the phase difference measurement at various bases of the direction finder with a certain threshold in order to detect bearings with abnormally large errors.

articleTitle: Minimization of equivalent noise bandwidth of weighting functions to reduce the effects of microwave generator phase noise
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We have shown the possibility of reducing the equivalent noise bandwidth (ENB) for adaptable weighting functions (AWF). ENB is minimized by the frequency of one variable zeros of the spectrum at a given variable number of zeros of AWF spectrum required to minimize errors caused by noise.

articleTitle: Intersystem jamming of wireless communications based on UWB noise signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Numerical simulation of UWB noise communications with spectrum spreading is performed. It is detected that the intersystem jamming appearing in result of code spectrum modulation. Noise performance of UWB communication system is investigated for a single-ray channel with additive Gaussian white noise. The new method of intersystem jamming reduction is proposed when nonmultiple time delays of noise informative signals are used.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the temperature condition of waveguide-distributive systems of communication spacecrafts
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the simulation and evaluation of temperature state of waveguides in operational conditions on the Earth and as a part of the spacecraft on an orbit, taking into account influence of sunlight and transfer of SHF signals of high capacity.

articleTitle: Multiparameter diagnostic of semiconductor layers by use of microwave waveguide photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility to simultaneously determine the thickness and the electrical conductivity of a thin semiconductor layer and the mobility of its free charge carriers using a one-dimensional microwave photonic crystal has been shown. The semiconductor layer plays a role of the irregularity in the one-dimensional waveguide photonic crystals. The results of the determination of a highly doped semiconductor's epitaxial layer parameters by the inverse problem solving using reflection and transmission spectra in a microwave band are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave resonator measuring converter in the diagnosis of semiconductor plates
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electrodynamic characteristics of the resonator measuring converter that used for the diagnosis of semiconductor structures are theoretically identified. The analysis of basic geometric parameters, that determines the characteristics of the probe and its sensitivity, is conducted.

articleTitle: Electrodeposited nickel nanopillared structures for magnetoresistive sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Nanopillared structures fabricated by Ni electrochemical deposition into/onto thin porous anodic alumina are investigated to use as a magnetoresistive sensor medium. The fabrication processing features, SEM, AFM, XRD characterization results for the structures are presented. The magnetization and current transport features in Ni pillars matrix structure in the current-perpendicular-to-plane mode have been modeled. The simulation data are presented for the magnetic susceptibility effects in composite nano-pillared structures.

articleTitle: New tools of video analytics based on intelligent sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of the functionality extending by means of new tools for video analytics is experimentally shown in an industrial system of intelligent video surveillance by the example of retail networks. At the same time the possibility of creation of intelligent sensors based on the combined of sensors with higher-level analytical systems is also shown.

articleTitle: Effect of linear dimensions of the drain-source 2D-channel of AlGaN/GaN hemt on its static current-voltage characteristics (lateral size effect)
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that in the local approximation, the fractality of electrical properties of the 2D-channel has strong influence on the behavior of static CVC of the drain-source channel of AlGaN/GaN HEMT. An increase of the linear resistance ρ(l,d) with decreasing length l and width d of the channel down to the values less than the limit of the local approximation L leads to a slower growth of the drain current Id and a more rapid increase of Rd. Only in the global approximation, when l and d > L, the parameters Id and Rd have the well-known classical dependences on the length and width of the channel for the specific resistance Rsp = R☐

articleTitle: Interaction of water with oxyethylated derivatives of glycerol
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The hydration number of oxyethylated derivatives of glycerol (OEGn) of polymerization degree n = 5, 25 and 30 is estimated using molecular dynamics simulations. The maximum of the distribution of bound water molecules for OEGn = 5, OEGn = 25 and OEGn = 30 corresponds to 11, 26 and 30 water molecules respectively. The data have been compared with the results of infrared spectroscopy, as well as hydration estimation based on the analysis of the phase diagrams of water-OEGm binary systems. The prospects for further studies by EHF dielectrometry are considered.

articleTitle: Technology of porous silicon dioxide films synthesis and their electrical properties
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the synthesis technology and electrical properties of porous silicon dioxide films made by magnetron sputtering of the composite target (Si:C) in the oxygen atmosphere. Such method is fully compatible with the existing stages of integrated circuits production implemented in the majority of cases in vacuum conditions.

articleTitle: Oscillation of spatial distribution of electric field and carrier density in p-i-n semiconductor structure
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A numerical calculation of the distribution of the electric field and the carrier concentration in the p-i-n diode under forward bias, as well as experimental studies of these characteristics using near-field microwave microscope have been made. The principle importance of taking into account the dependence of diffusion coefficient of the charge carriers on the electric field in the description of the processes occurring in the p-i-n diodes has been shown. The numerical results are in qualitative agreement with experiment.

articleTitle: Development of the calculation technique of the three-electrode electron gun modulation characteristic of the microwave devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the modulation characteristic calculation technique development for the three-electrode electron gun. This technique is based on the analysis of the field structure made by different focusing potentials along the electron-optical system axis, which was conducted with the finite integration technique. The obtained permeability values of the first anode allowed calculating the modulation characteristic, which defines the type of the cathode emission current in dependence of the focusing potentials in the minor values region.

articleTitle: Spherical vectorial functions application for electro-magnetic field approximation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analytical equations of a vectorial spherical waves (VSW) structure considering a critical cut are presented. Main relations for electromagnetic waves representation by means of VSW both on near- and far-field zones are stated. Some results of a field approximation example are shown.

articleTitle: Compression of phase-shift keyed signals with increased processing gain in the presence of Doppler frequency shift
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of influence of Doppler frequency shift on effectiveness of compression of phase-shift keyed signals with increased processing gain is performed. The matched filter and the mismatched sidelobe-free filter were considered as signal compression filters, the signal with pulse compression in accordance with P3 codes was considered as a phase-shift keyed signal.

articleTitle: Analysis of complex turbulent dynamics of an electron beam in a low-voltage vircator as a part of 3D electromagnetic simulation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The detailed analysis of electron flow complex behavior in a low-voltage vircator as a part of fully electromagnetic 3D computer simulation in CST Particle Studio is carried out. The main features of virtual cathode microwave devices construction modeling by the example of low-voltage vircator are shown. Many aspects and mechanisms of microwave generation are discovered. In addition, the character of physical phenomena involved in space charge oscillations is clarified. By means of CST Optimizer the optimization of geometrical and physical parameters is carried out to increase microwave generation efficiency.

articleTitle: Locating radiotomography through dielectric heterogeneities of known shape
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the proposed method for reconstructing of three-dimensional images of scattering objects hidden behind the dielectric obstacles by processing of monostatic radar multipoint radio frequency probe measurements. The measurements of signals' quadrature component on different frequencies in a broad band are used. The method is based on the calculation of the back-propagation field in the dielectrically inhomogeneous medium. It is assumed that the shape and the refractive index of the dielectric barriers are known.

articleTitle: Detection of signals with a frequency hopping spread spectrum
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of the receiver of signal detection with a frequency hopping spread spectrum is carried out. Elimination of the linear path internal noise effect on the output S/N ratio is shown. In the LabVIEW software environment a model of the detector is developed. The obtained results are adequate to theoretical studies.

articleTitle: The results of theoretical and experimental investigation of EBG-filter
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article presents the results of EBG- bandpass filter study. This filter based on a microstrip line with perforation in its screen. It is shown that the defect (reduction of the central elements width) can decrease bandpass losses. Good agreement between theoretical calculations and measurements for EBG-filter with a defective structure is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Gradient-based search technique using for M-QAM signals' DC-offset estimation and compensation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of using a gradient search technique to compensate the DC offset at the output of the quadrature converter is investigated in this research. The preliminary compensation of I/Q imbalance is assumed. The results of the work are a simulation model of a demodulator created in MATLAB SIMULINK in order to analyze the use of this method when receiving signals with M-QAM modulation, and frequency spectrum before and after calibration for QAM-4, −16, −32.

articleTitle: Mm-wave elements' base on the basis of dielectric structures: A semi-century way of formation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Scientific and technological aspects are generalized in this report for more than a semi-century period of researches and developments of dielectric elements' base of mm-wave range in the USSR and in Russia.

articleTitle: Dielectric losses in diamond-like materials at the cryogenic temperatures in the millimeter waveband
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the study results of the temperature dependence of the dielectric loss at millimeter waves in the temperature range of 1.0 – 300 K in some low-absorbing dielectric and semiconductor materials having the diamond-like crystal lattices. It is shown that the absorption maxima at helium temperatures in materials with a centrosymmetric lattice are primary associated with both intrinsic and extrinsic losses, and in materials with a noncentrosymmetric lattice - with extrinsic losses. The relaxation times, activation energies and other parameters characterizing the Debye mechanism of extrinsic losses of the investigated materials are determined on the base of the approximation model of temperature dispersion of losses.

articleTitle: Development of software for quicker response to troubles in data network
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns development of software modules for quicker response to troubles in data networks. Remote network traffic analysis and signaling mechanism are used to identify the state of connection between users and Internet Service Provider.

articleTitle: Properties of ROD and plane-layered hyperbolic metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The hyperbolic metamaterials in the form of a long (infinite) metal pins in the background dielectric and plane-layered metal-dielectric heterostructures have been considered. The method of integral equations (volume and surface) and the method of transfer matrix for layered structures have been applied for analysis. The modifications of the transfer matrix method for periodic and quasiperiodic structures transfer matrices are presented. The solutions of the dispersion equations and the diffraction problems for finite structures are obtained. Hyperbolic dispersion law is considered in the case of the losses in the metal. In this case, there is a limit on the modulus of the wave vector. It is shown that in the structures the waves of infrared and terahertz bands propagate along the pins or layers with low losses and speed, not much different from the speed of light. Transverse to the layers waves are strongly reflected, and the structure is a thermal screen.

articleTitle: Binomial multiple-valued codes for information transfer jamming resistance
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns application of the multiple-valued binomial numbers as a jamming resistance code. The methods of detection of errors are examined on their basis. The estimation of jamming resistance is given. The charts of probability of detection of errors are resulted.

articleTitle: The investigation of effect of thin films conductivity on the acoustic waves in structures containing piezoelectric plates
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The fractional change in velocity and attenuation of the zero-order acoustic wave with shear-horizontal polarization propagating in “YX LiNbO3 - air gap - conducting film deposited of glass surface” are experimentally investigated. The possibility of determination of film conductivity in such structure by the noncontact methods is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Angular coordinate of signal sources joint measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The measuring algorithm for the angular coordinate of several signal sources with the resolution above the Rayleigh has been presented.

articleTitle: Structure of ceramic substrates of microwave hybrid integrated circuits modified by laser radiation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Study results for a near-surface layer of aluminum oxide ceramics substrates for microwave hybrid IC's (MHIC's) are presented. Layers are produced by treatment of laser beam (1.06 μm wavelength) exposure - laser treatment. It is shown that there is a formation of a texture of chevron type and non-stoichiometric surface layer towards the lack of oxygen, as well as an increase of coefficient of fracture toughness for 6% after laser treatment and melting.

articleTitle: Determination of viscosity properties of blood using a noninvasive method
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the dependence of viscosity properties of blood on parameters of a pulse wave.

articleTitle: Analysis of multilayered antenna radomes as a radiation problem solving
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The Green's functions method of layered structures is suggested for antenna radomes reflection and transmission analysis. The incident wave is associated with equivalent surface electric and magnetic currents on the illuminated side of the flat multilayered structure. Reflecting and transmitting fields are calculated as the radiation of equivalent currents. Stratified structure is modeled with equivalent circuit approach. Reflection and transmission coefficients are calculated for different structures, incidence angles and polarization.

articleTitle: Electron optical system of Cyclotron Protective Device
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design and parameters of electron optical system with the ribbon-type micro cathode for 3-cm wavelength Cyclotron Protective Device (CPD) with increased frequency band are discussed.

articleTitle: Physical and asymptotic approximations for currents on a conducting cone from diffraction of a plane wave
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The engineering formulas for the tangential components of magnetic field on the surface are obtained— For a spatial diffraction problem on a cone. They are expressed by means of the function V.A. Fock and large radii cross-section (or away from the top) are asymptotic in nature.

articleTitle: Application of series feeding for design of MMIC monolithic amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the development results for MMIC amplifiers with series feeding. The experimental characteristics are presented.

articleTitle: The dual-band antenna system based on new generation transmit/receive modules for the on-board radar
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of implementation of the dual-band (X-band and L-band) on-board naval radar with wide angle scanning based on a new class of transmit/receive (T/R) modules with radiator printed on the T/R module shell is shown. Variety of wideband patch antennas is considered. Electrodynamic simulation for a “butterfly”-type printed radiator is developed. Also the L-band radiator is proposed for the above mentioned antenna system. Calculated directivity and matching characteristics of the proposed radiators are shown.

articleTitle: The numerical model for microwave oscillations in a ferrite-filled transmission line saturated by a longitudinal magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents a procedure and results of a numerical simulation of a pulsed electromagnetic wave traveling through a coaxial transmission line, partially filled with a ferrite material and placed in a longitudinal magnetic field.
