The evolution of the pulsed signal is analyzed, especially in connection with generation of monochromatic oscillations. The dependences of their frequency and amplitude on parameters of the line and the ferrite medium are discussed, as well as optimum selection of the line length and problems of line matching with the source and the load.

articleTitle: Wide-angle range provision of microwave invisibility by means of cylindrical cloaks
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A wide-angle range microwave invisibility effect for a frequency band of 1.7–2.2 GHz, obtained by means of the multilayered cylindrical cloak, is studied. The dependence of the invisibility effect on the order of the adopted transformation is analyzed.

articleTitle: Circular polarization flat-layered spherical Luneberg Lens antenna system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Investigation results of a flat-layered spherical lens made from a homogenous dielectric material at circular polarized wave illumination are presented. Possibility of lens anisotropy behavior compensation is shown. Axial ratio calculated data at beam pattern maximum direction at working frequency range are given.

articleTitle: Beat mode control in a power pulse millimeter waves gyroklystron
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Beats of output radiation are studied experimentally in a pulse power gyroklystron. The beats are between auto-oscillation frequency of an output section and input signal frequency. One-frequency radiation or two-frequency beats are observed depending on the relation between output section radiation power and input signal power. Experimental results are in good accordance with theory of external monochromatic force locking.

articleTitle: The passive band passing filter synthesis for navigation receivers of satellite systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Development of the L1 range band passing filter (BPF) is presented in the article for GPS signal. Design of BPF is carried out with Nuhertz Filter software use, with the subsequent simulation in the Microwave Office program.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of digital predistorters of communication systems' transmission paths
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The effectiveness of digital predistortion techniques for improving the linearity of the transmission path of modern communication systems using multistage signals was examined. A comparative analysis of the digital predistorters based on different behavioral inertial models was carried out. The impact of the input signal and its average power on the complexity of the model implementation is studied for a case when a predetermined level of out-of-band emissions is reached.

articleTitle: The use of one-port resonant transistor amplifiers in conjunction with lange coupler for RFID system transponder design
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Implementation of the transponder of a radio-frequency identification system, which is based on two one-port resonance transistor amplifiers (OPTA) and Lange coupler is considered. The results of operation simulation and good matching of the amplifiers with transmission line for I/O impedances of 50 Ohm, carried out in the program Agilent Advanced Design System, are obtained.

articleTitle: The preparation direction approach for satellite communication system specialists of institute of telecommunication systems of national technical university of Ukraine “Kyiv polytechnic institute”
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The program includes three stages: the first stage includes information about basic knowledge of satellite communication systems, orbital moving and flight dynamic, ITU-frequency coordination, performances and architecture of earth station and communication satellite, types of multiply access and satellite link budget; the second stage includes information about coding, modulation, synchronization and DVB-S standards; the third stage includes information about designing and engineering of satellite communication system, launch-vehicles, personal mobile satellite communication systems, satellite radio navigation systems, remote sensing satellite systems and internet access satellite systems

articleTitle: Excitation of the high Q-factor whispering-gallery modes in the hemiball shielded dielectric resonator by the “slot-line”
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Using of the “slot-line” for excitation of high Q-factor whispering gallery modes in shielded hemiball dielectric resonator in 8-mm wave band is proposed. This excitation method is effective and allows exciting the high order modes without additional energy losses. It is proved experimentally that obtained values of Q-factor are more than the “barrier” values that are limited by dissipative losses in a dielectric.

articleTitle: Flexible multilayer shielding structures for microwave devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The developed multilayered shielding structure involves materials with magnetic and dielectric losses. The frequency dependence of the reflection coefficient and the attenuation of the EMR in the range of 8.0…12.0 GHz are studied.

articleTitle: The temperature drift compensation method of radioelectronic optical methane concentration meter
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The radioelectronic optical methane concentration measuring instrument with hardware-software method of temperature drift compensating is developed and studied. The metrological characteristics of the meter is determined: absolute basic measurement error does nor exceed ±0.07 vol.% in the range from 0 to 4 vol.%, which is 3 times less than required, and the additional error caused by a temperature change from +5 to +35 °C is not more than ±0.15 vol.%, which is 2.7 times less than allowable error, according to GOST for coal mines methane detectors.

articleTitle: Optical properties of Langmuir-Blodgett films of tetraphenylporphin derivatives and mix-substituted phthalocyanine derivatives
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The optical properties of Langmuir-Blodgett films of a number of tetraphenylporphin derivatives and heterosubstituted phthalocyanine derivatives with 3,6-dioctyloxyphthalonitrile and 3,4,5,6-tetrachlorophthalonitrile fragments were investigated. The comparative analysis of absorption spectra of the obtained films was carried out. The dependence of optical properties of Langmuir-Blodgett films on the molecular structure of these compounds was established.

articleTitle: The method of intersymbol interference elimination in slowly changing multipath channels
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of intersymbol interference elimination in a slowly changing multipath channel is described in this paper. The considered method does not use safeguards.

articleTitle: Characteristics of ion-plasma coatings AlN-TiB2(TiSi2) after annealing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The magnetron sputtered coatings on base of AlN-TiB2(TiSi2) are investigated in this paper. The element composition, structural-phase composition, morphology are investigated after annealing of coatings with 900°C and 1300°C. The amorphous structure and high damping properties of the AlN-TiB2(TiSi2) coating make promising the use of these coatings as diffusion barriers in the form of independent elements.

articleTitle: Reconstruction algorithm of sea surge spatial spectrum using composite signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents one of possible methods for sea surge spectral characteristics estimation based on analysis of scattered probe signal, consistent with surface impulse response. The relative mean square error of sea waves energy spectrum component amplitude measurement is estimated.

articleTitle: The analysis of results of the left ventricle contouring using automatic algorithm on ultrasound images for patients with pathologies
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the automatic contouring algorithm of the left ventricle on ultrasound images of the apical four-chamber projection of the human heart. The applicability of this algorithm for the patients with the ischemic heart disease is examined. Further ways of research to improve the quality contouring are described.

articleTitle: Magnetic field influence on the spectrum of magnetic permeability of composite material containing single domain uniaxial magnetic particles
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The calculation of the frequency dependence of the permeability tensor components of composite materials containing ferromagnetic magnetouniaxial particles is carried out. The possibility of controlling losses by changing the magnitude of the magnetizing field is also shown.

articleTitle: Interference origin of fine structure of dynamic spectra of solar radio bursts
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Disturbance, caused by a solar flare, is accompanied with the radio emission of falling down frequency, affects the biosphere and influences on operation quality of many devices of surface and space equipment. The presence of heterogeneity on the way of radio waves results in the origin of interference and scintillation of observed radio emission. Comparison of analytical description of scintillation with the results of spectral observations from remote points showed that the formation of fiber-structures with intermediate speed of drift and the wide-band pulsations of solar flare radio emission is satisfactorily explained by multibeam propagation of radio waves through coronal plasma.

articleTitle: On singularities in 2D model of particles motion in axially symmetrical field
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new cylindrical coordinate system is proposed to make possible excluding any artificial singularities existing in a conventional cylindrical coordinate system and significantly decrease simulation time of axial symmetric electron-optics systems.

articleTitle: EM wave diffraction on bivariate periodical waveguide dielectric antenna array radiation elements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The EM wave diffraction problem on bivariate periodical waveguide dielectric radiation elements antenna array is solved with the strict settings. Radiation elements include stepped and gradual nonhomogeneous transitions in waveguides and Floquet channels. Trefftz's method and finite-element method combination was used at the EM models. Efficiency of such combination is confirmed by comparing of the accounting and experimental results.

articleTitle: Study of dispersion characteristics of a multirow interdigital slow wave structure
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of an experimental study of dispersion characteristics and field distribution of the main and higher order modes of multi-row interdigital slow wave structures with their size changes are presented. The ways of increasing the frequency separation of the main and higher order modes and the operating excitation band of the main mode. The study of the forced oscillations of the multirow interdigital slow wave structure with exponential H-waveguide power ports has shown the possibility of a single-mode excitation in a wide bandwidth.

articleTitle: Concerning the stability of broadband amplifier chains based on vacuum uhf devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We propose an original modification of the broadband amplifier chain consisting of an input amplifier tube with high gain and output amplifier tube based on a transparent traveling wave tube. The feature of the proposed modification is that the signal is supplied to the modulation grid positioned between the cathode and the anode of transparent travelling wave tube. It is shown that the signal being supplied to the modulating grid located at the cathode to the output amplifier transparent traveling wave tube improves the stability of the whole amplifier chain.

articleTitle: Laser simulation of ionization effects in microwave elements on A3B5 semiconductor compounds
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of transient radiation effects simulation is shown using laser radiation in the microwave elements based on A3B5 semiconductor compounds. The results of the laser ionization effects simulation in pseudomorphic HEMT at Al-GaAs/InGaAs/GaAs semiconductor heterostructure are presented.

articleTitle: Integral criterion in problems of modulation kind detection for narrowband radiosignals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An integral criterion for signal narrowbandness is described, it does not have the drawbacks of local criteria, because it admits individual integrable derivative jumps. The criterion takes into account the rate of signal's phase change with an amplitude weight. It is noted that the above criterion is also useful for classification of modulation kinds in complex radio signals. The structure of an algorithm simulating the process of modulation type detection, as well as the results of statistical modelling for signals with amplitude and phase modulation, is presented.

articleTitle: Power amplifiers for jamming stations
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the unit architectural construction of an amplifier with output power of 1 kW operating in the frequency range from 30 MHz to 1215 MHz and an amplifier unit for the frequency range from 20 MHz to 6000 MHz with output power of 30 W. The amplifiers are made by “Beta TV com”, Ltd, Donetsk, Ukraine and can be used for construction of jamming stations.

articleTitle: Vertical handover interaction model of mobile Software Defined Radio system elements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The access selection method of vertical handover process in heterogeneous reconfigurable mobile radio systems based on Software Defined Radio technology is proposed: access selection problem is formulated and vertical handover procedure in such systems is described; functional architecture for the management and control of reconfigurable mobile network is also proposed.

articleTitle: Master oscillator AFC in microwave diagnostics of semiconductors and metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of analysis and selection systems of AFC. Theoretical estimations of the parameters of the system and design optimization based on the requirements to meet the challenges in the field of microwave diagnostics of semiconductors, dielectrics and metamaterials, are carried out. AFC system of modulation type for microwave generators on modern base, which may have universal application in microwave diagnosis of various materials, is proposed and created. Singling out signals of measuring data with using the developed AFC system it can implement recording of kinetics of various processes, which are described by changes e and tgd at various influences, or after-effect of relaxation.

articleTitle: The signal/noise ratio for the weighted correlation processing of deterministic signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is proposed to transfer information using signals that are orthogonal with weight. It is shown, that the receiver of such signals is a correlator containing an additional functional unit in the form of a periodic weighting function generator. An analytical expression for the signal/noise ratio at the output of the correlation is obtained.

articleTitle: Waveguide-beam transducers on multimode dielectric waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article describes the design and operation of waveguide-beam transducers in EHF-band provided in the dielectric element base and multimode dielectric waveguides. The main object is wide-dimensional dielectric waveguides. The phenomena, which have place in wide-dimensional dielectric waveguides, are analyzed. The ways to improve efficiency and quality of waveguide-beam transducers are suggested.

articleTitle: Time optimization of interperiod accumulation of radar signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Usually it is considered that the more time of interperiod accumulation of radar signals, the more relation “signal/noise” is. It is shown that there is optimum time of interperiod accumulation of radar signals.

articleTitle: Self-directed microwave receiver input power limiters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Diode based power limiters for receiver modules have been designed and studied. Electrical characteristics of developed devices provide a basis for microwave receiver module improvements.

articleTitle: Two-layer circular below-cutoff waveguide application for materials and mediums permeability measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Simulation results for complex propagation constants HE11 mode in two-layer circular below-cutoff waveguides are presented. It is shown that in the off-limit frequency range the waveguides exhibit new properties. On the basis of these properties the transducers for the measuring of magnetic permeability of different materials can be developed.

articleTitle: Microwave micromodifier power mode optimization for microtechnologies
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns theoretically investigated features of spatiotemporal establishment of the temperature at the local high microwave heating of semiconductor object using a near-field micromodifier. We propose a method that partially allows withdrawing a problem of the required temperature and locality retention through by means of the combined pulsed microwave power supply of the micromodifier.

articleTitle: Application of remote sensing data for forest fires detectionwith the use of a trained thresholding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A training procedure for a threshold algorithm of temperature anomalies extraction based on fire data known to a subsatellite. Study of the proposed algorithm to detect other fires in the same photograph made with the use of infrared spectral channels of 4 microns and 11 microns of MODIS spectroradiometer. A good agreement between the results of fire detection with actual data presented in the Internet is achieved.

articleTitle: Automation of incidents' recording process in the network of the mobile radio communication of standard GSM-900/1800
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the analysis of the lacks of existing process of work with incidents in the mobile radio communication network of GSM-900/1800 standard in HP OpenView Service Desk system and it is offered to automatize process by means of HP Operations Manager system.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic characteristics of composite coating based on Z-type hexaferrite at microwave
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the results of an experimental study of the reflection coefficient of the layer composite coatings based on Z-type hexaferrite on metal. The influence of the binder on the measured characteristics is investigated. The values of the imaginary part of the complex permeability from the frequency are calculated. It is shown that the natural ferromagnetic resonance in composites is considered at frequencies above 4 GHz.

articleTitle: Dielectric permittivity of erythrocyte suspensions at 9.2 GHz
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of investigation of the second type diabetes and sugar-reducing drugs influence on the dielectric parameters of erythrocyte suspensions of patients, rabbits, rats by microwave dielectrometry at 9.2 GHz. This method is a promising method for integrated assessment of the structural changes of water properties in the interface erythrocyte-water, and can be recommended to monitor the dynamics of the erythrocytes state of patients in the course of treatment.

articleTitle: Broadband measurement of the reflective properties of natural and artificial radiomaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper describes the experimental device for measuring the electrical properties of the radio materials in a wide band of frequency. New method for processing results with the time-frequency signal filtering was obtained. The measurement results for the set-web space reflector antennas.

articleTitle: Study of the external loading influence on BWT-generator operation modes
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experimental investigation results of the backward-wave tubes with slow-wave structure (SWS) of the coupled helical resonator chain are presented. It is shown that there is a direct dependence of a spectrum of generated oscillations on reflection SWS. It is found that in resonant backward-wave tubes the generation of monochromatic oscillations with high electronic efficiency (up to 28%) is possible at low values of the beam perveance.

articleTitle: Application of a near-field compensation method for widening the microstrip antenna matching band
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The way of near field reactivity compensation for the coaxial probe exciting the circular microstrip antenna is described. The study of circular 18-mm radius microstrip antenna made of 3,14-mm thickness and permittivity of 2,2 material and matched by dielectric disk made of permittivity 5 material is provided. The X-band antenna matching results are presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of influence of periodic discontinuities on the dispersion characteristics of coupled cavities chains
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of experimental research of dispersion characteristics of a coupled cavity chain with single and periodic discontinuities are presented. The connection between the magnitude of displacement of band components dispersion characteristics of a non-uniform system relatively a uniform system dispersion and stopband width between them from the type, size and number discontinuities is established.

articleTitle: Planar ultrawideband antenna for communication and radiolocation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the results of numerical simulation and measurements of parameters of a planar antenna intended for ultrawideband communication, radiolocation, and radiotomography. The antenna can be used either as an element of ultrawideband antenna arrays or as an independent antenna. Having the dimensions of 50×40×40 mm, the antenna is well matched in the frequency band of 1.2–18 GHz. Antenna allows radiating and receiving UWB electromagnetic pulses of the duration ranging from 0.15 to 0.5 ns with small distortions. The antenna consists of FR4 printed board located in the L-shaped metal profile.

articleTitle: Autoregressive spectral algorithms of signal processing in systems of remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Classical spectral methods of assessment are among the most sustainable methods. They apply to almost all classes of signals and noise, with fixed properties. The reason of application of the parametric models of random processes is due to the possibility of receipt on the basis of these models more accurate spectral estimates than it is possible by using the classical methods of spectral estimation

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the antenna array composed of anisotropically conductive bands
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the mathematical model and numerical simulation of the antenna array composed of anisotropically conductive bands. The model uses impedance boundary conditions. The results are presented for a number of direction orientation cases for a conduction current vector of the bands.

articleTitle: Estimation of reciprocal impedance influence on adaptation rate in spatially reconfigurable antenna systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper concerns antenna-array spatial optimization as a type of signal pre-processing against the background of point-source interferences taking into account mutual coupling of antenna elements. It is shown that preprocessing with adjustment of the adaptive antenna array element spacing gives the capability to reduce considerably eigenvalue spread of spatial correlation matrix and obtain faster convergence of adaptation gradient-type algorithm.

articleTitle: “Radio over fiber” and wireless network technologies in the mobile communication
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Implementation of the proposed new technical solutions will provide delivery for 2,000 users multimedia services data signals with up to 12Mbit/s speed for each subscriber.

articleTitle: The experimental research program for investigations of natural wave spectra of the wide-format dielectric waveguides by resonant methods
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Understanding of operation principles and development of the most part of the dielectric element base (DEB) used at present for construction of an increasing number of various passive components for the millimeter wave range has begun from examination of dielectric waveguides (DWG). To date, other types of dielectric structures (DS) are included into DEB besides DWG: resonators, functional devices including multi-arm ones; antennas, radiators and feed elements; integrated circuits; diffraction devices and waveguide-beam transducers, as well as their sets - diffraction systems. Nevertheless, the new phenomena were studied earlier as phenomena in DWDs, which are typical for all of these DSs. Problems and methodology for parameter measurement in wide-format DWDs of rectangular cross-section are widened and deepened in this report. Methods, resonant settings and specific technologies of research carrying out are described.

articleTitle: Estimation of electromagnetic masking of an object on the multy-channel scattering matrix
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The new approach to the estimation of electromagnetic visibility of an object is proposed. It is based on the calculation of the multi-channel scattering matrix of the spatial domain containing the investigated object. The masking effectiveness assessment is carried out by comparing multi-channel matrices for spatial domains with the object and without it. For calculating multi-channel scattering matrix, the recompositional variant of the minimal autonomous blocks method is used.

articleTitle: VSAT network optimization based on on-board typical transponder parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The optimum operating point of a transponder traveling wave tube was obtained. The dependences of satellite capacity on the return channel for 8-PSK and 16-PSK modulation are shown. It is determined that in case of one carrier it is better to operate at the saturation point, or close to it in case for a multicarrier. Optimal values of “input back-off” traveling wave parameter for a tube (for different cases it is in 0–4 dB range) are obtained.

articleTitle: Influence of oscillation frequency on autodyne characteristics in operating range of gunn diodes
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculations results of amplitude and frequency phase angle displacement, coefficients of autodyne gain and frequency deviation are presented. The effect of frequency detuning of the oscillator from the transit frequency of the Gunn diode is shown. Calculations are based on the approximation characteristics of Gunn diodes.

articleTitle: Features of development for MIMO communication channel with unmanned vehicles
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the analysis of features of MIMO communication systems with unmanned vehicles, such as tan optimal transmission time interval of pilot symbols, the use of error-correcting coding and the influence of various factors on the throughput.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband LNA of 2–18 GHz range
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: UBB LNA based on Russian production elements is developed. The LNA block diagram is presented. The decade band quadrature direction coupler design and characteristics are presented. Achieved characteristics are at the level of foreign analogs.

articleTitle: The analysis of nonlinear spatial compensation for a complex of interferences using an optimal spatial structure
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of estimation-correlation-compensation signal processing algorithm in presence of both broadband Gaussian interferences and non-Gaussian interference is carried out. It is assumed that the processing realized by optimizing amplitude-phase distribution at the antenna array aperture, by optimizing the spatial structure of processing system, as well as by the subsequent non-linear compensation of non-Gaussian interference and by correlation processing. The analytical expression for the signal-to-noise ratio is obtained, thereby allowing making the spatial structure optimization.

articleTitle: The analysis of NbN and Nb-Si-N films structure nanocomposite
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: NbN and Nb-Si-N films are deposited by magnetron sputtering the Nb and Si targets on silicon wafers at various bias voltage, Us. The films are investigated by an atomic force microscope (AFM), X-ray diffraction (XRD) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The deposited films are annealed to establish their thermal stability. The NbN films were nanostructured, and the Nb-Si-N films had a nanocomposite structure, and represented an aggregation of δ-NbNx nanocrystallites embedded into the amorphous Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> tissue (nc-δ-NbN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>/a-Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>).

articleTitle: Redistribution of mobile traffic using the method of Wi-Fi offloading. Advantages over alternative method
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the main challenges in mobile networks. It is proposed to solve the problem of network redistribution using a combination of Wi-Fi and Femtocell technologies.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence of the yttrium aluminum composites doped with various concentrations of terbium
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The composites with various terbium concentrations are synthesized in the silicon-based porous anodic alumina by the coprecipitation method from solutions of yttrium, aluminum and terbium nitrates. The photoluminescence of these structures is investigated. It is found that the yttrium aluminum composite obtained from the solution with terbium concentration 0.1 mol.% demonstrates the most intensive photoluminescence in the green range. The terbium related photoluminescence intensity decreases with a further increase in the concentration of terbium.

articleTitle: Using clocked UWB antenna arrays for 3D imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns a small-sized portable 3D radio tomography device consisting of a non-equidistant array of planar UWB antennas, a system of generation and receiving of UWB signals, a switching unit of UWB antennas and software for tomosynthesis of radio images. The paper presents the results of experimental data confirming the efficiency of the device.

articleTitle: Magnetostatic oscillations in transversely biased long ferromagnetic cylinder of elliptical cross-section
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analytical theory describing magnetostatic oscillations in a transversely magnetized infinitely long ferromagnetic cylinder of elliptic cross-section has been developed. The implicit equation for the eigenfrequencies of modes has been derived and analyzed. An example of frequency spectrum of an elliptic cylinder with a/b=2 was presented. Magnetostatic potential of the eigenmodes in form of elementary functions has been found, that will allow obtaining simple analytical expressions for spatial distribution of the high-frequency magnetization.

articleTitle: Observation and analysis of transient luminous events in the Earth's atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents a general overview and analysis of conditions for the occurrence of transient luminous events in the atmosphere, namely, termed sprites, elves and blue jets. The main features of their appearance and manifestation are obtained. Using two video surveillances of transient luminous events obtained on the base of Institute of Geophysics, Polish Academy of Sciences, Department of Atmospheric Physics, in August 2012, we estimated the glowing atmosphere energy of these processes. The complex of observational equipment consisted of a video camera Watec 902H with different wide-angle lenses, a frame grabber Pinnacle Dazzle DVC100, a GPS receiver and a notebook with appropriate software. In order to estimate the atmosphere luminescence as from an extensive surface object the calibration curves from unfocal images of Vega (Alpha Lyrae) are plotted. The spectrum of the star, atmosphere absorption and spectral sensitivity of the camera are taken into account. For the analysis of features of the atmosphere luminescence over a storm we plotted the isophotes in the images.

articleTitle: Multibeams TWT of O-type with sheet electronic beams
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The mathematical model of a multibeam TWT with sheet electronic beams on a wavy bent rectangular waveguide with use of waves Hm0 is formulated. Features of designs and interaction of electronic beams with waves Hm0 are noted. Calculation results of multibeams TWT are resulted, it is shown, that a fourbeam TWT has rated output power of 11 W, gain of 31 dB at frequency of 559 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of beam-forming devices of hf-band transmitting circular antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the method of accurate definition of characteristics of beam-forming devices based on controlled power splitters and phase shifters by using of radiating system characteristics of circular antenna array.

articleTitle: Study of the field characteristics of multirow interdigital structure
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents an experimental study of the coupling impedance of multirow interdigital structures using the actual distribution of the longitudinal component of the electric field of transverse (basic and higher) types of waves. The estimation of the competitiveness of working and parasitic waves types of multi-row systems by changing a position of the transverse waveguide screen.

articleTitle: Dual software and hardware refocusing of satellite reflectors
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the possibility of hardware and software recovery of the reflector antenna by means of measuring the hardware system function (HSF), i.e. its response to artificial point sources. This HSF measurement detects the “disease” of the reflector system, i.e. measure deviations from the ideal parabolic shape. Usually this deviation occurs in the outer space, for example, due to thermal deformation.

articleTitle: Wave antenna diagnostics on basis of the spherical near-field scanning
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A concise description of the method of the wave diagnostic for aperture antennas and planar arrays is given. This method is based on the near-field measurements over spherical surface that covering antenna under test. The amplitude spectra of the uniform plane waves of an antenna field are defined by the amplitudes of the vector spherical waves. After that on the basis of the superposition of the uniform plane waves an aperture field or a field over antenna array elements are determined. A possibility of solving problems of measurements over an incomplete sphere is shown. The results of numerical and experimental studies are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of DOA algorithm structure on efficiency of estimation of angular coordinates
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of DOA algorithm structure on efficiency of estimation of angular coordinates is studied‥ Examples of the array antenna use with the elements arranged in parallel, and L- and 2d-L-shaped antenna arrays, are discussed. Simulation and comparative analysis results for the proposed algorithms are presented.

articleTitle: Creating a radio signal with known polarization parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We propose an algorithm for obtaining quadrature signals with known polarization parameters. The algorithm can be used for developing and testing methods for detecting and selecting radio signals, and for the statistical detection characteristics. The probability density functions of the radio signal polarization parameter (ellipticity angle for different signal-to-noise ratios) are presented.

articleTitle: Tools for information Wiki-system development and maintenance based on ontology
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the tools supporting the information system development technology based on Wiki-technology and subject domain ontology. The technology allows building Wiki-systems with a good structure and coherent system of concepts. Program facilities for maintenance of such type of systems are also suggested.

articleTitle: Implementation of multimode mode for amplitude-phase distribution synthesis on the aperture of dielectric planar radiators
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the synthesis of dielectric planar radiators field amplitude-phase distribution (APD) based on multimode rectangular dielectric waveguide proper waves and the method of required modes set realization for the synthesis of field APD described with the model of Gauss-Hermite zero order beam. The solving of the mentioned problems makes it possible to construct the radiators for diagnostics of moving objects in the near-field region with the use of a multichannel EHF radiointerferometer.

articleTitle: Some implementation features of receiving and transmitting equipment of radio-wave imaging radar station
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The receiving and transmitting unit, providing radio-wave imaging mode of high potential Ka-band radar stations, are described. The unit implements digital signal forming for transmit and received signal processing using effective receiving channels and a high-potential output amplifier at an electronic device. The realization can be considered as a platform for implementing a series of radars for various applications.

articleTitle: The element base on the basis of multi-coupled dielectric waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The general task of this report is knowledge generalization on properties and application opportunities of the unique cluster of the dielectric element base (DEB): so-called, the multi-coupled element waveguides (MCDWG), which cross-section contains the multi-coupled topology (their structure consists of several elements in the form of dielectric rods or plates). Specific tasks are research of wave phenomena and processes in MCDWG and in devices on its base; investigation of these phenomena regulations together with properties of such devices (at first place, on the example of waveguide-beam transducers - WGBT); creation of the knowledge base and construction and design principles of WGBT on MCDWG DEB. It is shown that MCDWG may be considered as the generalized millimeter-wave DEB, and developed wave devices on the basis of MCDWG (in particular, WGBT) have higher effectiveness and better qualities of formed fields than one-element ones.

articleTitle: Cordic differential model of characteristic functions of 3D teragertz FMCW radar
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The equation of a differential model such as CORDIC is obtained and parameter estimations of FMCW radar at different noise levels are experimentally confirmed. Good results are obtained when the noise level is less than 60 dB, in case of a high noise level an estimation error increases, and at very high noise levels the result is not predictable and untrue.

articleTitle: Achieving sub-Hz frequency resolution in high spectral purity and low power frequency synthesizers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper describes a method to achieve sub-Hz frequency resolution in a microwave frequency synthesizer using commercially available digital PLL components. The key feature of this method is the spectral purity and frequency resolution comparable with the solutions based on direct digital synthesizer chips. The last ones are not used in the described method that allows obtaining the substantial economy in size, cost and power consumption of the system.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillator of chaos with a nonlinear contour. experiment
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the experimental study results for the ultrawideband microwave oscillator on the chip-elements and Si-Ge transistor. To increase the efficiency modes the passive nonlinear contour is used. It is shown, that the given system forms chaotic oscillations in the given frequency band with efficiency of∼ 8 %.

articleTitle: The distribution analysis for elements in depth of nitride coating based on high-entropy Ti-Hf-V-Nb-Zr alloy
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The element-structural analysis of the nitride coatings obtained by vacuum arc evaporation from high-entropy cathodes of Ti-Hf-V-Nb-Zr was carried out. The use of complementary methods of elemental analysis (RBS, SIMS and GDMS) allowed making a comprehensive analysis of the elemental composition of the investigated coating, namely determining the elemental composition of the surface layer, identifying the uncontrolled impurities (O, C), as well as the changes in the concentration of elements with depth.

articleTitle: Soil underflooding manifestations diagnosing by radar - thermal IR aviation remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper analyzes the identification results of underflooding manifestations on vegetated soil as per consecutive day-time and night-time and multi-seasonal radar-thermal IR aviation complex ACRS-30 of remote sensing. The investigations were carried out in winter and dry autumn season conditions, when the vegetation processes in crops are mostly stopped.

articleTitle: Measurement of stepwise change point of the fast fluctuating Gaussian random process under conditions of the parametrical prior uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper we propose a technically simple way of measurement of the abrupt change of fast fluctuating Gaussian signal under conditions of parametric prior uncertainty as an example of the mathematical expectation jumping of a random process with unknown intensity. Using local Markovian approximation of the solving statistics increments the definition technique of asymptotic characteristics of change-point time estimate is illustrated. Applying statistical computer modeling, we have found that measurers synthesized on the basis of the proposed approach are operable and the theoretical formulas describing their performance well conform to the corresponding experimental data in a wide range of parameter values of the analyzed process.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic analysis of ring and disk nanoarrays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The boundary problem of diffraction electromagnetic waves on two-dimensional periodic metal gratings has been solved with taking into account finite permittivity of metal in the optic range. The suggested technique is based on approach of approximate boundary conditions for thin dielectric layers. It is pointed out that dependence of magnitude of a scattered field on wavelength has resonant behavior and resonant wavelength is many times higher than size of cell of grating. It is shown the possibility of designing of grating with high reflection coefficient at frequencies of plasmon resonance.

articleTitle: Accuracy limitation of wind speed altimetric measurements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Errors of altimetric a wind speed determination, which are caused by variability of thin topographical structure of the sea surface physically not connected with variations of a wind speed, are considered. It is shown, that in case of light and moderate wind the main contribution to an error is given by variations of energy of short surface waves, at high wind speeds it is given by uncorrelated with wind speed deviation of the distribution from the Gaussian distribution.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic characteristics of radioabsorbing two-layer glass — Al2O3 structures with a thin film of aluminum
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of research of frequency dependences of coefficients of reflection and transmission of radioabsorbing two-layer glass - Al2O3 structures with a thin film of aluminum are given. The resonance peak on the reflection characteristic with a maximum at −33 dB at a frequency of 13 GHz is found. The coefficients of absorption of electromagnetic radiation of studied two-layer structure in the range of frequencies of 6–18 GHz are calculated.

articleTitle: Precision performance study of radar-tracking and radio navigational systems of upper-air sounding
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Research problems of atmosphere parameter measurement accuracy of the radar and radio navigational upper-air sounding system (UASS) are discussed in the report. Procedures of laboratory tests and comparative launch execution are developed to carry out research. Laboratory and comparative testing of the navigational UASS with AVK, MARL-A and Vector-M radar-tracking systems are carried out. It is shown that navigational UASS have higher precision and better capability of radiosonde coordinates and velocity measurement.

articleTitle: Methods for measuring the wavelength of the flat metal-dielectric waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the study results of two developed methods for constructing meters wavelength in flat metaldielectric waveguides: the first, one detector wavelength measurement method in a flat metal-dielectric waveguide loaded with a fixed shorting device, and the second, a two-detector method for wavelength measuring in a flat metal-dielectric waveguide.

articleTitle: A novel method of radio imaging of extended objects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A novel method for obtaining of the radio images of extended objects is proposed. The method is based on the frequency dependence of the axially-symmetric Fresnel-zone plate focusing behavior. Transmitting antenna is placed on the axis of the imaging system within the non-transparent first Fresnel-zone before the axially symmetric Fresnel-zone plate lens. The receiver matrix is placed on the focal surface of the axially-symmetric lens. So the reflected signals for the various points of the object cross-section are received simultaneously in focal receiver matrix. The signals of various frequencies are used for varying the distance between the observed cross-section of the object and the receiver matrix. The example of a technical implementation of the proposed method is considered. The potential characteristics of the suggested technique are evaluated numerically.

articleTitle: Non-contact radio wave control methods for patch antennas of 3-centimetre range
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article presents results of theoretical calculation, numerical simulation and experimental research of characteristics of the symmetrical two-node triangular microstrip antenna for use in measuring equipment of 3-cm wavelength range.

articleTitle: Ontological approach in search optimization
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The strategies selection process of web-site search optimization was analyzed. The classification of SEO-techniques was presented. The problem of finding new solutions for the further development of search optimization was formulated. An approach to the problem of choosing a strategy of sites promotion through the integration of ontologies and reasoning by precedents was offered. The ontological model of knowledge representation and database precedents were built. A prototype decision support system to promote information resources was implemented.

articleTitle: LFM locator for hidden objects tomography
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The existing method for reconstruction of 3D images of scattering dissimilarities on the results of multipoint broadband radio scanning in the millimeter range using signals with linear frequency modulation is adapted for use in the presence of the dielectric obstacle. The results of numerical simulation, processing of experimental data and the reconstructed images of test objects are presented.

articleTitle: Use of DRM technology for broadcast mass notification at multiethnic regions
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the method for organizing mass and selective notification via digital broadcasting in different languages with an official status of the republics as a part of Russia

articleTitle: Design of the waveguide-distributive systems with improved radio engineering and mass-dimensional parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Methods of design and calculation of waveguides with rectangular cross section considered as extended thin-walled shell constructions which allow providing their strength and rigidity at the set of static and dynamic external influences (forces, deformations and temperatures) with improvement of mass-dimensional parameters are offered.

articleTitle: Cordic integral model of characteristic functions of 3D teragertz FMCW radar
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The equation of an integral model such as CORDIC is obtained and parameter estimations of FMCW radar at different noise levels are experimentally confirmed. Good results are obtained when the noise level is less than 55 dB, in case of a high noise level an estimation error increases, and at very high noise levels the result is not predictable and untrue. Also it allows estimating a phase of oscillation.

articleTitle: 2-mm wavelength tunable oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Gunn oscillator 2 mm range with electronic frequency tuning is presented. Application of a monolithic integrated circuit containing varicap as an element of the resonant system greatly simplifies the fabrication and setting of the generator, and also allows frequency tuning. The generator can be used to use as a standalone device or as a sub-module in the complex microwave devices, in particular, this generator is used as a local oscillator in the receiver module.

articleTitle: The capabilities of radioaltimetry system for measuring of spatial characteristics of rough water
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The abilities of information about parameters of steady-state waviness extracting from pulse altimeter signals are described. Abilities of onboard equipment allow measuring the parameters of reflected signals and making secondary processing. The parameters of fluctuating of reflected signals are evaluated during the processing, and then a period of sea wave, wave height, and water particles velocity are calculated. This information helps us to correct the measured height and velocity components.

articleTitle: Function-oriented processors for fulfillment of algorithms of real-time correlation systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Correlation is one of the most significant DSP procedures in modern correlation extreme navigation systems based on measurements of geophysical fields parameters. The main subject of this paper is an optimal implementation of correlation by means of function-oriented processors (FOP) based on 2D processor element arrays. Real FOP's based on universal microprocessors are considered as well.

articleTitle: Electrophysical properties of InSb quantum nanowires arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The investigations of the current-voltage characteristics (CVC) of InSb nanowire arrays with diameter of 40 nm and a high aspect ratio of length to diameter (∲1000) formed in the matrix of anodic alumina (AA) is given. Presented CVC's have a nonlinear view on their three parts with varying degrees of nonlinearity. The maximum current value in the nanowire arrays is up to 27 A/cm2 at voltage about 4.6 V.

articleTitle: The calculation of localization of electromagnetic hybrid waves of nonhomogeneous symmetric fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of calculation of hybrid waves in a waveguide was obtained taking into account the interaction of waves of TE and TM types in a cylindrical coordinate system. The calculation of the electric field vector for the fundamental mode, as well as for hybrid modes depending on the radial coordinate of symmetric inhomogeneous multimode fibers with different profiles of dielectric permittivity of a medium.

articleTitle: Results of using the method of successive frequency synthesis on RT-22 at 18–26 GHz
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of VLBI observations between the RT-22 (Simeiz) and RT-70 (Yevpatoriya) using the method of successive frequency synthesis at 18–26 GHz within the framework of “Radioastron” project are presented. The cross-correlation functions for five active galactic nuclei (BL Lac, 2145+067, 3C454.3, 3C84, 0528+134) and two sources in water vapor line (W3OH and ORION KL) are determined.

articleTitle: Assessment of interfering influence of the sheet of water on the surface of the mirror antenna on results of the microwave radiometric measurements of intensity of the rain
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Data on the size of an error ofmeasurement of the radio brightness temperature of a rain caused by a sheet of water on a surface of the mirror antenna for frequencies of the microwave radiometric measurements of 5.5 GHz, 7.5 GHz and 13.5 GHz are obtained. Dependences of this error on intensity of a rain are shown and itsmaximumvalues for the specified frequency ranges are defined.

articleTitle: Double-mode O-type oscillator-amplifier with inclined focusing field
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Resonant O-type oscillator-amplifier with prolonged interaction is considered. Conditions of the simultaneous excitation of the oscillations on the surface and bulk waves are implemented in this device. Theoretical analysis is performed on the basis of nonlinear multidimensional theory of the beam-wave interaction. It is shown that focusing field incline results in efficiency enhancement in the surface wave mode and bulk waves mode on the harmonics of electron beam bunching frequency.

articleTitle: Coupled electromagnetic and magnetostatic oscillations in ferrite-dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The frequency-field dependences for coupled electromagnetic and magnetostatic oscillations of the composite ferrite-dielectric resonator have been investigated theoretically by finite elements method. Effective gyromagnetic ratio vs. bias field dependences have been found for lowest types of hybrid oscillations.

articleTitle: Ceramic coaxial resonator vco with a Barium Strontium Titanate tuning element
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The comparative analysis of the experimental fluctuation characteristics is provided for two identical coaxial ceramic resonator VCOs with different types of frequency tuning elements: Barium Strontium Titanate (BST) capacitor and varicap.

articleTitle: Slow wave system double metal film comb on dielectric comb substrate in the rectangular screen
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two electrodynamical models have been obtained and the dispersion has been calculated for the slow-wave system of metallic film comb type on dielectric comb substrate in the rectangular screen. The first model is based on the method of Green's functions and integral equations. The second model is based on G.T. Markov formulas of excitation of a rectangular waveguide. The proposed electrodynamic models have been applied for calculation of dispersion.

articleTitle: Simulation model of the development of irreversible processes in film conductive structures under the influence of powerful microwave radiation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents a simulation model for the development of irreversible processes in inhomogeneous conductive films with a thickness of more than 60 microns under exposure of microwave radiation. The model considers the direct absorption of microwave power by a conductive film. Distribution of the electromagnetic field on the surface of the film and dynamics of development of thermal processes with account for the dependence of the conductivity on temperature is obtained.

articleTitle: Flexible schungite-containing electromagnetic screens based on fibrebonded fabric
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technology for creation of schungite-containing electromagnetic screens based on fibrebonded fabric was developed. The paper presents the study of reflection and transmission electromagnetic radiation coefficients' frequency dependences for 0.7–17 GHz range. Schungite-containing electromagnetic screen based on fibrebonded fabric has transmission coefficient about 10 dB and reflection coefficient within −8… −20 dB

articleTitle: Problem of the lifetime increase of wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis methods and algorithms of the lifetime increase of wireless sensor networks, in particular the energy balancing methods, are considered.

articleTitle: Heat absorption when soldering the microwave devices
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the method for determination of heat absorption when soldering the microwave devices. Heat absorption evaluation for multiple soldering the microwave devices with the leading wires of various diameters is carried out.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic radiation shields with geometrically inhomogeneous surface based on powdered perlite and titanomagnetite
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The electromagnetic radiation (EMR) reflection and transmission characteristics in the frequency range 0.7…17 GHz for shields with the surface in the form of geometric inhomogeneities (pyramids) based on powdered perlite and titanomagnetite depending on the height of these inhomogeneities are obtained. It is shown that EMR reflection and transmission coefficients values of these shields by 5…10 dB lower than similar values for shields with a flat surface, manufactured on the base of perlite and titanomagnetite mixture.

articleTitle: Estimation of spectral parameters for signals of 3D TERAGERTZ FMCW RADAR
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The process of beat signal reception at the mixer output FMCW radar is analyzed. The classical methods to obtain depth resolution and their inability to provide the specified options are considered. A model for the study of the test signal spectral estimation methods is developed. Several models have given satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Hardware-software complex of interferencing situation control and localization of electromagnetic radiation sources
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the general problems of interfering situation control at work on adjustment, calibration, measurement of parameters, tests and operation of various radio-electronic devices. The main requirements to portable monitoring systems of an interfering situation are formulated. The construction principles and testing results of the broadband directed antennas blocking range of frequencies from 20 MHz to 3GHz are stated. Development results of a hardware-software complex of interfering situation control and localization of electromagnetic radiation sources are given.

articleTitle: Ku-band nanosecond pulses receiver
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Ku-band nanosecond pulses receiver based on Russian production element base is developed. The scheme of channels construction is provided. Basic elements of its design allowing increasing sensitivity are considered, waveforms of received signals are presented, and the theoretical assessment of sensitivity is given.

articleTitle: Function-oriented processors with homogenous architecture for data flow signal processing in the space-born control systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Continuous complication of data processing algorithms for space and air vehicles results to special-purpose processor embedded on the different levels of board hardware. Their architectures and instructions sets are adopted for effective implementation of the most complicated computational algorithms. It is important for real-time digital signal and image processing when computer performance must perform about 1012 op/sec. These processors are intended for real-time data flow computation with large massive of signals or pixels and considered as a VLSI. Some problems of development of the functional-oriented processors with homogeneous architecture are discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Simulation of nanoscale structures based on carbon materials
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Nanoscale structures based on carbon materials are simulated using the developed numerical models. A functionally integrated structure combining resonant tunneling diode and field-effect transistor based on single carbon nanotube (RTD-FET) is studied. It is found that RTD-FET will have significantly different N-shaped current-voltage characteristics depending on the chirality of the used nanotube. Current-voltage characteristics of a resonant tunneling nanostructure based on graphene are also calculated.

articleTitle: Concept of remote sensing from space by new type multichannel modified zero radiometers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The new concept of microwave radiometers design for remote sensing is described. A comparative analysis of modern circuits designed for high long-time stability is shown. The new way for realization of an ideal compensative radiometer is also shown. Functional circuit of a multi-channel modified zero type radiometer is developed.

articleTitle: Marshall McLuhan as an oracle of the new era of communications
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The modern theory of communication is in process of formation. For understanding its basic principles and stages of development it is important to study the work of a Canadian philosopher and culture expert Herbert Marshall McLuhan (1911 – 1980), who is one of the theorists in the field of mass communication. He became one of the prophets of the era of information technology. McLuhan»s famous phrases «medium is the message» and «global village» («global village» - about the modern world) have become a well-established cliché.

articleTitle: Development of simulation model of the taxi and analysis of the modeling results
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of modeling which were obtained by means of the simulation model of the taxi configured for an average local carrier. There is a description of the executed experiment and explanation of the obtained data results.

articleTitle: Simulation of the influence of impact ionization process on the current noise in deep submicron silicon diode
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Ensemble Monte Carlo simulation has been used to simulate charge carrier transport in the deep submicron silicon diode with n+-n-n+ structure. The influence of impact ionization process on static current-voltage characteristics as well as current noise has been studied.

articleTitle: Analysis of intrapulse fluctuations of the phase difference from the experimental data
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the results of analysis of intrapulse spatiotemporal fluctuations of the phase difference of signals that occur within a short radar pulse. Analysis was conducted on the basis of physical experiment in the three-centimeter wavelength range on surface roads.

articleTitle: Cavity resonators in the form of paraboloid of revolution
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the cavity resonators with a shape of paraboloids of revolution. Comparison of oscillation modes in cylindrical cavities with cavities in the form of paraboloids of revolution is carried out. The possibility of a similar classification parabolic cavities in the lower types of oscillations is demonstrated. Approaches to the numerical calculations of the electrodynamic characteristics of such resonators are determined. Application areas of cavities in the form of paraboloids of revolution are considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of differential entropy at two-parameter technical measurements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The questions of improving the accuracy of measuring equipment are considered. The present paper concerns the theorem on the maximum of differential entropy of the two-dimensional random variable bounded finite limits with its defined mathematical expectation, variance and correlation moments.

articleTitle: Generation of powerful THz radiation by electron beams and its interaction with plasma and gases
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main results of the IAP RAS activity at the powerful pulse THz gyrotrons are presented. The power about 200 kW at the frequency of 0.67 THz in single impulses with durations of 30 microseconds has been reached. This gyrotron is successfully used to initiate localized (characteristic size in the order about 1 mm) discharge in gases. The models describing the dynamics of discharge initiated by THz radiation are under development. New experimental facility for long pulse or CW gyrotrons in frequency band 0.28–0.52 THz has been build based on helium-free 10 T cryomagnet.

articleTitle: Hybrid metal-dielectric structure based on inverted dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The hybrid metal-dielectric structure based on an inverted waveguide is investigated. The auxiliary dielectric resonators with metalized side are put into a waveguide. The basic characteristics such as VSWR versus frequency, and pattern characteristics are studied using the finite element method. The ability of a suitable level of pattern characteristics has been shown.

articleTitle: Systems networks IP/MPLS monitoring model using NetFlow protocol
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The monitoring of network operation, data collection, processing and reporting about the service quality for users in a suitable form for decision-making, is one of the main problems in a process of this problem's solving. At the same time, the additional loading of service traffic, packets delay with a considerable number of errors can lead to network bandwidth decrease. The present paper proposes an analytical model which allows estimating the monitoring system probability-time parameters on the basis of NetFlow.

articleTitle: Reflectometry dyagnostics of diffuse inhomogeneities in multilayer periodic structures
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new approach in frameworks of the dual regularization method is proposed in the solution of the reflectometry inverse problem to retrieve profiles of diffuse inhomogeneities in multilayer periodic epitaxy nanostructures by multifrequency measurements of power reflection coefficient. To compensate the absence of phase information in input data, the a priori information about the belonging of the desired solution to a compact set of functions is involved in the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Physical properties of integral inductance of strip MEMS - A coil at SHF
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Physical properties of the classic method of analysis for strip MEMS - coils are discussed. In calculation the scale of inductance has been assigned and canonical relations for calculation of inductance and flux linkage have been obtained. From relations the feasibility of two classes of inductances with the small (in comparison with the scale) flux and great one follows. It is shown that under a fixed number of turns and cross-section square that coil has more inductance at less volume, whose axial width of the strip is less. The evaluation of inductance of MEMS - coil, which satisfactorily coincides with observable one, is adduced at SHF up to cutoff frequency.

articleTitle: Autodyne system for speed measurement of products with near ground surface trajectory
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A description of an operating principle and a system arrangement intended for measuring of the velocity of products at their ballistic tests with a flat trajectory is given. The system is based on two autodyne radio block devices providing remote and noncontact measurement of the product flyby timepoint. The system also includes a signal processing unit and ballistic chronometer. Measurement error depends on the test conditions and may be about 0.5%.

articleTitle: Modulated signal processing in a Doppler direction finder
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of a Doppler direction finder (DPF) in signal processing with complicated modulation is carried out. The main features of the signal processing in the direction finder are presented, recommendations on operation optimization of the Doppler finder for increasing the s/n ratio are given, a model of DPF in LabVIEW software environment is developed. Assessment of the obtained theoretical studies with study results for a direction finder model.

articleTitle: The electromagnetic screen-restructor
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: To protect personnel and other institutions from the low-intensity electromagnetic fields the fractal electromagnetic screen-restructor, containing a substrate of bioinert material and installation tool — the electromagnetic circuit — in the form of the fractal figures with the flat element in a center, was developed.

articleTitle: Genetic-algorithm-based structural synthesis of microwave transistor amplifiers using S-parameter data sets of passive elements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A modified genetic-algorithm-based approach for structural synthesis of linear and low-noise microwave amplifies using passive elements models in the form of S-parameter data sets is presented.
