This approach is implemented in Geneamp software tool. An example of synthesis of 1–2 GHz one- and two-stage LNAs on PCB demonstrates the efficiency of the approach.

articleTitle: Signal and noise characteristics of autodynes in solving problems of gas-turbine engine vibration-based diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A mathematical model of autodyne turbine engine vibration sensors was developed. Oscillator power supply noises were taken into account. The analysis of autodyne and noise characteristics was carried out. The main requirements to the choice of the operation point and to the level of reflected radiation for various characteristics were formulated. The results of experimental research were obtained on the example of “Tigel'-08” autodyne oscillator for 8-mm wave band. Obtained results confirmed the conclusions of theoretical studies.

articleTitle: Features of ammonia and plasma assisted MBE growth for development and production of III-nitrides based heterostructures for advanced nanoelectronics
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of use of STE3N MBE System for growth of GaN nanoheterostructures by both types of MBE (using plasma activation of nitrogen and ammonia) are presented. It is shown that the use of high-temperature AlN/AlGaN buffer layers grown using ammonia at extremely high temperatures (up to 1150°C) allows improving drastically the structural quality of the GaN layers and reducing the dislocation density down to 9·108–1·109 cm−2. On the other hand, unlike the ammonia MBE, which is difficult to use at T <5000C (because of low decomposition efficiency of ammonia), PA-MBE is very effective at low temperatures, for example for growth of InAlN layers lattice-matched to GaN. The results of the growth of high quality GaN/InAlN heterostructures using both PA-MBE and NH3-MBE (at extremely high ammonia flux) are shown. The use of SemiTEq equipment in Svetlana-Rost JSC for high power microwave FETs based on GaN is demonstrated.

articleTitle: The measurement method of a parabolic reflector antenna profile by a near-field region
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The measurement method of the parabolic reflector antenna surface profile by the near-field region in the Cartesian coordinate system by a planar scanner is presented. This method allows investigating the stationary large reflector antennas by a scanner, the dimensions of which are less than the aperture of the antenna under study.

articleTitle: Structural data on distributed transaction with direct access to telecommunication servers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the informational and structural elements of building integrated systems for the implementation of the enterprises with a high degree of data distribution, which requires sharing. The considered block diagram of the transaction sequence of application provides support for the joint processing of the information without the local reorganization of the database schema.

articleTitle: Structural features of ZnOxS1−x nanostructured films
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, ZnOxS1−x nanostructured layers were obtained by chemical bath deposition from solutions of zinc acetate, ammonia and thiourea. Structural features of ZnOxS1−x films were studied by scanning electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction. The effect of condensation time on the elemental and phase composition of the thin layers, as well as their structural characteristics, such as lattice constants and growth texture, were found.

articleTitle: Study of probability distribution of user access node traffic
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the study of the distribution of time intervals between packets of inbound and outbound user access. The quantitative estimations of obtained distributions are given and the possibility of using the results for the calculation of the modern telecommunication networks is described.

articleTitle: Structural and luminescent properties of terbium doped strontium titanate xerogel
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We report on synthesis and photoluminescence of sol-gel derived terbium doped strontium titanate on monocrystalline silicon and in the porous anodic alumina matrix. The microstructure and morphology of the samples are analyzed by X-ray diffraction and scanning electron microscope analyses. The thickness of the spin-on films deposited on silicon is about 115 and 170 nm due to the annealing temperature 750 and 1000 °C respectively. The samples reveal terbium luminescence in the visible range.

articleTitle: Determination algorithm of underlying surfaces border position by pulse altimeter signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The determination algorithm of underlying surfaces by pulse altimeter signals is described. The algorithm basis is the principle of comparison of reference standard distributions with a current posteriori distribution of a reflected signal's echo amplitude. As the result of comparison of statistical distributions a posteriori evaluation of correct discrimination is formed. The maximum of a posteriori probability has its own minimum in case of detected crossing of underlying surfaces border. It allows forming the evaluation of underlying surfaces border position.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic analysis of composite materials containing multi-scale conductive inclusions
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method for calculation of effective electrodynamic parameters of composite materials composed of a mixture of wire chiral particles with different electric length is proposed. The task of microwave range electromagnetic wave interaction with a flat layer of a composite is solved for the case of a composite material, composed of a mixture of multi-scale single-coil helices. The possibility to control selective properties of a composite layer by using multi-component mixture of conducting particles is shown.

articleTitle: Estimation of efficiency of PAA application to reducing of lower boundary of sounding with rass
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns possibility to swing beams of the transmitting and receiving radio antennas of bistatic systems for atmosphere radio acoustic sounding at the acoustic sounding pulse tracking at its movement over the path. The paper presents the ways of solving the diffraction problem for defining the corrective functions when measuring temperature and speed of wind at the lower part of the sounding path with a considerable slope of beams. It is shown that the modern elemental base makes the technical realization of the RASS systems with economically justified PAA.

articleTitle: Using of partially filled rectangular waveguide for leaky-wave antenna design
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A leaky-wave antenna based on a rectangular waveguide with partially dielectric filling and transverse slots is studied. The complex propagation constant is determined from a transcendental equation by matching of magnetic fields inside and outside the waveguide in a slot plane. Velocity factor dependences on the waveguide filling parameters are presented. The influence of the dielectric position in the waveguide on the antenna characteristics is considered. The radiation pattern is analyzed.

articleTitle: Electron beam focusing in a dynamic mode and a new technique of PPM tuning
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new technique of PPM tuning is proposed, it is based on measurements of the magnetic field outside of a sealed-off tube, comparing data with calculated ones and magnets adjusting. Accuracy of magnetic field adjustment achieves 1.6%.

articleTitle: Verification of the modified method of extending a valid region for far-field pattern reconstruction in planar near-field measurements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents a concise description of Gerchberg-Papoulis algorithm for the extension of the valid region of the calculated far-field pattern in planar near-field measurements. The results of the algorithm verification for numerical test and experimental data are also shown.

articleTitle: The adaptive antenna array for jam-resistant reception of satellite navigation system signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns in-band interference level reduction by means of a spatial adaptive filtering algorithm. The results of measurements standard deviation phase of navigation signals in noise conditions using adaptation algorithm are presented.

articleTitle: Illumination antennas for radio-vision systems of the 3-mm wavelength range
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Numerical and experimental studies of several types of 3-mm wavelength illumination antennas were carried out. The illumination antennas are intended for use in an active radio-vision system disposed in the near-field scattering region of objects. An efficient and constructive-simple leaky wave antenna was designed. The antenna is constructed on the basis of the standard rectangular waveguide with 2.4×1.2-mm cross-section.

articleTitle: Development of decision support methods repository as service-oriented scientific environment
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents an approach to the development of the repository of decision support methods in the form of a service-oriented scientific environment. The advantages of such environments are discussed and modern facilities for their construction are considered.

articleTitle: Axial discontinuity influence on Q-factor of the lamellar dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It has been shown that increasing the air gap between disks of the lamellar dielectric resonator (LDR) with whispering gallery modes increases the frequency of the resonator on the selected mode of oscillation and also can increase its Q-factor compared with Q-factor of a solid resonator.

articleTitle: Air digital TV in the frequency range of 10,15–10,3 GHz
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the equipment for transmission of TV signals in the frequency range of 10.15–10.3 GHz. There is information about equipment for these purposes produced by “Beta TV com”, Ltd in this article.

articleTitle: Eigen frequencies of cylindrical structures with a plasma sheet
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The dispersion equations that describe eigen modes of the semiconductor and dielectric cylinders with a plasma sheet on a lateral surface are obtained. The dispersion dependences of eigen slow waves in such system based on analytical and numerical approaches are obtained. The structures both with a plasma sheet and without it, for which eigen frequencies are in the terahertz range, are studied. The comparison of frequency spectrums of eigen modes of studied systems is made. The influence of a surface plasma sheet with a thickness of atomic size on the eigen frequencies of the semiconductor and dielectric cylinders with modes of identical field distributions is studied.

articleTitle: The optoelectronic microwave oscillator based on an optical disk microresonator
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Topology optimization of the low phase noise optoelectronic microwave oscillators based on whispering gallery mode disk resonators has been considered. The development of a hybrid integrated circuit on its basis has been suggested.

articleTitle: Resonant scattering of the centimeter range radio waves in the presence of the long sea waves
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The effects of the resonance scattering of centimeter range radio waves due to changes in long wave slopes of the sea surface are analyzed. We obtained estimates of the energy impact of wavelengths, as well as distribution deviations of sea surface slopes from Gaussian distribution. It has been shown that the presence of long wavelength may result in increase of the effective backscatter cross section of 50% with a horizontal polarization and 35% in the vertical polarization.

articleTitle: Towards a mass technology of building intelligent scientific internet resources
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper discusses fundamentals of a mass technology of building intelligent scientific Internet resource (ISIR) providing the systematization and integration of scientific knowledge and information resources related to a certain subject domain, as well as the content-based access to them. The main features of this technology are orientation to experts, i.e. specialists in certain subject domain, and usage of an ontology-based approach.

articleTitle: Effective permeability of nanoscale particle of W-type hexaferrite
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the paper there has been conducted the calculation of effective permeability of a nanoscale particle of W-type hexaferrite by alteration of added Zn ions from 0.8 to 2. It has been shown, that increasing of permeability of solid material leads to increasing of a surface portion into the main volume of the particle. The results that have been obtained by us justify the necessary correction of the relationship theory of composite mixtures when manufacturing the composite materials based on nanoscale powders.

articleTitle: Jamming level dependence on the wind speed over the sea surface during coherent radar operation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Physical mechanisms of jamming appearing during coherent radars' operation are analyzed. The dependence of the jamming level on the wind speed is structured. It is shown that power reflected from the sea surface in the direction of the target signal with increasing wind speed decreases rapidly. It is shown that the non-linear effects in the field of sea waves which lead to deviations in inclination distribution from Gausse distribution do not influence the change of jamming level with the wind force increase.

articleTitle: Planar detector with a distributed Schottky diode
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns a problem solution of current flowing through the channel of a distributed Schottky diode included in the detector circuit. Impedance of a diode as a main linear characteristic of an element is calculated. Volt-watt and ampere-watt sensitivities, as the main characteristics of the detector, are determined.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic scattering of drops at 2 wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of peculiarities of electromagnetic scattering of spherical raindrops was performed by using double-frequency sounding method. The optimal combination of operating wavelengths was found due to the uniqueness of rain intensity measurements of the differential radar cross section. The expressions are obtained for the system of inequalities, which exclude ambiguity of measurements.

articleTitle: Automated experimental setup for measuring of the characteristics of microwave electrovacuum devices of orotron — GDR type
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experimental installation for automatized measurement of characteristics in the vacuum generators of microwave frequencies with open resonators is described. The unit efficiency was tested by comparison of experimental results obtained in automatic and manual modes of measurements in the model of generators for the four millimeter range of wavelengths.

articleTitle: Tunable waveguide-dielectric resonator for the millimeter band with increased Q-factor
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Possibility of the essential increase of the eigen Q-factor of the waveguide-dielectric resonator (WDR) on the fundamental asymmetrical mode of the magnetic type for the frequency tuning with help of resonance short-circuit plunger has been shown. For the WDR on the basis of a circular evanescent waveguide section with Teflon dielectric in 8-mm band the Q-factor of the resonator exceeding 2400 was obtained for all turn frequency band which is about 10%.

articleTitle: Shielding effectiveness measurement of coaxial radio-frequency connectors and adapters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: To measure the shielding effectiveness a method is proposed and an experimental laboratory-scale plant is created. It allows making measurements in a frequency band determined by an operation mode of lead rectangular waveguides on the principal wave type. The experimental plant is a volumetric resonator with a smoothly varying cross-section formed by two identical broadband pyramidal horns joined by opened sides.

articleTitle: The antenna with frequency scanning based on logoperiodic structure
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method for constructing a linear polarization antenna with frequency scanning fulfilled on the basis of the logperiodic structure is proposed. Numerical simulations show that the proposed antenna can be fit with the feeder in a wide frequency band, and the shape of its pattern varies slightly with varying frequency.

articleTitle: Features of development of the degradation processes in the nanometer film structures under the influence of high-power electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the peculiarities of the development of the degradation processes in the nanometer film structures under the influence of high-power electromagnetic fields. We obtained the values of thickness of the conductive films, in which a process of transformation of energy of electromagnetic radiation into the acoustic wave takes place.

articleTitle: X-band microstrip antenna with 45% bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results on the design of a broadband microstrip antenna are presented. This antenna provides high gain in the frequency band of 8 – 12 GHz. A feature of this configuration is the use of short-segment rectangular waveguide as an integral part of the antenna.

articleTitle: Intelligence diagnosis system of pathological process with redundant training matrix
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of infection diseases diagnosing is considered within the bounds of information-extreme intelligence technology, which is based on maximization of informational capability of a decision support system in the study process by means of sequential optimization of the redundant binary training matrix. Implementation of the proposed algorithm was done for GRID-center of acute enteric infection diagnosing.

articleTitle: Application of ant algorithms as a basis for the creation of an intelligent system for solving problems of transport logistics
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a basic ant algorithm as a theoretical basis for building intelligent systems in transport logistics. The efficiency of the use of this algorithm is studied in accordance with the requirement of a large number of nodes in the transport network. A comparative analysis of a small implementation of this algorithm in different types of programming languages is also conducted. The high efficiency of the algorithm and the capabilities of modern multiprocessor computers allow constructing the vehicle optimal route calculation systems operating in real time.

articleTitle: Shielding characteristics of fiber organic water-containing materials under exposure of elevated temperature
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The frequency dependence of the attenuation and reflection of electromagnetic radiation of wet fibrous materials based on organic structures in the range of 8 – 12 GHz has been investigated. The possibility of extending the temperature range of operation of the testmaterials to 180 °C withminimal loss of the liquid component andmaintaining high shielding performance was considered. Practical recommendations for the creation of shielding structures to protect objects fromstray electromagnetic radiation are proposed.

articleTitle: Passive ultra wideband reflectivity array for radiotomography
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the design of a controlled impedance reflector as a passive element array antenna for radio imaging problem. The numerical simulation at the test object in the form of two point scatterers and an array of 64 elements showed the possibility of recovery of the radio images with resolution better than 3 cm by using UWB pulses with 0.2-ns duration.

articleTitle: The integral model of the second type characteristic functions of 3D teragertz FMCW radar
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the obtained equation of the second type of an integral model and experimentally confirmed parameter estimation of FMCW radar oscillations at different levels of noise. Good results are obtained under the condition of significant noise. When the noise level is less than 35dB, unessential errors are observed. Frequency estimation has an additive repeatable error.

articleTitle: The ultra wideband spin-wave chaos generator of middle power based on field-effect transistors
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The prototype of an ultra wideband (UWB) chaos generator of a microwave range is developed. This generator contains a nonlinear spin-wave transmission line, a multistage transistor amplifier with an output amplifier based on FET transistor and a microstrip pass-band filter. It is shown that in autonomous mode a UWB chaotic signal with central frequency of 3 GHz has an integral power level about 4 W in the frequency band that is greater than 30%. Such chaos generator has a high value of efficiency about 20%.

articleTitle: IP-core for real-time navigation data processing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analysis of algorithms of the orientation for high maneuvering vehicle objects shows that fast computations of scalar products with guaranteed errors is one of the most important procedures. So embedded special-purpose or functional-oriented processors (FOP) are required for real-time computations. Above all the FOP's processor core structure must be adopted for fast scalar products computations. IP core for hardware support of an efficient scalar product is proposed in the paper. This core consists of 64-bit ALU, multiplier (64 bit also) and a four-port register file. The comparison of architectural performance between a proposed core and some modern microprocessor architectures is represented.

articleTitle: The interdigital electrode system for detection of monolayer electrical capacity of line C6 glioma cells
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Layered nanoheterostructures of nanoporous anodic aluminum oxide / metal-polymer coordination compound / clusters of few-walled carboxylated carbon nanotubes type are proposed. Their biosensibility and biocompatibility are shown. ECIS-impedance sensor coated with such nanoheterostructures operates on quantum effects of the spontaneous polarization and the quantization of the Maxwell-Wagner polarization and detects structural organization and intercellular communication in the cell monolayer of C6 rat glioma.

articleTitle: Study of methods for increasing the accuracy of FM radar systems measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns a digital method of heterodyne signal processing for linear-frequency modulated signals, with computation by means of Hilbert transforms. Methods are urgent for solving such problems where the signal transmission time is short, and the propagation medium can be considered as linear. The numerical comparison of the proposed algorithm and the method of computation using Furrier transform is carried out. The scheme for the developed algorithm implementation is proposed.

articleTitle: Plagiarism in scientific works: Reasons and what is to be done
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main reasons for the low efficiency of the fight against plagiarism are identified. Proposals to increase the efficiency in identifying plagiarism in scientific papers are presented.

articleTitle: Mobile robot with remote information processing
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In general, Mobile robots are not able to have a powerful CPU on board, the requirements to the size and weight of a mobile robot do not allow this option. One possible solution of this problem is to transfer video over a wireless communication to a remote computer for further processing computer vision algorithms being used to fulfil the task.

articleTitle: Model of height-temporal variations of the electron density in the undisturbed midlatitude D-region of the ionosphere
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of long-term systematic experimental studies near Kharkov and episodic purposeful observation near Volgograd using the method of partial reflections there were analyzed the main features and modeled height-time distribution of the electron density in the undisturbed midlatitude D-region of the ionosphere.

articleTitle: Accounting of spatial correlation of troposphere refraction index for calculation of coherent component of stochastic electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The aim of the paper is improving the accuracy of calculation of the coherent component of the stochastic electromagnetic field by the numerical solution of the wave parabolic equation. Using the method of geometrical optics, we remove the limitation on the delta-correlated inhomogeneities (Markov approximation). There are tested three models of medium inhomogeneities: Booker-Gordon, Gaussian and Kolmogorov-Obukhov. Estimates of a mean field obtained for each of models were compared with the results obtained in the Markov approximation.

articleTitle: Oscillators of klystron type on one- and double-gap cavities
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns mathematical simulation and experimental study of possibilities of simple design SHF oscillators based on a monothrone and double-gap cavities. Possibility of creation of 30...40% efficiency generators of one-cavity design and 50...60% efficiency generators based on double-cavity generating-amplifying klystrons (GAK) is shown.

articleTitle: Gyroklystron as a frequency multiplier
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of calculation of three-stage gyroklystron — frequency doubler. It is shown, that at 95-GHz output frequency of the gyroklystron, 126.5-kV beam voltage, 29.5 A current, and a correct choice of the resonator Q, their detuning from the operating frequency and lengths of resonators and drift tubes, it is possible to achieve 45% efficiency of the device at a gain of 40 dB and amplification band 95 MHz.

articleTitle: Modeling of the energy flux density in a circular waveguide with a layer of metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the results of the simulation component of the Poynting vector of the main mode of a three-layer-round waveguide. The middle layer is a LHM (Left-Handed-Medium) metamaterial with a negative refractive index. In a waveguide with LHM layer inversion of the radial component of the Poynting vector is observed.

articleTitle: Magnetic induction introscopy using the scanning matrix of induction coils
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An installation for visualization of objects using conductive magnetic induction measurements by the matrix of flat spiral coils is designed. The coils are installed in a matrix of 4 rows, each row shift allows increasing density measurements in case of a linear scan. The results of experimental studies of visualization of different metal objects are presented.

articleTitle: Re-adjusting disk microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A complicated design of a disk microstrip antenna with ability of changing of energy characteristics is discussed. The readjusting effect is carried out by the radial slots' orientation changing in the basic and additional microstrip resonators.

articleTitle: Dynamics of development of thermal processes in semiconductor structures at the local effects of microwave radiation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the basic principles of the model of local effects of microwave radiation in semiconductor structures. The validity of the proposed model is based on the method of finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) is shown. The influence of radius of a spherical probe on the distribution and values of the field intensity in the axis of semiconductor structures is determined. Dynamics of development of thermal processes in the local region of semiconductor structures in a continuous mode with relation to electrophysical parameters on temperature are obtained.

articleTitle: The use of nanocarbon materials for development of biofuel elements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the activity of the microbic biofuel element which oxidizes ethanol. The intact bacterial cells of Gluconobacter oxydans or their membrane fractions were used as a bioelectrocatalyst. Thermoexpanded graphite (TEG) was used as a material of an electrode. The used strain of bacterial cells, as well as carbon composition types will make a basis of a prototype of a microbic biofuel element at development of the block of transformation and accumulation of electric energy.

articleTitle: The broadband phase radio direction finder for coordinate determination of radiation sources of harmonic signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the circuit implementation of a phase radio direction finder for coordinate determination of radiation sources with harmonic signals. The use of sparse linear antenna arrays and radiation source are examined. The feature of this radio direction finder is an ability to operate in the frequency band. The basic relations for the direction-finding characteristics, which allow providing the operation of the radio direction finder in the frequency range using measured wavelength and implementation of the demodulation unit on broadband quadrature bridges

articleTitle: Modeling of selective microwave devices on circular waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The common approach to waveguide filters synthesis is considered. The technique of initial approximation finding on the basis of preliminary calculated S-parameters of single irregularity is proposed. This initial approximation is used for devices optimization. The resonant cavities formed by circular waveguides with radial ridges are used as basic elements.

articleTitle: Development of small-size pass-band filters (PBF) based on magnetostatic spin waves (MSW) in decimeter and centimeter frequency band with mechanical frequency tuning
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The summary represents the development results of the small-size magnetostatic spin waves-based PBF devices with mechanical frequency tuning in a range from 1.0 to 14.0 GHz. A dependence of a maximum turning value has been studied according to an operating frequency band and a design of a magnetic system (MS) of a filter. Magnetic systems (MS) have been developed, which allowed changing a gap of MS more than twice with one adjustment screw. Based on this type of MS PBFs are created with mechanical frequency tuning not less than 1000MHz. Experimental researching showed parameters stability of PBF (minimal losses, pass band, out of band barrier value, etc) under mechanical frequency tuning including −50 to 70 °C range.

articleTitle: The testing polygon of the Black Sea Higher Naval Institute named after P. S. Nakhimov: History of development and application prospects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Provided the history in brief concerning the development of the testing polygon of The Black Sea Higher Naval Institute named after P.S. Nakhimov, where some radar signature studies of the ships took place. Calculation possibilities for the ship physical field characteristics are compared with their measuring possibilities. It is supposed to change a composition of the characteristics to be measured and increase a number of the polygon users as well as create a reference ship of physical fields.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of agents interacting standards
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article provides a comparative analysis of architectures agents. The following architectures are considered: deliberative, reactive and hybrid. Each architecture can be used in different models and in different subject areas. Choice of architecture agents directly affects the results of the model area and the adequacy of the data results.

articleTitle: Generation of noise by a quantum wire
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Development of the relaxation instability arising in a contact area of a quantum wire if current density exceed a boundary value is investigated. It is shown that instability can be a source of noise fluctuations of voltage. Parameters of the noise caused by relaxation instability are calculated.

articleTitle: Optimal estimation of signal source angular coordinates by using a few-element antenna array with optimal spatial structure
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of determining the angular coordinate of the signal source under spatially correlated interference action is being solved. The algorithm of optimal estimation of the angular coordinate is obtained for deterministic signals, quasideterministic signals and Gaussian random signals. Estimation error is defined by using Cramer-Rao bounds for the given signal-interference situation. The influence of the spatial structure of the antenna array on the estimation error is studied.

articleTitle: On the problem of periodization of the national telecommunication complex history
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a new vision of the periodization of the development of electro-communications, formation of the telecommunications industry of the USSR. On the basis of the age of the public significance of information communications, the authors emphasize the 4 stages of transformation of funding of operational data from an instrument of public control and to mobilize a critical service to the population, the service sector of the economy.

articleTitle: Mis-structures with nanoscale dielectric films of the rare-earth metal-alloyed silicon nitride
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: One of the main problems of electronics of MIS-devices - increasing stability of their features is considered. This problem solution is achieved by the surface-state density reduction using the rare-earth metal-alloyed silicon nitride films as a tunnel and barrier layer, and nanoclusters of SiGe solid solution and Ge as a storage medium. A CV-study is made of electrophysical parameters of MIS-structures of Me-Si3N4 (rare-earth metals) - nanoclusters of Ge(SiGe)-Si3N4 (rare-earth metals) -nSi, in which the rare-earth elements with different atomic radius are used as alloying components. The regularity of influence of the rare-earth metal radius values on electrophysical characteristics of MIS-structures is established.

articleTitle: The using of aquifers for the normalization of data in UWB geolocation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the results of a natural experiment on the use of GPR for probing and imaging of aquifers. GPR “OKO-2” was used for the studying of soil. The basic processing steps and the results are shown. The proposed technique in the processing of radar tracks showed that the presence of underground aquifers can help to restore the real terrain relief without using special vertical positioning.

articleTitle: The effect of large mesospheric electric fields on the terrestrial lower ionospheric structure
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Based on observations of electrically active mesosphere characteristics, the effects of large mesospheric electric fields on the terrestrial D region height structure have been modeled. The large mesospheric electric field strengths exceeding 2 V/m are shown to result in forming a local minimum in the height profile of atmospheric conductivity between 60- and 70-km altitudes.

articleTitle: Scattering H10 wave on diaphragme with gyromagnetic medium in rectangulary waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns a new approach for the solution of a problem of diffraction of waveguide waves on a diaphragm of final thickness with a gyromagnetic medium. At the first stage the method of the Fourier gains an infinite system of the linear equations concerning two sequences of unknown field-form factors in the ferrite resonator. At the second stage an interpolation formula of Lagrange is applied to its solution with a special view of base function that allows essentially simplifying the initial system of the equations which can be solved analytically in the closed view for integral values of the relation of random widths of a waveguide to width of a diaphragm at any material parameters of a gyrotropic medium. In a limiting case of full filling with the gyromagnetic medium the solution passes in the known one.

articleTitle: Specificity of inaccuracy of indirect measurements of capacitance-voltage characteristics by means of ultra-short pulse method
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of the inaccuracy of indirect measurements of capacitance-voltage characteristics (CVC) at an ultra-short pulse impact for known inaccuracy of direct measurements of voltage applied to an element and current through the element was carried out. The dependence of inaccuracy of CVC measurement from active current through the element is shown. On the example of a Schottky diode for its use in a pulsed mode we have shown that the methodical inaccuracy of CVC measurement on a harmonic signal exceeds the instrumental inaccuracy of CVC measurement at the ultra-short pulse impact.

articleTitle: Gyro-TWT at slowed-down E0i-mode
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The gyro-TWT at slowed-down E0i mode at corrugated waveguide characteristics is investigated. Possibility of achievement of efficiency of 30% is shown at the coefficient of amplification 15 dB.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of the effective permittivity of a perforated dielectric layer
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The effective permittivity of a planar dielectric layer with cylindrical holes arranged in a hexagonal lattice is determined by a hybrid projective method with using the concept of a layer of half-wavelength thickness. Some results obtained for different values of the layer material permittivity, hole spacing, hole diameter, angle of incidence of the wave and polarization of the latter are presented.

articleTitle: Formation of superhard multilayer microand nanostructured Ti-Hf-Si-N/NbN/Al2O3 coating with high mechanical and tribological properties
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new variant of multilayered Ti-Hf-Si-N/NbN/Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> coatings were developed. Coatings were prepared by several deposition techniques such as plasma-detonation and vacuum-arc deposition using evaporation of the cathode. Nanocomposite coatings have a size of nanograins from 14-17 nm to 28-53 micron, high hardness from 21 to 56 GPa. The main advantage of such nano-and microstructure coating is a low coefficient of friction. Additionally the formation in the aluminum oxide and in the steel surface layer of transition zone with the formation of nanoscale phase and high value of hardness was detected.

articleTitle: The software emulator of navigation receiver for the test equipment of GNSS simulators
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article presents an algorithm of estimating the coordinates of navigation field consumers in the presence of a priori information on the short time interval. The algorithm is designed to analyze the quality of the navigation field produced by signal imitators. The algorithm based on a numerical method for calculating the average values in the nonlinear transformation. The modeling and the results of research are performed

articleTitle: Improvement of assembly accuracy and strength of waveguide-distributive systems of communication spacecrafts
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the theoretical maintenance problems of assembly technology by means of soldering from separate elements of waveguide and distributive spacecraft systems to minimize the technological errors at the production stage to provide conditions of local and global durability in any point; settlement problems of possibility of a flexible section's exclusion, and also improvement of their functional and operational characteristics.

articleTitle: Study of brain and open heart thermograms
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The qualitative comparative analysis of myocardium heat field was carried out using thermograph in the spectral range of 8 – 14 microns. There was made the quantitative assessment of head and myocardium temperature measurement accuracy which depends upon the ambient temperature. Based on the proposed approach to the analysis of head and myocardium thermograms, we carried out the study of thermo-abnormal areas on the surface of the objects, which shows clearly the distribution of the internal temperature and the levels of the microcirculation in the myocardium and vessels.

articleTitle: Doppler motion sensors adaptation for measuring quadratures of reflected signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A transmit-receive system is suggested based on a pair of Doppler motion sensors with differing frequencies and providing measurement of I/Q components of received signals by hardware tools. Simultaneously, suppression of amplitude noise is observed in the system. Noise suppression from 15 to 18 dB in comparison with a single sensor is experimentally achieved in a system of 24-GHz sensors.

articleTitle: Synthesis of equival ent circuits for embedded RLC-components based-on LTCC
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the synthesis of equivalent circuits with lumped passive elements such as resistance (R), inductance (L) and capacitance (C) formed in integration technology of the substrate body LTCC.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of near-field microwave tomography of subsurface dielectric inhomogeneities
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Method of multifrequency microwave tomography and holography of subsurface dielectric inhomogeneities in the near-field zone based on the solution of inverse scattering problem is studied in numerical simulation with input data calculated from Maxwell equations.

articleTitle: The multilayer integrated circuit of bandpass filter design based-on macromodels and equivalent circuits for RLC-elements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the creation of RLC equivalent circuit elements based on rational functions for Butterworth bandpass filter. The modeling filter built on empirical models, macromodels and equivalent circuits are carried out. S21 characteristics are obtained for the three variations of the bandpass filter.

articleTitle: Implementation features of pass type Ka-band wide-angle scanning phased array antennas
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The development results of the pass-type wide-angle electrical scanning based on integrated elements with Faraday phase shifters and phased array antenna series design are presented. The phased array antenna typical design and the beam control system realization with switching frequency exceeding 1 kHz are described.

articleTitle: Single-electron transistor based on porous anodic alumina
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The self-organized nano-sized porous anodic alumina films filled with metal are discussed for multiple-island single-electron transistors operated at room temperature. The proposed approach allows multiple-island single-electron transistors being simultaneously fabricated over the whole wafer area and even on a wafer lot by batch manufacturing like conventional semiconductor integrated circuits.

articleTitle: The ship electrical signalling system ring bell from the fleet destroyer “Pronzitelny” of the Black Sea fleet: from the military equipment to cultural heritage
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The way of turning the ship ring bell system of the electrical system of one of the ships of the Black Sea fleet in the 1910's from the military equipment into an object of cultural heritage. Research is carried out within studying of a sample of such artefact from the funds of the National Museum of the Heroic Defense and Liberation of Sevastopol.

articleTitle: Problems of data organization for data mining techniques application in decision support systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the organization decision support systems with data mining techniques application and problems of data storage creating for these systems. The paper presents an overview of possible solutions using a decision support system for metal producing manufacture as an example.

articleTitle: The calculation of the current-voltage characteristics of vacuum EHF nanoelectronics structures
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The tunneling (cold emission) across potential barriers of complex forms, including those for structures with multiple electrodes, is theoretically studied. The volt-ampere characteristics (VAC) of diode and triode structures of vacuum nanoelectronics are presented.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the effectiveness of radar detection method for mine-like objects using seismic shocks
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents a quantitative evaluation of the mechanical displacement of objects under the influence of the search surface seismic waves and the level of additional modulation radar signal upon irradiation location mines.

articleTitle: Principle of developing the pseudo-coherent x-band radar
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principle of developing the pseudo-coherent radar [transmitter based upon the small-size cold-cathode magnetron (1kg)], which allows locating nearly objects and eliminating the influence of internal noise and of reflections from the sea surface, is presented. It allows locating small-size high-speed light vessels in a ship's wake.

articleTitle: “Quick” event registration by a microwave radiometric method
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the estimation of modulation radiometer efficiency when measuring “fast” processes. This estimation was obtained by considering effect of fluctuations of the receiver gain and compared with a modified zero radiometer. Measurement errors arising at reduction of integration time to period modulation values are determined.

articleTitle: Dielectric filters with improved frequency scattering parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The new kinds of dielectric resonators, proposed for using in the band-pass and band-stop filters, characterized by enlarged frequency bands, free of parasitic oscillations of high types, are considered. The electrodynamic model of the filters is developed. S-matrix parameters are calculated and studied.

articleTitle: Sensitivity increasing of a homodyne microwave meter of medium parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The realization of measuring instrument of changes of integrated structure of the environment is considered in the paper. Instrument allows measuring of phase progression of the microwave signal, which repeatedly passes the measuring environment. At the same times, sensitivity and accuracy of the device simultaneously increase. The design of the device and process of adjustment of the system as a whole becomes simpler.

articleTitle: Terahertz M-type oscillator: Optimal geometry of oscillatory circuit
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analytical estimation of optimal parameters is fulfilled for the terahertz M-type generator operating at frequency about 0.330 THz with anode voltage of 13 κV and magnetic field of 0.7 T. Revealing from this model, the magnetron interaction space geometry providing the effective electron interaction with a high-frequency field on (+1) spatial harmonic of p-mode oscillations is proposed for the drift-orbital resonance mode. Using the three-dimensional numerical simulation, the selected oscillation circuit geometry is verified and the system suitableness is confirmed at the operation frequency. In addition, directions of the system optimization are specified. The possibility to design magnetrons with rather low operating anode voltages, magnetic fields and with the increased service life is shown in the terahertz band.

articleTitle: Pulse characteristics of antenna array radiating ultra-wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dispersion properties of the mutual impedance of emitters significantly change the shape and the spectrum of ultra-wideband signals that it is necessary take into account when forming the signal. For analysis and calculations, taking into account the characteristics of mutual coupling of elements it is proposed to use the interaction pulse characteristics. Using pulse characteristics allows simplifying calculations of ultra-wideband antenna systems and improving their accuracy.

articleTitle: Phase calibration for non-linear network analyzers
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A phase calibration procedure for non-linear 6-pole network with frequency conversion is presented. This calibrated network can be used in a non-linear network analyzer instead of a comb generator. Calibration allows measuring absolute complex values of transition and reflection coefficients of non-linear devices.

articleTitle: Study of cooperative MIMO method effectiveness for HF communication system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental results are presented, on their basis the HF (high frequency) cooperative MIMO system channel capacity estimation was carried out. MIMO channel modeling results are also presented, they are obtained using correlative, Kronecker, Weichselberger models. Channel capacity was calculated for the following cases: SISO, MIMO 2×2. The calculated characteristics are compared with the corresponding ones obtained from the experimental data. Conclusions about effectiveness of cooperative MIMO method application in HF communication system are made.

articleTitle: Modeling of interaction of chiral mesogen with carbon nanotube
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of supramolecular organization modeling of a cholesteric liquid crystalline (ChLC) matrix was shown by molecular dynamics simulation using the all-atom model. The supramolecular organization of ChLC mesogen and ChLC - a single walled carbon nanotube composite was estimated and 3D-model of a cholesteric phase of the studied compound was obtained. The effect of a carbon nanotube on the order parameter of ChLC molecules in the cholesteric phase was determined.

articleTitle: Formation of CuGaTe2 nanoparticles in the silicate matrix. The method of preparation and properties
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Possibility of formation of nanoparticles ternary compound semiconductor SuGaTe2 in silicate glass is studied. It is shown that at introduction of a specified compound in a composition of the glass the nanostructure of good optical quality is obtained. Their optical absorption is studied in visible and near IK range areas. Influence of additional heat treatment on spectral properties of low-dimensional structures is found. The features of spectra are explained from the viewpoint of the transformation of the crystal lattices.

articleTitle: The hardware-software system for study of microwave radiation biological effects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the importance of the problem of studying the impacts of low-level microwave radiation on humans. The paper also presents the requirements for the organization of the data collection system and software for analysis in the study of the biological effects of radiation associated with psychoemotional changes.

articleTitle: Method for development of GPS working zone based on scaled-down simulation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of semi-natural simulation using software and hardware of NI GPS Simulation Toolkit and CH-4312 aviation receiver a method of constructing the working area (fields forecast accuracy) satellite navigation system GPS for a given airspace is proposed. This shows the limitations in the use of hardware-software means for assessing the accuracy of determining the coordinates of the object.

articleTitle: Properties of unproper gliding and leakage waves in dissipative waveguide structures
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Improper gliding and leakage waves in dissipative structures are considered. Such gliding surface wave is the Zenneck wave over the dissipative plane, the existence of which in a number of publications is in doubt until the present days. Here we show the falsity of such publications and give a historical overview on the mentioned problem. The calculated parameters of the Zenneck wave over the sea, along the border of air-ionosphere, above the metal and along the wire are presented. The results for gliding and leakage waves in some complex dissipative structures are presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of the dipole, helical and cavity-slot antennas applicators for multichannel medical radiothermographs
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Thermal radio emission at frequencies, expedient for medical diagnostics by a radio thermomapping method, is determined. Three types of antennas-applicators for the unified antenna lattices of radiothermomapping multichannel systems are considered. Density patterns of applicators' absorbed power in a near zone are presented.

articleTitle: Extraction of high-power multicell transistor parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Extraction procedure of high-power multicell transistor parameters was proposed and described. Test plate for extraction verification was designed. Extraction results were confirmed by experimental data.

articleTitle: Planar single-layer leaky-wave antenna array
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A planar center-fed leaky-wave antenna array for broadside radiation in 24–24.25 GHz frequency range is presented. The antenna consists of a printed one-dimensional periodic metal strip grating on a grounded dielectric waveguide. The radiation efficiency of the antenna exceeds 50 %, while the antenna gain is above 30 dBi.

articleTitle: On the history of cooperation of Leningrad plant (Leningrad Production Enterprise) named after Kozitskiy with enterprizes of the crimea
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents a summary on the first stage of formation of the Sevastopol radio plant and its functioning as a part of Leningrad Production Enterprise named after Kozitskiy. Founders and some leading specialists of the enterprise, the main types of the sea communication equipment manufactured during this period and its developers are characterized, the role of the main plant in formation of the enterprise is explained. In addition, the history of contacting with Simferopol PE “Photon” is discussed.

articleTitle: Development of simulation systems and decision-making method in the logistic field
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This work considers the need for a system of decision-making in the field of logistics. The necessity of such a product, and addresses issues related to this type of business, the specific traffic and voyage planning. Development directions of open multi-agent scheduling and simulation system are determined. A decision support method and BPsim system are developed for logistic aims.

articleTitle: Optical properties of silver/porous silicon nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the study of nanostructures formed by immersion deposition of silver on porous silicon at different modes for their application in surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy. Porous silicon has been fabricated by anodization of monocrystalline silicon in water solution of isopropanol and hydrofluoric acid. Reflectance spectra of the obtained structures of silver/porous silicon have been studied. It has been revealed that the highest level of Raman signal requires using laser with wavelength of 400 – 450 nm.

articleTitle: Scientist, teacher and tutor of brain-power (to the 80th anniversary of professor Boris Mikhailovich Petrov)
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This report is dedicated to a great scientist, a founder of scientific school in the applied electrodynamics, to Dr. Sci. Tech., the professor, an honored worker of science and techniques of the Russian Federation, an academician of Academy of Engineering Sciences of the Russian Federation — Boris Petrov.

articleTitle: Hurst exponent estimation for moving fractal object by maximum likelihood method
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Article deals with synthesis of Hurst exponent estimation algorithm for signal reflected from moving object. Signal model based on fractal Brownian motion is developed. Method of estimation of object Hurst exponent is proposed. Method of object detection by Neyman-Pearson criterion is considered.

articleTitle: Structure of the upper-air sounding system of the «Vostochny» cosmodrome
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Information concerning the development of the upper-air sounding system for meteorological provision of the «Vostochny» cosmodrome, integrating the most advanced atmosphere parameter instrumentation is provided in the present paper. Complex use of sounding means allows moving to a qualitatively new level in operational data acquisition about an atmosphere state.

articleTitle: Change in radiating power of the algainp heterostructures under irradiation by fast neutrons
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is established, that radiating power is reduced in three stages under irradiation by fast neutrons. There are areas of high, average and low electron injection in the active area of the light-emitting diodes. The final stage of the reducing process of light output power is a low electron injection.

articleTitle: Approach for RFID tag measurement data modeling
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the approach for modeling RFID tags measurement data of Received Signal Strength (RSS) and Read Rate (RR) types. For the modeling we take into account probabilities of successful response of an RFID-tag to an antenna, add normally distributed error into the modeled RSS value, and form an RR value taking into account the effect of correlation between RSS and RR values. As modeling input data we used experimental data obtained in an indoor facility during localization of 144 passive RFID tags by an RFID system composed of 16 antennas.

articleTitle: Aspects of building the digital transmit-receive modules of active electronically scanned arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principles of construction of transmit-receive modules of today's active electronically scanned arrays (AESA) with analog and digital beamforming (DBF) are considered. A block diagram of AESA with DBF is given. The basic problems arising in design of digital transmit-receive module were analyzed. They are the realization of synchronization circuit, the choice of the components and semiconductor technology of perform of transmit-receive module.

articleTitle: Biological effects of low level microwave radiation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article presents the results of changes in the emotional state of a person under the influence of low-intensity microwave radiation, which were confirmed by functional changes in the central and autonomic nervous systems, and also by formation of the physical and psychological attributes, typical for the definite states. Analysis of the obtained results allows considering them as a biological effect.

articleTitle: Linear approximation in phase-chronometric signal processing in torque measurement system of gas pumping plant
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A torque measuring system for pumping plants using phase-chronometric signals from clusters of eddy current probes is developed. The efficiency of the approximate approach in phase-chronometric signal processing is analyzed by means of a mathematical simulation.

articleTitle: Correlation and frequency properties of nonequidistant pulse sequence obtained by means of Frank codes
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An approach to the construction of non-equidistant pulse sequences based on Frank matrix. Autocorrelation functions of novel sequences and their spectral density are obtained. A comparison of time and frequency of regular and non-equidistant sequences is carried out.

articleTitle: Repeating tasks scheduling in desktop grid systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the proposed approach to planning recurring tasks in grid systems of personal computers, which have a heterogeneous dynamically changing architecture.

articleTitle: Automatic landing of animal tracking Lighter-Than-Air Systems (LTAS) on the recharging platform
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Basic concept of stratospheric platforms or rigid airships is applied more than 100 years and designed by the German constructor Count Ferdinand von Zeppelin. Zeppelin's ideas were first formulated in 1874 and developed in detail in 1893. Zeppelins were first flown commercially in 1910 by Deutsche Luftschiffahrts-AG (DELAG), the world's first airline in revenue service for carried fare-paying passengers. After that, were designed a special stratospheric High Altitude Platforms (HAP) for different applications including communication systems as backhaul to the terrestrial telecommunication systems. The first HAP stations are at a similar stage of development as communication satellites were in the 1960s, designed to fly or float above controlled airspace up to the stratosphere. In the meantime were developed similar projects known as Stratospheric Communication Platforms (SCP), Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) and Lighter-Than-Air Systems (LTAS). This paper describes LTAS solutions for tracking, monitor and control of wild animals. Firstly were established VHF Radio systems for animal tracking and during more than three decades, commercial Mobile Satellite Systems (MSS) have utilized tracking of mobiles via communication satellites and recently via SCP or LTAS airships and aircraft. Some of SCP stations have solar cells for generating power supply and some have rechargeable batteries. The proposed design of LTAS rechargeable ground platforms is described.

articleTitle: The termal insulation microwave absorber material
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Studies of foam glass modified with ilmenite concentrate have demonstrated the improvement of its physicomechanical properties in comparison with foam glass synthesized without additives. This material actively interacts with microwaves and can be used for the development of protective screens reducing the adverse effect of microwaves on biological objects, anechoic chambers, and rooms with low level of electromagnetic background noise. Spectra of the transmission coefficients for frequencies in 26–260 GHz range are presented. The observed effects demonstrate the existence of regions with partial and total reflection arising on the glass-pore boundary and of the microwave interaction with superdispersed concentrate and carbon particles that remain after foaming with incomplete frother transition from the soot to the gas phase.

articleTitle: Quasioptimal nonlinear filtering of binar signals in Johnson noise condition
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: There was designed an unintentional emission signal receiver based on Markovian nonlinear filtering method. Analysis of receiver efficiency was carried out on digital simulation of a mixed signal, SL Johnson noise and white Gaussian noise. The new receiver allows realizing binary signal extractions similar to optimal receive of minor average risk method.

articleTitle: Some properties of E-plane cross-shaped resolver of the complex reflection analyzer
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Properties of the seven-port transducer using four-port inhomogeneity of E-plane cross-shaped power divider are considered. Vector parameters of a measuring channel of the transducer have weak frequency dependence, if the width of a standard waveguide of the measuring channel is two fold the width of the waveguide of the primary channel of the divider.

articleTitle: HF-band synthetic aperture radar for buried objects detection
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of using HF-band synthetic aperture radar to detect buried objects from aboard of aircraft in on-line flight mode is experimentally demonstrated. The procedure of synthetic aperture in decameter radio waves is considered due to reflected signal coherent (regular) component availability.

articleTitle: Electron flow in the mode of simultaneous generation of two oscillation modes of signals
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the experiments using a self-consistent mathematical model of the magnetron M155. The experiments show possibility of simultaneous long generation of π-mode and N/2 +1-mode signals, whose power is sufficient for practical use.

articleTitle: Events ontologies and their application for description of energy security threats
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article proposes the improvement of two-level technology of energy security study by integrating of semantic models and expansion of the ontological space of knowledge domain (energetics) by means of events ontologies. The rules of events ontology generating are proposed. The examples of events ontology and events metaontology are given.

articleTitle: Probability of energy-based signal detection under conditions of multipath fading channels
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A closed-form analytic expression for the probability of detection for energy-based detection over multipath fading channels is analyzed. The most general fading model, i.e. k-μ channel with shadowing, is assumed.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling and design of multiple-valued logic elements of digital telecommunications networks
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The study tackles the issues of multiple-valued elements design, based on the nonlinear resonant circuits (NRC) as a decision of a parametrical optimization problem. We illustrate that the use of nonlinear resonant circuit is one of the most perspective variants of multiple-valued logic elements implementation.

articleTitle: Fractality as a new nanotechnological direction of semiconductor material science
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Studies have shown that in the local approximation, the behavior of electrical properties of semiconductor surfaces, interfaces, processes of current flow and charge transport, as well as the majority of technological processes on the nano-level satisfy all properties of chaotic systems. In the local approximation, the dependences of the electrophysical properties of objects and geometry of technological processes on the linear dimensions and fractional values of fractal dimensions allow making control of the properties of semiconductors and technological processes on the nano-level, which is a sign of a new nanotechnology direction in semiconductor material science. Unlike quantum effects, not only the energy properties of electron gas, but also almost all other physical properties of semiconductors obey the fractal regularities in the local approximation.

articleTitle: The spiral slot antenna with a horizontal choke ring
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the computer modeling of a spiral slot antenna with horizontally oriented cells of a choke ring. The advantage of using the horizontal choke ring in the form of small electrical size of the antenna system is shown in comparison with the traditional vertical one. An assessment of the impact with respect to the horizontal choke ring on the phase diagram in the upper hemisphere is performed.

articleTitle: Forming and self-changing non-linearity as a security measure of communication system used chaos
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Authors' conception of controllable and self-controllable non-linearity is described (as a discussion theme). Its implementation is one of the possible ways to give the biological objects' features (“biologization”) to usual engineering systems. In particular, it can be useful to increase resistance of confidential communication systems.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of the cone antenna with a longitudinal slot
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A wideband cone antenna in 10-GHz range is experimentally investigated. The directivity diagram (DD) of the isotropic cone antenna and the cone antenna with a longitudinal slot is obtained. The scheme of cone antenna supply with an unbalanced coaxial cable by using an instrumental coaxial connector and a metallic screen is proposed.

articleTitle: Rarefied recursive positioning of scanning objects in radar systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper proposes a method of rarefied recursive coding of objects to be scanned in space in radar systems, which based on single-bit recursive tracking of Galois code scale. The developed method of rarefied reading allows reducing the technological requirements to the size of primary transformation elements. Rarefied reading of a single-bit scale allows simplifying the design and reducing the cost of mass production tracking systems of objects in space.

articleTitle: Anisotropy and frequency dependence determination of relative dielectric constant for sapphire and silicon carbide substrates
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Study results of frequency properties of sapphire and 4H-SiC{0001} silicon carbide substrate show availability of anisotropy and dispersion of effective dielectric constant ε(f).
