In both cases a value of ε(f) decreases with frequency f increasing. For a sapphire substrate the dispersion (ε(f=3.3 GHz)=9.32 and ε(f=37.6GHz)=8.62) is 7.5 percent, anisotropy is lesser than 0.5 percent. For 4H-SiC substrates a maximum value of dispersion (ε(f=3.47 GHz)=8.34 and ε(f=46.63 GHz)=7.77) is 6.8 percent, and anisotropy is 2.8 percent.

articleTitle: Few-element antenna array for high-accuracy noise-protected tri-band GLONASS/GPS receiver
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A few-element antenna array for the high-accuracy noise-protected receiver GLONASS/GPS has been developed. The antenna array is implemented based on the tri-band (L1/L2/L3) active slot stripline leaky-wave antennas with right-hand circular polarization. The root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) of the relative phase pseudo-range determination by GLONASS signals in the four-element antenna array is observed to be lower than 1 mm in the L1 band and lower than 1.3 mm in the L2 band.

articleTitle: Interference from Adjacent Satellite Systems in Mobile Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper introduces the effects of interference from Adjacent Satellite Systems affecting all applications of Mobile Satellite Communications (MSC) systems as a very important influence of Space constellations. The advantages and disadvantages of those effects are discussed and also are provided particulars about specific local environmental influence in Maritime MSC (MMSC), such as some of the noise contributions from the local ships, environment. These noise influences are introduced by atmospheric noise from absorption, industrial noise, out of band emission from ship's radar, interference from high power communication transmitters, interference from vehicles and shipyard noise. Specific issues related to blockages caused by vessels superstructures and motion of ship's antenna are concluded and a set of solutions are proposed to maximize the availability of satellite communication capacity to the mobile user applications at sea, on the ground and in the air.

articleTitle: Verification of wood permittivity spectra using the Kramers — Kronig relation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Spectra of the complex permittivity of spruce (Picea obovata), obtained by capacitor, resonator and free space techniques in the frequency range 100 kHz – 500 GHz are presented. Data from the literature containing information about the permittivity spectra of these wood, are presented. Kramers-Kronig relation can be used to adjust the measurements of the complex permittivity subject to the availability of experimental data in three important regions of the spectrum: near zero frequency, in the anomalous dispersion region and near the optical range.

articleTitle: Information method of resolution increasing in SQUID-microscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of low temperatures in the SQUID sensor at room temperature of the sample does not allow reducing the distance between them. This leads to a smearing of the image and reducing the resulting resolution of the microscope. Standard methods for deconvolution can improve the resolution of the SQUID microscope up to 20 times, but they are not optimal with respect to the information available a priori. We used information-algebraic algorithm to avoid these losses. This allows improving the resolution of the SQUID microscope even up to 10 times. In addition, this method allows refining or reconstructing not exactly set parameters of the sensor.

articleTitle: Study of neural network algorithm of the earth remote sensing data clustering
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The algorithm of the autonomous classification of objects from their satellite images is offered and studied. The algorithm is based on the neural network technologies. The algorithm was tested and recommendations for it using are proposed. The examples of real images processing are presented.

articleTitle: The analog-to-digital converter with 1100 MSPS sampling rate
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technical solution of an analog-to-digital converter consisting of two ADC chips ADS54RF63 is proposed. It makes possible to process the input signal bandwidth of 0.5 GHz with dynamic range of 60 dB. This analog-to-digital converter is produced by Beta TV com Ltd, Donetsk, Ukraine.

articleTitle: Calculation of differential and equivalent parameters of autodyne oscillators based on the approximation characteristics of gunn diodes
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculation results of active and reactive conductivities of Gunn diodes, differential autodyne parameters of microwave oscillators, non-isochronism and non-isodromism coefficients of autodyne oscillators and external feedback parameters are presented. Calculations are based on the approximation characteristics of Gunn diodes.

articleTitle: Submillimeter wavelength region orotron with double-row periodic structure
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of submillimeter orotron with double-row periodic structure development is considered. Results of experimental investigation of a model of such device with 0.182-mm periodic structure step and different modifications of open resonators in 140…360GHz frequency range are presented.

articleTitle: Ring array for monopulse phase direction finder
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the method of the optimal structure synthesis for the ring passive array of the wideband phase direction finder using the limited number of antenna elements and having required low level of phase errors.

articleTitle: The modified zero radiometer for dielectric medium study at the near-field zone
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The block diagram of the microwave radiometer designed for biological application is developed. The radiometer can significantly reduce the effect of changes of the transmission coefficient of the radiometric receiver, drift noise temperature and antenna mismatch with biological object at the measurement results.

articleTitle: Collection and data transmission devices for geographically distributed systems of heating monitoring of buildings
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the features and grounds of the modern element base for creation of the devices for-data collection of non-permanent parameters in geographically distributed systems of monitoring of buildings for industrial and sociocultural purposes.

articleTitle: Optimization of antenna configuration to achieve higher performance of MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The effect of spatial correlation on the capacity of MIMO system and bit error rate is discussed. A method of optimization of multi-element antenna geometrical parameters under given power azimuth spectrum is proposed. It is shown that MIMO system with optimized antennas provides better performance as compared with MIMO system using standard half-wave uniform linear arrays, when V-BLAST coding algorithm is implemented in a channel with correlated Rayleigh fading and Gaussian noise.

articleTitle: The results of calculation of 0.18 THz klynoorbictron-amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the optimization search using an elaborated mathematical model for the promising versions of a klynoorbictron-amplifier design to be operated over the frequency range of 180 GHz are presented. The versions of the devices have been found, which are capable of providing from 10 to 14 % efficiency, the gain of 18-38 dB, the output power of 10 to 40 W with input signal power of 0.01-0.5 W at operating voltage of 0.07 - 0.18 A.

articleTitle: Modeling of electromagnetic waves in cylindrical three-layers waveguide with metamaterial layer
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of coefficient's modeling by propagation wave guide's modes of cylindrical tree-layer waveguide. Medium layer LHM (Left-Handed-Medium) is a metamaterial with a negative index of refraction. The presented results allow making a conclusion about the existence of waves with a significant delay of phase velocity in such waveguides.

articleTitle: Application possibilities of fiber-optic telecommunication links' components for beamforming systems of broadband antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the possibility of using components of telecommunication fiber-optic links implementing Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM) technology to build the beamforming systems for broadband receiving phased array antennas. The paper presents the results of experimental study of the characteristics of the fiber-optic microwave signals' transmission link model, composed of components available in the market. The obtained estimation of the model's main parameters, i.e. transfer coefficient, the transfer characteristic, compression point, dynamic range, harmonic distortions, noise level, are given.

articleTitle: Quantitative determination of fault tolerance for neuronetwork devices of infocommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The option of quantitative criterion of level determination of fault tolerance of neural networks of any structure and appointment is developed. Fault tolerance of the neuronetwork device of recognition of a radio signal with QAM256 modulation is investigated. Dependence of determination result of fault tolerance level on the chosen indicator of quality of functioning of the neuronetwork device is studied.

articleTitle: The 3-mm wavelength phase-meter system based on dielectric elements' base
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The 3-mm wavelength phase-meter system for motion characteristics' remote measurement is presented being based on dielectric passive structures and the dielectric waveguide antenna-feeder system. It operates on the basis of radiointerferometry principles. Some experimental results illustrating its applications are presented.

articleTitle: Model of the speckle noise forprocessing of SAR images
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A model of statistical properties of speckle noise in SAR images which formed from rough surfaces is described. The autocorrelation and cross-correlation functions of speckle intensity are investigated in both single-look and multi-look images of stationary random rough surfaces in term of the SAR system parameters and the autocorrelation function of backscatter radar cross-section fluctuation. Speckles are modeled with a multiplicative noise model and verified with real SAR data. Using the developed statistical noise model the property of SAR images has been investigated. It is shown that if the correlation scale of cross-section fluctuation functions of speckle intensity depends on those of the cross-section fluctuations. This property, therefore, may be applied to image classification. Comparison of the theory with computer simulation shows good agreement.

articleTitle: Publication citation at CriMiCo conference “microwave & telecommunication technology” in Scopus database
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The report analyzes citation and self-citation of publications in CriMiCo conference using bibliometric methods with Scopus database. Geographical aspect of citation and chronological dynamics of processes of citation and self-citation are considered. Actual values and self-citation and citation indices for the Conference Proceedings, as well as identifying trends in these indicators are determined.

articleTitle: Effect of multiple changes of phase and group velocity of traveling waves in the microwave broadband devices based on strip structures with a strongly unbalanced electromagnetic coupling
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper discusses propagation of waves in a strip structure of “meander line coupled with two solid strips” type. It is shown that in propagation of the quasi-TEM waves in controlled devices based on such a structure, there are two matched states with external circuits in a wide frequency band. These states are characterized by significantly different phase and group delay velocities of the forming traveling waves in a stripline structure with the lowest level of the reflected waves. The authors believe that the stripline structure in question provides the smallest possible dimensions for the task of constructing phase shifters and other microwave devices.

articleTitle: Image filtering algorithms in infocommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A comparative analysis of efficiency of frequency image filtering algorithms of Wiener and Tikhonov, under conditions of distorting noise with Rayleigh and exponential probability density functions. Quality filtering characteristics (signal/noise ratio of the initial and processed images) are calculated.

articleTitle: Improving the accuracy of positioning by GNSS signals at regional level
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Precise positioning service allows determining a user's coordinates by global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) signals with meter and decimeter accuracy on single-frequency equipment. In connection with development of GNSS such service became relevant. The possibility of network creation with high positioning accuracy on the basis of cellular communication systems was considered.

articleTitle: Some results of orbital objects observation by a radio-wave imaging radar station of Bauman Moscow State Technical University
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The construction principles description and operation algorithms of high potential Ka-band radio-wave imaging radar station (RWIRS) are presented. RWIRS is constructed on basis of the double mirror antenna system of the radio telescope RT 7.5 of Bauman Moscow State Technical University. Some results of orbital objects observation are described.

articleTitle: Selective properties of the double-row periodic structures of millimeter-wave band
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of modeling transformation of surface waves of a dielectric waveguide into spatial waves on different modifications of the double-row periodic structures are presented. Possibility of effective radiated power control of harmonics and selection of oscillations for the investigated structures is shown.

articleTitle: Microstrip filters based on 2-D photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The properties of microstrip structure with the regular resonators and based on 2-D photonic crystal with dimension 2×3 are investigated theoretically and experimentally. An opportunity to create filters with high frequency selective characteristics and based on 2-D microwave design is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dynamic chaos in a problem of objects positioning: On a capability and features of application
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Possibility of dynamic chaos using for determination of navigation objects position (over a communication channel length, or for a signal delay time in it) is discussed. In this context the correlation properties of dynamic modes of spiral and screw chaos types are studied and compared using a Rössler generator as an example:

articleTitle: Simulation of an analog phase shifter
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The feature of the phase shifter under study is a set of identical connected cascades in T-scheme. The results of numerical modeling are presented. The studied device is optimized for S-parameters in the frequency range; phase and amplitude characteristics of return loss and insertion loss are investigated. Thus, the possibility of modeling of a microwave module of an analog phase shifter based on a two-port cascade connection, is shown. The results of numerical simulation of multi-cascade analog phase shifters based on the elements with controlled capacity. These experimental frequency characteristics of the phase shifter produced on the basis of numerical modeling results are fully agreed with the calculated data.

articleTitle: Numerical conformal transformations for modeling of coupled round conductors with an eccentric shielded pair
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For the first time a quasi-static model for an eccentric shielded pair of conductors is developed using numerical conformal transformations. The magnetic slits are introduced, and the circular boundaries are approximated by polygonal ones during modeling. Conformal transformations are implemented in MATLAB. If the conductors are moved from the center to the outer shield, it provokes coupling and matching impedance reducing.

articleTitle: The state analysis of intelligent tools of Computer Aided Software Engineering
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the analysis of Computer Aided Software Engineering Tools (such as IBM Rational, CA ERwin Modeling Suite, Aris Toolset, BizAgi, Elma, Power Designer, BPsim и Borland Together Designer) for automation of a development process and change management of typical enterprise business process. The enterprise information system development is based on Big Data technology. The simulation is used as a basis for enterprise business process improvement tools.

articleTitle: Integration of optical and electronic interconnections on silicon
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design and fabrication technology of integrated optical and electrical interconnects on silicon are developed. The light-emitting diodes in the presented construction are based on nanostructured silicon built in an alumina matrix. The optocouple with the current transforming coefficient of about 1 % is fabricated. The advantages of the developed design are shown in comparison with existing analogues.

articleTitle: Videolocator for subsurface sensing radiowave system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We consider the algorithms of video signal processing in digital videolocator that provides coordinates estimation of a linear antenna array of subsurface sensing radiowave system during scanning. To estimate temporal displacement and rotation angle is proposed to use the mutual phase spectrum of two consecutive videoframes.

articleTitle: Map of the history of telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A unique geographical and chronological map of telecommunications technology in the world that demonstrates how, where and when were created the technologies that have influenced the development of the whole sphere of communications. The fundamental principles underlying the construction of maps of the history of telecommunications are presented.

articleTitle: Methodology of data decomposition and formal synthesis of composition forms for representation of digital signal processing basic operations
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of parallel algorithm development is considered. The main content of a solution presented is development of formal law of information formation on parallel algorithm structures. The way proposed of a solution search is characterized initially by a single view on algorithmic and architectural subsystems of a parallel computation system. The main peculiarity of the solution presented is synthesis of general description of sequential and parallel algorithms for digital signal processing operations. The basis for solution presented is developed methodology of data decomposition. The main peculiarities of methodology presented are its functional nature and the general approach to data decomposition of any dimension. The basic steps of methodology presented are considered. The methodology is the basis for development of the formal model of the parallel computation organization. The synthesis method of composition form for digital signal processing basic operations is considered.

articleTitle: Study of the excitation mode of plasma waves in 2D plasma of GaAs-AlxGa1−xAs heterostructure at low temperatures
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of the statistical simulation method the study of exaltation mode of plasma waves in 2D plasma of heterostructures and the main characteristics of physical process of charge carriers transfer, was carried out at low temperatures. Algorithms and programs for the study of excitation mode of plasma waves in 2D plasma heterostructures. Plasma frequency in GaAs / AlxGa1−xAs heterostructure was calculated, its value is about 3.58 THz.

articleTitle: Additional focusing in the problem of three-dimensional radio-frequency visualizations of subsurface objects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The modification of the algorithm for radio holographic synthesis of 3D-images based on probing LFM-signal is developed. The modification takes into account the effect of refraction at the boundary with a receiving environment. Double improvement in resolution and geometric similarity image subsurface objects are shown experimentally.

articleTitle: System for operability evaluation of “Vector-M” radar complex
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article describes a system that allows evaluating the operability of major functional subsystems of “Vector-M” Aerological radar computing system (ARCS) during the session of tracking a flying radiosonde, and, at the end of operation, making a prediction of operability or diagnosing a failure location with a program analysis of information collected over a certain number of flights.

articleTitle: Factors leading to reduced effectiveness of resonance peniotron
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The study of the influence of the phase velocity of the microwave wave and increase of the speed of electron beams on the limit values of the peniotron effectiveness has been carried out using the developed mathematical model. It is shown, that peniotron limit efficiency exceeds 80% in case of phase velocity change in the range 1≤ υp/ c ≤ 2 at nonrelativistic electron speeds.

articleTitle: Reduction treatment of iron-ore technological raw material with the use of the high-power microwave electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technology of reduction treatment of iron-ore raw material with the use of microwave radiation having the bulk heating properties, that allows, unlike the convection heat sources, eliminating the appearance of temperature nonuniformities in different areas of the processed material, shortening the energy expense and raising the heating speed.

articleTitle: Mismatch errors of modulation meter of complex reflection coefficient
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theoretical analysis of the mismatch errors of microwave channel elements in the meter of the integrated reflectance is carried out by means of the method of directed graphs. It is shown that due to the frequency selection of meter information, a significant portion of the spectral components due to finite isolation between the reference and measuring channels turns to be outside the bandwidth of the electoral system.

articleTitle: Influence of electric field strength on electrochemical formation of macroporous silicon with ordered pore positions
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Studying of electric field influence on macroporous silicon formation has been conducted. We have found that formation of the ordered macroporous structure took place at electric field strength exceeding 109 V/m. The electric field strength less than above-mentioned value results in pore extension and following pore splitting in two.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the calculation results for the communication range with the simulation results of network coverage LTE
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the course of the study the analysis and modeling of the LTE network in the city of Almaty were carried out. The network modeling was performed using the simulation program Atoll. Atoll is a flexible and scalable platform for planning the cellular networks.

articleTitle: The microwave device on diaphragm and frame coupling elements for Gunn diode generator output power control
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility to create waveguide structures based on diaphragm with coupling elements placed astride it, which have both allowed and forbidden bands, had been shown experimentally. It was shown that introducing the heterogeneity kind of “dowel with gap” into the construction provides the appearance of the resonance singularity kind of low-loss transmission window in the forbidden frequency band and a kind of cutoff peak in the allowed frequency band. The value of dynamic range of transmittance adjustment using n-i-p-i-n-structure, placed in the gap between a dowel and a frame element, reaches 23.5 dB at the value of transmission loss of 1.5 dB. The possibility to use the offered device for controlling output power of a generator based on Gunn diode has been investigated.

articleTitle: Noninvasive diagnostics of the melanoma using the method of near-field microwave sounding
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the development and approbation of the method of resonant near-field microwave to-mography with regard to problems on early diagnostics of melanoma and other skin neoplasms.

articleTitle: Using of movement microwave detector for radiovision tasks
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the possibility to increase resolution of radio images shot when using the clocked grating principle. Monochromatic sensing of an object with a completely filled lattice at 24 GHz allows obtaining resolution of at least 0.5–1 cm. The main advantages of this option are the easy sensing and low production cost, that contribute to its further development and application.

articleTitle: Phase error correcting method for phase splitters based on SiGe differential stage
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper presents the methods of correction of the phase angle error of the phase splitters (PS) of microwave band based on the classical differential stage. The synthesis strategy of design correction circuits of the second order, providing reduction of the parasite phase shift up to Δφ≤2 degree between the output signals of phase splitter in the frequency band up to 8 – 13 GHz in the SGB25VD technological basis, is given.

articleTitle: Development of MIC PDK for GaAs process with 1.0-µm geometry size
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of development of MIC PDK for GaAs process with 1.0-µm geometry size are presented. The PDK was later used for development of IF amplifiers, microwave switches and IF transformers for frequency range up to 1.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Comparison of calculation techniques for large signal S-parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two techniques for calculating the large signal S-parameters (LSSPs) of nonlinear microwave circuits, i.e., the frequency splitting method and circuit modification method, are compared. It is shown that in contrast to the small signal case, LSSPs calculated by different techniques will be inevitably distinct due to distortion of an initial stationary operating mode of the circuit. However, these differences do not lead to significant errors in designing microwave circuits. Recommendations for selecting the LSSP calculation technique and conditions are presented.

articleTitle: Small-sized axisymmetrical antenna arrays of microwave range
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the research of small-sized axisymmetrical radial and azimuthal dipole antenna arrays are presented. Methodology reducing the size of antenna arrays by incorporating lumped inductive elements into tears of radiating branches of vibrators is offered.

articleTitle: Multialternative detection and recognition of subsurface objects as per the preliminary diagnostics of soil
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper proposes a method for the detection and recognition of subsurface objects, in which the processing of the received signals used information about the electrophysical parameters of the soil in the frequency range used by the probing of UWB (ultra-wideband) signal.

articleTitle: Investigations of troposphere radiowave propagation over the Black Sea surface
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper describes experiments on beyond-the-horizon very high and microwave wave propagation over the North-East part of the Black Sea. The experiments took place in the 30–70th of the XX century. The experiments provided better understanding of the mechanisms of the far wave propagation over the sea surface, accumulating the data base with information concerning the signals' attenuation factor, space-temporal distribution and frequency-selective fading. The results of these experiments helped to work out the methods of attenuation factor prognosis and gave recommendations for synthesis of adaptive radars.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of multi-agent systems and Kanban system in the construction of operational production plans for engineering enterprises
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Large industrial enterprises are complex dynamical systems. Automated production management systems play a significant role in such enterprises. The data system has the following functions: automation of the process of creating, manufacturing, production planning, management and others. The comparative analysis of multi-agent systems, production planning and production of Toyota is carried out.

articleTitle: Simulation of radio receivers based on multi-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Modification of an express engineering method for simulation of nanoelectromechanical system (NEMS) such as nanoradio based on multi-walled carbon nanotubes (CNT) is proposed. Calculations of NEMS including two and three electrodes are carried out. Firstly, the influence of a distance between CNT top and an anode on nanoradio IV-characteristics is shown. Secondly, the influence of a distance between CNT and a bottom electrode on a normalized frequency shift of radio receivers is illustrated.

articleTitle: UWB remote detection of nonlinear electronic components
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We investigate the possibility of using ultra-wideband (UWB) signals for nonlinear location, when using the perturbations of the scattered field it is required to determine the presence or absence of nonlinear inclusions in the field of observation. The proposed solution is to compare the shape of UWB pulses reflected from a given field sensing in two modes - switched off mode and in case of additional generator microwave illumination. If the non-linear element is present in the areas of sensing, and microwave power of illumination is high enough, the first and second reflected UWB pulses will vary in shape. If the difference in the form of pulses is significant, we assume a nonlinear element presence in the region under study.

articleTitle: Stroboscopic radar of extensional objects observation
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The way of information redundancy reduction of the stroboscopic radar at the review of extended objects is considered. The structure of stroboscopic processing system is offered. Overall performance of system is shown by statistical modeling.

articleTitle: Effect of meteorological formations for change in consumers coordinates in GNSS
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The ability to detect meteorological formations along the propagation path of radio waves using global positioning systems is experimentally demonstrated. Seasonal changes of altitude and characteristics of the propagation field are compared.

articleTitle: The control of the combinational components of multifrequency signals at M-type TWT
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the research results of a numerical simulation of combinational frequencies waves' excitation by the multiharmonic signal amplification in a M-type TWT, which is a superposition of monochromatic waves. The paper shows the possibility to control a power level of combination components in the output signal spectrum by means of changing an input power level of an additional control signal.

articleTitle: Dual-band rectangular dielectric resonator filter
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A novel dual-band rectangular dielectric resonator is presented. Resonators are rotated 45 degrees relative to the coaxial feed and excited at two magnetic dipole oscillations: TE11b, TE21b. The filter operates at 5.57 and 6.1 GHz. The fractional bandwidth is 0.4% and 0.2% for the two passbands respectively.

articleTitle: Noncoherent selective reception of chaotic radiopulses in a multipath channel
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Scheme of a noncoherent selective receiver of ultrawideband chaotic radiopulses in a multipath channel with additive Gaussian noise is proposed and analyzed. Method is based on a convolution of chaotic pulses with a mutually orthogonal signal set. It was shown that bit-error-probability versus signal-to-noise ratio of the proposed method in the multipath channel is practically the same as for the energy receiver in the AWGN channel with one path.

articleTitle: Determination of efficient parameters of calibrated one-port vector network analyzers for limited frequency ranges using a short-circuited air line
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article presents a new method of accuracy verification of calibrated one-port vector network analyzers based on the least mean square algorithm. The method is of particular interest for significantly limited frequency ranges as well as for costeffective S-parameter measurement systems where the use of conventional ripple test may be impractical and/or relatively expensive. Experimental studies were conducted for few frequency ranges in coaxial measurement environment.

articleTitle: Uncertainty analysis of covariance matrix based vector network analyzer for Z-parameter measurements
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article presents the covariance matrix based uncertainty analysis for Z-parameter measurements using a vector network analyzer. Calculation expressions for one- and two-port devices are given. Experimental studies were conducted on CABAN R154 vector reflectometer in the coaxial measurement environment.

articleTitle: Fast channel estimation algorithm for HF MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper proposes a low complexity algorithm of the channel estimation for HF serial-tone MIMO communication channel, based on: 1) presentation of MIMO channel as a set of SIMO channels, 2) tracking of main vectors of eigenvalue decomposition (EVD) of the impulse response correlation function (IR) of a SIMO channel; 3) current MMSE estimation of IR with the approximation of the decreased rank of the correlation matrix IR.

articleTitle: Electrochemical deposition of ZnO/Er thin films and nanocrystal arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The electrochemical deposition process of the zinc oxide/erbium system is investigated by the cyclic voltammetry method on the metallic and semiconductor substrates. Morphology and composition of zinc oxide/erbium films deposited on nickel and single-crystalline silicon in the different modes are studied. The present paper shows the possibility of formation of the zinc oxide/erbium continuous films as well as the arrays of nanocrystals with 50 – 100 nm diameter controlled by the electrochemical deposition process variables.

articleTitle: Improvement algorithm for the transmission voice efficiency in dispatch communication system
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the possibility to increase speech intelligibility in a communication system in a strong external acoustic noise. The result is achieved by using adaptive frequency spectrum correction by increasing the speech base frequency. To determine the instantaneous speech base period the method developed through a combination of cepstral and correlation methods is applied.

articleTitle: Nanostructural semiconductors based on powder technology
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The basic methods to obtain nanocrystalline silicon based on powder technology are analysed. Structural features of the powder nanosilicon prepared by plasma chemical synthesis are considered. Test samples are generated by the dynamic pressure and static pressing. Current and temperature characteristics of the test samples, which showed the possibility of using monocrystallites powder material as a part of the active layers of nonlinear devices, are analysed.

articleTitle: Correlation distance measuring instrument
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A correlation method of distance measurement is considered. It is proved that in such radio finder the influence of Doppler shift of frequency on result of measurements is excluded. The characteristic of the distance measurer is defined. It is shown that the characteristic of the measurer has a sawtooth appearance. The steepness of the characteristic is defined. Condition of unambiguous measurement of range is obtained. The assessment of potential accuracy of the temporary delay measurement is obtained.

articleTitle: Technological optimization of the microwave hybrid and monolithic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The methodology of increasing of serial applicability indicators and reliability of microwave hybrid and monolithic in-tegrated circuits (HIC and MIC) is offered. The modern MIC element base consists of multilayered semiconductor heterostructures. The methodology is based on modeling of degradation processes of microwave HIC and MIC heterostructure under the influence of external factors and development of technological optimization methods.

articleTitle: Biometric signal processing at radar remote diagnostics of cardio-respiratory human activity
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Radars which able to diagnose the state of living organisms, can find the widest application. The estimation method of respiration and heartbeat parameters of the man was offered. The mathematical modeling for algorithm optimization of obtaining the necessary signals and determination of their spectral characteristics are carried out.

articleTitle: Bi-grid tube as a king for a day
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The development aspects of double-grid tubes with a cathode grid are studied. The features of this tube, its advantages and disadvantages are analyzed. The tube designs of different manufacturers are presented. The analysis of the reasons why this tube was forced out by tetrode with a shielding grid.

articleTitle: The resonant-emission diode on a nitride gallium cathode with single-layer cathode coating
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A presence of resonant electron emission of GaN micro-cathode with AlGaN single-layer coating at certain parameters of the coating and electric field have been shown and negative conductance of a diode based on the emission is obtained. Dependence of frequency spectrum of negative conductance on cathode coating parameters is investigated. Parameters of the diode with negative conductance in terahertz frequency range has been found and optimized.

articleTitle: Rector of Simferopol University in 1985–1989 Aleksandr Georgiyevich Shein (to the 75th anniversary)
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the activity of a famous radio physicist, an expert in the field of SHF physical electron-ics, the doctor of physical and mathematical sciences, professor Alexandr Georgiyevich Shein. Three periods of Prof. Shein's activity are singled out: in Kharkov, in the Crimea, and in Volgograd. It is noted, that in Simferopol State University the department of radio physics was organized upon an initiative of A. G. Shein.

articleTitle: Formal transition from algorithm to model for digital signal processing operations
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Evolution of a basis of the organization of computing process for digital signal processing is observed. Necessity of the basis modification for parallel data processing is shown. Real transition to parallel data processing has made computation organization the object of the investigations. The object is characterized by set of variants of the computation organization. The variant chosen ought to provide efficient processing under the given conditions of computation realization. Therefore to provide a possibility of the well-founded choice of a variant of the computation organization it is necessary to develop a new formal basis of the organization of computations in the space-time domain. Formal model is the basis. The way of the formal model development is offered.

articleTitle: Phase-locking by an external wave of a two-mode electron oscillator with close frequencies
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper considers a competition of two modes with frequency separation much smaller than the zone of self-excitation. Such a situation is typical for a gyrotron with an oversized cavity. Thus, the driving monochromatic signal affects both modes. It is shown that such a gyrotron can be switched from one mode to another. This sort of operation can be used for suppression of neoclassical tearing modes in tokomaks and stellarators.

articleTitle: The formation of the pattern radar images of ships using a limited set of experimental data
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of formation of radar images of ships are given for SAR's with a different resolution. As an original material, the real radar image of moorages of ships in a L-waveband with resolution about 1.5 meters was used. The radar images were compared with their classes by means of estimating and visual analysis of available optical shots which correspond to the radar ones.

articleTitle: Behaviour comparison of the cumulative phase difference and the correlative integral module in application to the problems of the reference estimation of parameters of radioholographic objects
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the comparison of methods using cumulative phase difference (CPD) and correlation integral absolute value (CIAV) as a proximitymeasure, taking as an example a problem of reference estimation of parameters of holographicmicrowave imaging (SRGV) systems' objects under study. Itdemonstrates that bothmethods outperforma classical system resolution limit.

articleTitle: Investigation of subterahertz gyrotron for DNP NMR spectroscopy at IAP RAS
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the state of the art of the development and experimental investigations of subterahertz gyrotrons for spectroscopy applications at IAP RAS. The gyrotron with frequency of 258 GHz and power of 100 watts is successfully used for spectroscopy experiments and 80-time rising of sensitivity has been obtained. The fundamental harmonic gyrotron with an internal mode converter is under development now. The predicted efficiency is 20% at power about 100 W and frequency of 263 GHz. The same helium-free 10-T magnet and electron optics will be used for design of a second harmonic tube with operating frequency of 520 GHz.

articleTitle: The design version for the active microstrip bandpassing filters
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The algorithm of the construction of the active microstrip bandpass filter with the application of the corrective element of its frequency characteristic is represented. The corrective element converts initial (the Tchebyshev frequency characteristic of a filter) to the elliptical form near the passband. The microwave linear amplifier compensates the insertion losses. This position is confirmed on the example of the 8-pole L -band filter with bandpass about 8%.

articleTitle: Secure communication using generalized synchronization in the case of the influence of chaotic signal on periodic generators
publicationTitle: 2014 24th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Method for secure information transmission on the basis of generalized synchronization in the case of the influence of chaotic signal on periodic generators has been proposed. The efficiency of the method has been testified by the numerical simulation both of model (Rössler generators) and real (low-voltage vircators) systems using as generators of transmitter and receiver. The proposed method is shown to possess principal advantages in comparison with the known analogues eliminating the problem of instability of its performance when the control parameters of interacting systems are not identical, increasing its stability to noise and the quality of information transmission.
